<!--
SCRIPT CONTENTS — source only; never rendered.
Run chunks 01–10 in order, or Render this QMD.
Each numbered entry is one named R chunk; the details below are navigation notes.

01. Data loading and sample preparation  {r 01-data-and-sample}
    Load df_final.RData; restrict all analyses to eligible monogamous, different-gender couples; code gender, research area, partner status, meeting context, timing and similarity outcomes. Optional local Quarto setup helper.

02. Sample description and model variables  {r 02-sample-descriptives}
    National professoriate comparison; observed counts and missingness; relationship and partner characteristics; centered predictors and reference coding.

03. Estimation and output functions  {r 03-estimation-and-output-functions}
    Paths, cache and final supplement builder; analysis samples; imputation; HC3 linear models; Rubin pooling; contrasts and generalized eta-squared.

04. Main models and planned contrasts  {r 04-main-models-and-indirect-associations}
    Bivariate associations; occupational-homogamy Models 1, 4–5; overall and within-area gender contrasts; field-gap contrasts; meeting/timing associations and four planned indirect contrasts; multiplicity adjustments.

05. Diagnostics and sensitivity analyses  {r 05-diagnostics-and-sensitivity}
    Influence diagnostics and VIF; complete cases; exclusions; logistic models; omitted duration; continuous timing; corresponding indirect-association checks.

06. Exploratory partner-similarity models  {r 06-exploratory-partner-similarity}
    Models 8–16: topic and research-area similarity within academic couples; partner PhD status within non-academic couples; meeting/timing extensions; subgroup imputation; polynomial timing checks.

07. Tables, figures and supporting summaries  {r 07-tables-figures-and-sensitivity-summaries}
    Standardized coefficients and exploratory forests; model fit; omnibus tests; full timing sensitivities; main-reference sensitivity summaries; ordered S1 demographic panel specifications.

08. Results text and main figures  {r 08-results-and-main-figures}
    All 15 group comparisons; joint distribution tests and sensitivity checks; Tables 1–3; Figures 1–5; five Results sections with three exploratory subsections; shared report/Word Results builder.

09. Manuscript text and word count  {r 09-manuscript-text-and-word-count}
    Title, abstract, keywords, Discussion and Conclusion; resolve source prose; assemble manuscript body; count words excluding abstract and references.

10. Render manuscript and export files  {r 10-render-and-export}
    Export Markdown and editable Word; verify both editable Word tables; build six-table/seven-figure supplement and ZIP; emit only manuscript sections in the rendered report.

Maintenance: the unused four-category joint outcome model, its plots, duplicate partner-comparison exports, legacy descriptive composites, and unused external outlier script dependency have been removed. Current manuscript models and sensitivity specifications are retained.
-->

```{r 01-data-and-sample}
#| include: false

# load and prepare data ----
rm(list = ls()) # clean global environment
set.seed(2026) # set a seed for reproducibility

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)

project_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE), winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE))

setwd(project_dir)
load(Sys.getenv("HOMOGAMY_DATA_PATH", unset=file.path(project_dir,"data","df_final.RData")))

data <- data %>% select(participant_id, time_spent, research_area, research_area.factor, highest_rank, 
    highest_rank.factor, working, tenure_ever, tenure.factor, tenure_noocc.factor, doctoral_degree_year, 
    age_at_phd, birth_year, age, age_range, sex, sex.factor, gender, gender.factor, cis, sex_orientation_cp, 
    country_birth, country_birth.factor, birth_continent, country_living_final, race_ethnicity_white_only, 
    race_ethnicity_mixed, relationship_status, relationship_status.factor, nb_partners_since_phd, cp_gender.factor, 
    final_age_diff, cp_start_year, cp_start_age, cp_formation_timing, cp_duration, cp_living, cp_living.factor, 
    cp_edu, cp_edu.factor, cp_working, cp_occ, cp_occ.factor, partner_rank_c, partner_rank_c.factor, 
    partner_rank_p, partner_rank_p.factor, cp_topic_combined, cp_location_c, cp_location_p, meet_combined, 
    dual_career_program.factor, any_of("cp_meet.factor"))

# Optional: run configure_analysis_folder() manually only if local Quarto setup is needed.
configure_analysis_folder <- function(
  analysis_dir = project_dir
) {
  stopifnot(dir.exists(analysis_dir),
            file.exists(file.path(analysis_dir, "script_of_analyses.qmd")))
  config_file <- file.path(analysis_dir, "_quarto.yml")
  if (!file.exists(config_file) && file.exists(file.path(analysis_dir, "_quarto.yaml")))
    config_file <- file.path(analysis_dir, "_quarto.yaml")
  settings <- if (file.exists(config_file)) yaml::read_yaml(config_file) else list()
  if (is.null(settings)) settings <- list()
  if (!is.list(settings)) stop("The existing Quarto settings must be a YAML mapping.")
  original_settings <- settings
  if (!is.list(settings$project)) settings$project <- list()
  settings$project$type <- "default"
  settings$project$render <- list("script_of_analyses.qmd")
  settings$project[["execute-dir"]] <- "file"
  settings$project[["output-dir"]] <- NULL
  if (!file.exists(config_file) || !identical(settings, original_settings)) {
    if (file.exists(config_file)) {
      backup <- paste0(config_file, ".", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"), ".bak")
      if (!file.copy(config_file, backup)) stop("Could not back up the existing settings.")
    }
    yaml::write_yaml(settings, config_file)
  }
  message("Setup complete. Click Render on script_of_analyses.qmd.")
  invisible(config_file)
}

# sample selection and variable transformations ----
# Restrict every downstream sample before transformations, descriptives or imputation.
# Exclude multiple-partner/open/polyamorous, single/other and missing-status responses.
monogamous_status <- "One partner (monogamous relationship)"
n_before_analytic_exclusions <- nrow(data)
n_excluded_multiple_partners_input <- sum(as.character(data$relationship_status.factor)==
  "Multiple partners (polyamorous, open-relationships)",na.rm=TRUE)
n_excluded_single_other_missing_status <- sum(
  is.na(data$relationship_status.factor) |
    !(as.character(data$relationship_status.factor) %in% c(
      monogamous_status, "Multiple partners (polyamorous, open-relationships)")))
df <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(relationship_status.factor),as.character(relationship_status.factor)==monogamous_status) %>%
  mutate(relationship_status.factor=droplevels(relationship_status.factor))
stopifnot(nrow(df)>0L,all(as.character(df$relationship_status.factor)==monogamous_status))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cp_academic_couple = case_when(
      
      cp_occ.factor == "Academic research scientist" ~ "In Academic Couple",
      
      partner_rank_c %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) & cp_occ.factor == "Scientist employed outside of academia (e.g., in government, industry, NGOs, entrepreneur)"  ~ "In Academic Couple", 
      partner_rank_p %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ "In Academic Couple",
      
      is.na(cp_occ) ~ "NA partner's occupation",
      
      !is.na(cp_occ) ~ "In Non-Academic Couple",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cp_academic_couple = factor(
      cp_academic_couple,
      levels = c("In Academic Couple", "In Non-Academic Couple", "NA partner's occupation")))

n_before_partner_status_filter <- nrow(df)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cp_academic_couple = factor(cp_academic_couple,
                                levels = c("In Academic Couple",
                                           "In Non-Academic Couple"),
                                ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cp_academic_couple)) 
n_excluded_partner_academic_status <- n_before_partner_status_filter - nrow(df)

n_total <- nrow(df)
n_total

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cp_academic_couple_3g = case_when(
      cp_academic_couple == "In Academic Couple" ~
        "In Academic Couple",
      
      cp_academic_couple == "In Non-Academic Couple" &
        cp_edu.factor == "Doctorate degree" ~
        "In Non-Academic Couple (Partner has a PhD or doctorate)",
      
      cp_academic_couple == "In Non-Academic Couple" &
        cp_edu.factor != "Doctorate degree" ~
        "In Non-Academic Couple (Partner has no PhD or doctorate)",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    cp_academic_couple_3g = factor(
      cp_academic_couple_3g,
      levels = c(
        "In Non-Academic Couple (Partner has no PhD or doctorate)",
        "In Non-Academic Couple (Partner has a PhD or doctorate)",
        "In Academic Couple"
      )
    )
  )

table(df$cp_academic_couple[is.na(df$cp_edu.factor)], useNA = "ifany")

nrow(df %>% filter(is.na(gender.factor) & is.na(sex.factor))) # both missing = 0

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    gender.factor = dplyr::recode(
      gender.factor,
      "Man" = "Man",
      "Women" = "Woman"
    )
  )

df %>%
  group_by(sex.factor, gender.factor, cis) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(count))

n_excluded_cisgender <- sum(is.na(df$cis) | !(df$cis %in% TRUE))
df <- df %>%
  filter(cis == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    gender.factor = droplevels(gender.factor)
  )

nrow(df)
table(df$gender.factor, useNA = "ifany")

n_excluded_main_research_area <- sum(is.na(df$research_area.factor))
df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(research_area.factor))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cp_gender.factor = dplyr::recode(cp_gender.factor,
                                     "Man" = "Man",
                                     "Women" = "Woman"))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    sex_orientation_cp = case_when(
      
      is.na(gender.factor) & is.na(cp_gender.factor) ~ "Both genders are missing",
      
      !is.na(gender.factor) & is.na(cp_gender.factor) ~ "Only partner's gender is missing",
      is.na(gender.factor) & !is.na(cp_gender.factor) ~ "Only participant's gender is missing",
      
      gender.factor == "Man"   & cp_gender.factor == "Woman" ~ "Heterosexual",
      gender.factor == "Woman" & cp_gender.factor == "Man"   ~ "Heterosexual",
      
      gender.factor == "Man"   & cp_gender.factor == "Man"   ~ "Homosexual",
      gender.factor == "Woman" & cp_gender.factor == "Woman" ~ "Homosexual"
    ), 
    sex_orientation_cp = factor(sex_orientation_cp,
                                levels = c("Heterosexual","Homosexual", "Both genders are missing", "Only partner's gender is missing","Only participant's gender is missing")))

n_heterosexual <- nrow(df %>%  filter(sex_orientation_cp == "Heterosexual"))
n_homosexual <- nrow(df %>%  filter(sex_orientation_cp == "Homosexual"))
n_sexorientation_undetermined <- nrow(
  df %>% 
    filter(sex_orientation_cp %in% c(
      "Both genders are missing",
      "Only partner's gender is missing",
      "Only participant's gender is missing")))
n_sexorientation_undetermined
n_homosexual
n_heterosexual

# Historical row numbers no longer identify the same participants after the monogamy restriction.
# Recompute influence flags on this sample; optional explicit participant IDs are handled in cfg.
pre_heterosexual_flag_ids <- character(0)
# Restrict the analytic sample to current relationships coded as heterosexual.
# Unknown partner gender and same-gender relationships are excluded, not imputed.
n_excluded_nonheterosexual_or_unknown <- nrow(df)-n_heterosexual
df <- df %>% filter(sex_orientation_cp=="Heterosexual")
stopifnot(nrow(df)>0L,all(as.character(df$sex_orientation_cp)=="Heterosexual"))

# Each person is counted once, at the first failed filter in the existing order.
# This accounting check does not change sample selection or model estimation.
stopifnot(n_before_analytic_exclusions - nrow(df) == sum(
  n_excluded_single_other_missing_status, n_excluded_multiple_partners_input,
  n_excluded_partner_academic_status, n_excluded_cisgender,
  n_excluded_main_research_area, n_excluded_nonheterosexual_or_unknown))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(age),
    age_z = as.numeric(scale(age)))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(

      age_range %in% c("51-60", "61-70", "70+") ~ "> 50",    # older than 50
      TRUE ~ NA_character_                                   
    )
  )
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    age_range_4g = case_when(
      age_range %in% c("<= 30", "31-40") ~ "<= 40",   # 40 or younger
      age_range %in% c("41-50") ~ "41-50",           # between 41 and 50
      age_range %in% c("51-60") ~ "51-60",          # between 51 and 60
      age_range %in% c("61-70", "70+") ~ "> 60",   # older than 60

    )
  )
 
df <- df %>%

      research_area.factor %in% c("Humanities and Social Sciences") ~ "Hum&Soc",

df <- df %>%
  mutate(

    research_area_4g = factor(research_area_4g, levels = c("Engineering Sciences","Life Sciences","Hum&Soc Sciences","Natural Sciences")))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(

    research_area_3g = factor(research_area_3g, levels = c("Life Sciences","Hum&Soc Sciences","Nat&Eng Sciences")))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(

df <- df %>%

      TRUE ~ NA_character_

    highest_rank_binary = factor(highest_rank_binary, levels = c("Junior rank", "Senior rank")))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(

    ),

df <- df %>%
  mutate(

      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    age_at_phd_binary = factor(age_at_phd_binary, levels = c("< 30", "30+")))

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    is_single = factor(is_single, levels = c("Not Single", "Single/Other")))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cp_before_phd = case_when(

df$race_white_vs_mixed_nonwhite <- factor(

    )
  ),
  levels = c("White", "White-Mixed / Non-White"))

df$born_in_CH <- factor(

  levels = c("No", "Yes")
)

nrow(df)

df <- df %>% mutate(cp_area_similarity = factor(cp_topic_combined, levels = c("Different areas", "Different topics in same area",

df <- df %>% mutate(cp_workplace_similarity = case_when(cp_location_c %in% c("Another university abroad",

    "Same university/college", "Same faculty/department", "Same lab/group") ~ cp_location_p, TRUE ~ NA_character_), 
    cp_workplace_similarity = factor(cp_workplace_similarity, levels = c("Another university abroad", 
        "Another university in country", "Same university/college", "Same faculty/department", "Same lab/group")))

df <- df %>% mutate(partner_rank_combined = case_when(!is.na(partner_rank_c.factor) ~ partner_rank_c.factor, 
    is.na(partner_rank_c.factor) & !is.na(partner_rank_p.factor) ~ partner_rank_p.factor, (is.na(partner_rank_c) & 
        is.na(partner_rank_p)) & !is.na(cp_edu) & cp_edu < 8 ~ "No research nor PhD experience", TRUE ~ 
        NA_character_), partner_rank_combined = factor(partner_rank_combined, levels = c("No research nor PhD experience", 
    "PhD student", "Postdoctoral fellow / Assistant lecturer", "Lecturer / Assistant professor", "Senior lecturer / Associate professor", 
    "Professor / Director of research", "Dean / Institute Director")))

rank_levels <- c(
  "PhD student",
  "Postdoctoral fellow / Assistant lecturer",
  "Lecturer / Assistant professor",
  "Senior lecturer / Associate professor",
  "Professor / Director of research",
  "Dean / Institute Director"
)

df <- df %>% mutate(partner_rank_ord = factor(partner_rank_combined, levels = rank_levels, ordered = TRUE), 
    self_rank_ord = factor(highest_rank.factor, levels = rank_levels, ordered = TRUE))

df <- df %>% mutate(cp_rank_similarity = case_when(partner_rank_ord %in% rank_levels[1:2] ~ "Currently a PhD/Post-doc", 
    partner_rank_ord < self_rank_ord ~ "Lower professorship rank", partner_rank_ord == self_rank_ord ~ 
        "Same professorship rank", partner_rank_ord > self_rank_ord ~ "Higher professorship rank", TRUE ~ 
        NA_character_), cp_rank_similarity = factor(cp_rank_similarity, levels = c("Currently a PhD/Post-doc", 
    "Lower professorship rank", "Same professorship rank", "Higher professorship rank")))

table(df$highest_rank.factor, df$cp_rank_similarity, useNA = "ifany") # Rows are self rank; Columns are partner rank similarity

df <- df %>%
  mutate(cp_workplace_similarity_binary = case_when(
    cp_workplace_similarity %in% c("Same lab/group", "Same faculty/department", "Same university/college") ~ 1,
    cp_workplace_similarity %in% c("Another university abroad", "Another university in country") ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(cp_rank_similarity_binary = case_when(
    cp_rank_similarity %in% c("Same professorship rank", "Higher professorship rank") ~ 1,
    cp_rank_similarity %in% c("Currently a PhD/Post-doc", "Lower professorship rank") ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(cp_area_similarity_binary = case_when(
    cp_area_similarity == "Same/similar topics(s)" ~ 1,
    cp_area_similarity %in% c("Different areas", "Different topics in same area") ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

# table-1-additions ----
# Additional displayed variables; the original recodes above are retained.
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    age_similarity = factor(case_when(
      is.na(final_age_diff) ~ NA_character_,
      abs(final_age_diff) < 3 ~ "0-2 years",
      TRUE ~ "3+ years"), levels = c("3+ years", "0-2 years")),
    partner_education_nonacademic = factor(case_when(
      cp_academic_couple == "In Academic Couple" ~ "Not applicable",
      is.na(cp_edu.factor) ~ NA_character_,
      cp_edu.factor == "Doctorate degree" ~ "Partner has a doctorate",
      TRUE ~ "Partner has no doctorate"),
      levels = c("Partner has no doctorate", "Partner has a doctorate", "Not applicable")),
    partner_topic_academic = factor(case_when(
      cp_academic_couple != "In Academic Couple" ~ "Not applicable",
      TRUE ~ as.character(cp_area_similarity)),
      levels = c("Different areas", "Different topics in same area", "Same/similar topics(s)", "Not applicable"))
  )
```

# Counts without the /N denominator in the displayed cells.
fmt_np <- function(n, denominator) {
  pct <- 100 * n / denominator
  ifelse(
    is.na(pct) | !is.finite(pct),
    "\u2014",
    sprintf("%d (%.2f%%)", n, pct)
  )
}
fmt_percent <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.2f%%", x))
}
median_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}
min_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}
max_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}
fmt_median <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%g", x))
}
fmt_sample_age <- function(median_age, min_age, max_age) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(median_age), "\u2014",
    sprintf("%g (min: %g; max: %g)", median_age, min_age, max_age)
  )
}

# table1 ----
# Table 2 uses the original observed sample; missing values appear for every item.
table1_levels <- c("Hum&Soc Sciences", "Life Sciences", "Nat&Eng Sciences")
table1_rows <- function(z) {
  rows <- list()
  put <- function(label, value, indent=0L) {
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <<- data.frame(Characteristic=label, Indent=indent, Value=value)
  }
  np <- function(n, denom) if (denom > 0) sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)",n,100*n/denom) else paste0(n," (—)")
  count <- function(mask) sum(mask,na.rm=TRUE)
  continuous <- function(v,label) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z[[v]])))
    put(label, if (sum(!is.na(x))) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)",mean(x,na.rm=TRUE),sd(x,na.rm=TRUE)) else "—")
    put("Missing, n",sum(is.na(x)),1)
  }
  categorical <- function(v,label,values) {
    x <- as.character(z[[v]]); put(label,"")
    for (a in values) put(a,np(count(x==a),sum(!is.na(x))),1)
    put("Missing, n",sum(is.na(x)),1)
  }
  academic <- z$cp_academic_couple == "In Academic Couple"
  nonacademic <- z$cp_academic_couple == "In Non-Academic Couple"
  topic <- as.character(z$partner_topic_academic); edu <- as.character(z$cp_edu.factor)
  known_topic <- topic %in% c("Same/similar topics(s)","Different topics in same area","Different areas")
  phd <- edu == "Doctorate degree"
  master <- !is.na(edu) & !phd & grepl("master|professional",edu,ignore.case=TRUE)
  put("Occupational homogamy with the current partner","")
  put("In academic couple",np(count(academic),nrow(z)),1)
  put("Same/similar research topics",np(count(academic & topic=="Same/similar topics(s)"),count(academic)),2)
  put("Different research topics",np(count(academic & topic %in% c("Different topics in same area","Different areas")),count(academic)),2)
  put("In the same research area",np(count(academic & topic=="Different topics in same area"),count(academic)),3)
  put("In different research areas",np(count(academic & topic=="Different areas"),count(academic)),3)
  put("Missing topic information, n",count(academic & !known_topic),2)
  put("In non-academic couple",np(count(nonacademic),nrow(z)),1)
  put("Partner has a PhD",np(count(nonacademic & phd),count(nonacademic)),2)
  put("Partner has no PhD",np(count(nonacademic & !phd),count(nonacademic)),2)
  put("Master's or professional degree",np(count(nonacademic & master),count(nonacademic)),3)
  put("Below master's/professional degree",np(count(nonacademic & !phd & !master),count(nonacademic)),3)
  put("Missing partner education, n",count(nonacademic & is.na(edu)),2)
  put("Missing occupational homogamy, n",sum(is.na(z$cp_academic_couple)),1)
  # Supplementary demographics: keep source coding and the same levels in every column.
  demographic_levels <- function(v) {
    x <- df[[v]]
    if (is.factor(x)) levels(x) else sort(unique(as.character(x[!is.na(x)])))
  }
  categorical("highest_rank_4g", "Highest academic rank attained", demographic_levels("highest_rank_4g"))
  categorical("birth_continent", "Region/continent of birth", demographic_levels("birth_continent"))
  continuous("age","Age, years: M (SD)")
  continuous("age_at_phd","Age at PhD completion, years: M (SD)")
  continuous("cp_start_age","Age at relationship formation, years: M (SD)")
  continuous("timing_relationship_phd_continuous","Relationship formation minus PhD completion, years: M (SD)")
  categorical("timing_relationship_phd_4g","Relationship formation relative to PhD completion",c(
    "5 years or more before PhD completion year","Less than 5 years before or during PhD completion year",
    "1 to 5 years after PhD completion year","More than 5 years after PhD completion year"))
  categorical("meet_combined_3g","Meeting context",c("Other","At work or in work-related contexts","At School/University as students"))
  continuous("cp_duration","Relationship duration, years: M (SD)")
  continuous("final_age_diff","Partner minus participant age, years: M (SD)")
  categorical("final_age_diff_3g","Age difference",c("3+ years younger","Similar age (difference of 0-2 years)","3+ years older"))
  do.call(rbind,rows)
}
table1_data <- table1_rows(df)[,c("Characteristic","Indent")]
table1_headings <- list()
for (g in c("Man","Woman")) {
  z <- df[df$gender.factor %in% g,,drop=FALSE]
  key <- if(g=="Man") "Total_Men" else "Total_Women"
  table1_data[[key]] <- table1_rows(z)$Value
  table1_headings[[key]] <- gt::html(paste0("<strong>",if(g=="Man") "Men total" else "Women total",
    "<br>N = ",nrow(z),"</strong>"))
}
table1_status <- c(academic="In Academic Couple",nonacademic="In Non-Academic Couple")
table1_status_labels <- c(academic="Academic couples",nonacademic="Non-academic couples")
table1_status_columns <- list()
for (status in names(table1_status)) {
  table1_status_columns[[status]] <- character(0)
  for (g in c("Man","Woman")) for (i in seq_along(table1_levels)) {
    take <- df$cp_academic_couple %in% table1_status[status] &
      df$research_area_3g %in% table1_levels[i] & df$gender.factor %in% g
    z <- df[take,,drop=FALSE]
    key <- paste0(status,"_area",i,"_",g)
    rows <- table1_rows(z)
    # A dash marks outcome details that do not apply to this couple group.
    inapplicable <- if(status=="academic") c("In non-academic couple","Partner has a PhD",
      "Partner has no PhD","Master's or professional degree","Below master's/professional degree",
      "Missing partner education, n") else c("In academic couple","Same/similar research topics",
      "Different research topics","In the same research area","In different research areas",
      "Missing topic information, n")
    rows$Value[rows$Characteristic %in% inapplicable] <- "—"
    table1_data[[key]] <- rows$Value
    table1_headings[[key]] <- gt::html(paste0(table1_levels[i],"<br>N = ",nrow(z)))
    table1_status_columns[[status]] <- c(table1_status_columns[[status]],key)
  }
}
table1_note <- paste("Values are n (%) or M (SD). Columns are grouped by couple status, gender and research area.",
  "The bold Men total and Women total columns describe the full sample within each gender. Occupational-status percentages use the full column sample.",
  "Topic subrows use the number of academic couples; education subrows use the number of non-academic couples within the column.",
  "Other categorical percentages use observed responses. Missing counts are shown separately. A dash indicates an inapplicable subgroup.",
  "Additional demographics comprise highest academic rank attained and region/continent of birth, using their recorded categories.")
# Split the existing rows without changing counts or subgroup denominators.
occupational_rows <- seq_len(match("Missing occupational homogamy, n", table1_data$Characteristic))

table_s1_1_data <- table1_data[-occupational_rows, , drop=FALSE]
# Reorder whole variable blocks, retaining each category and its missing-count row.
characteristic_order <- c(
  "Meeting context",
  "Relationship formation relative to PhD completion",
  "Relationship formation minus PhD completion, years: M (SD)",
  "Age, years: M (SD)",
  "Age at PhD completion, years: M (SD)",
  "Age at relationship formation, years: M (SD)",
  "Relationship duration, years: M (SD)",
  "Partner minus participant age, years: M (SD)",
  "Age difference",
  "Highest academic rank attained",
  "Region/continent of birth")
block_start <- which(table_s1_1_data$Indent == 0L)
block_end <- c(block_start[-1L] - 1L, nrow(table_s1_1_data))
block_names <- table_s1_1_data$Characteristic[block_start]
stopifnot(setequal(characteristic_order, block_names))
ordered_rows <- unlist(lapply(match(characteristic_order, block_names),
  function(i) seq.int(block_start[i], block_end[i])), use.names=FALSE)
table_s1_1_data <- table_s1_1_data[ordered_rows, , drop=FALSE]
make_s1_table <- function(dat, title, note) {
  out <- gt::gt(dat) %>%
    gt::cols_hide(columns=Indent) %>% gt::cols_label(.list=table1_headings) %>%
    gt::tab_header(title=title) %>% gt::tab_source_note(note) %>%
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size=gt::px(11),data_row.padding=gt::px(4),container.overflow.x="auto")
  for (status in names(table1_status)) {
    for (g in c("Man","Woman")) out <- out %>%
      gt::tab_spanner(label=ifelse(g=="Man","Men","Women"),id=paste0(status,"_",g),level=1,
        columns=all_of(paste0(status,"_area",seq_along(table1_levels),"_",g)))
    out <- out %>% gt::tab_spanner(label=table1_status_labels[status],
      id=paste0(status,"_status"),level=2,columns=all_of(table1_status_columns[[status]]))
  }
  for (depth in 1:3) out <- out %>%
    gt::tab_style(style=gt::cell_text(indent=gt::px(depth*14)),
      locations=gt::cells_body(columns=Characteristic,rows=dat$Indent==depth))
  out %>% gt::tab_style(style=gt::cell_text(weight="bold"),
    locations=gt::cells_body(columns=Characteristic,rows=dat$Indent==0)) %>%
    gt::tab_style(style=gt::cell_text(weight="bold"),
      locations=list(gt::cells_body(columns=all_of(c("Total_Men","Total_Women"))),gt::cells_column_labels(columns=all_of(c("Total_Men","Total_Women")))))
}
gt_table_main <- make_s1_table(table_s1_1_data,
  "Table S2. Participant and current relationship characteristics",

Same-area and different-area subrows subdivide different research topics. Missing counts are shown separately; a dash indicates an inapplicable subgroup.")

table1_formation_note <- paste(

  "Timing categories are displayed in Figure S1. Natural and Engineering Sciences are combined.")

Age-difference categories supplement the continuous measures in Supplementary Table S2. Categorical percentages use observed responses; missing counts are shown separately.")

```{r 03-estimation-and-output-functions}
#| include: false

# three-model-settings ----
required <- c("mice", "mitml", "sandwich", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "knitr", "digest")
absent <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(absent)) stop("Install required packages: install.packages(c(",
                         paste(sprintf('"%s"', absent), collapse = ", "), "))")
library(ggplot2)
options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))
cfg <- list(
  output_dir = file.path(dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE), winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE)), "Outputs"),
  m = 50L,
  maxit = 20L,
  seed = 2026L,
  alpha = .05,
  # Your original age-difference covariate: similar age (0-2 years) vs 3+ years.
  age_difference = "binary_original",
  # Optional: participant IDs of the original two flagged cases. Do not enter
  flagged_participant_ids = character(0),
  save_private_analysis_data = FALSE
)
stopifnot(cfg$m >= 2L, cfg$maxit >= 2L)
dir.create(cfg$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cache_dir <- file.path(cfg$output_dir, "private_cache")
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
main_dir <- file.path(cfg$output_dir, "Main_Manuscript")
supp_dir <- file.path(cfg$output_dir, "Supplementary_Files")
sens_dir <- file.path(supp_dir, "Sensitivity_Analyses")
for (p in c(main_dir, supp_dir)) dir.create(p, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
previous_supp <- list.files(supp_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
previous_supp <- previous_supp[grepl("^(Figure_S[0-9]+\\.png|(S10|S[1-9])_.*\\.(html|csv|png)|Supplementary_index\\.(html|csv)|Session_info\\.txt)$",
  basename(previous_supp))]
if (length(previous_supp)) {
  previous_dir <- tempfile("previous_supplement_", tmpdir = cache_dir)
  dir.create(previous_dir)
  for (f in previous_supp) {
    relative <- substring(f, nchar(supp_dir) + 2L)
    target <- file.path(previous_dir, relative)
    dir.create(dirname(target), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    if (!file.rename(f, target)) stop("Could not archive previous generated supplement: ", basename(f))
  }
}
set.seed(cfg$seed)
field_levels <- c("Hum&Soc Sciences", "Life Sciences", "Nat&Eng Sciences")
meeting_levels <- c("Other", "Work-related", "School/university")
timing_levels <- c("5+ years before PhD", "<5 years before/during PhD",
                   "1-5 years after PhD", ">5 years after PhD")
vlabels <- c(gender_c = "Gender", research_area_3g = "Research area",
  cp_academic_couple_c = "Occupational homogamy", meet_combined_3g = "Meeting context",
  timing_relationship_phd_4g = "Formation timing", age_c = "Age",
  age_homogamous_c = "Age similarity", cp_duration_c = "Relationship duration")
bind <- function(x) { x <- Filter(Negate(is.null), x); if (!length(x)) data.frame() else do.call(rbind, x) }
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
fmt <- function(x, digits = 1) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
fp <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "not estimable", ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", paste0("= ", sub("^0", "", fmt(p, 3)))))
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", as.character(x), fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE); gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
tab <- function(x, caption = NULL, digits = 3) {
  for (nm in intersect(c("p", "p_holm", "p_raw"), names(x)))
    if (is.numeric(x[[nm]])) x[[nm]] <- ifelse(is.na(x[[nm]]), "", ifelse(x[[nm]] < .001, "< .001", fmt(x[[nm]], 3)))
  cat(as.character(knitr::kable(x, format = "html", digits = digits,
                                caption = caption, row.names = FALSE,
                                escape = !isTRUE(attr(x, "html_cells")))), "\n\n")
}
export_paths <- character(0)
register_export <- function(path) {
  root <- normalizePath(cfg$output_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  export_paths <<- unique(c(export_paths, substring(path, nchar(root) + 2L)))
  invisible(path)
}
supp_items <- list()
is_supplement <- function(folder) identical(folder, supp_dir) || identical(folder, sens_dir)
add_supplement <- function(key, title, content, note = "") {
  supp_items[[key]] <<- list(title = title, content = content, note = note)
  invisible(key)
}
save_gt_table <- function(x, path) {
  if (is_supplement(dirname(path))) {
    key <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path))
    add_supplement(key, gsub("_", " ", key), gt::as_raw_html(x, inline_css = TRUE))
  } else {
    gt::gtsave(x, path); register_export(path)
  }
}
write_csv <- function(x, name, folder = supp_dir) {
  if (is_supplement(folder)) return(invisible(x)) # table is already embedded
  write.csv(x, file.path(folder, name), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  register_export(file.path(folder, name))
}
embed_supplement_plot <- function(path, name) {
  key <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(name)
  add_supplement(key, gsub("_", " ", key),
    paste0('<img alt="', esc(gsub("_", " ", key)), '" src="', knitr::image_uri(path), '">'))
}
save_plot <- function(p, name, folder = supp_dir, width = 10, height = 6) {
  supplemental <- is_supplement(folder)
  path <- if (supplemental) tempfile(fileext = ".png") else file.path(folder, name)
  if (supplemental) on.exit(unlink(path), add = TRUE)
  ggplot2::ggsave(path, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  if (supplemental) embed_supplement_plot(path, name) else register_export(path)
}
save_imputation_trace <- function(imp, name) {
  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  on.exit(unlink(path), add = TRUE)
  png(path, width = 1600, height = 1000, res = 150)
  tryCatch(print(plot(imp)), finally = dev.off())
  embed_supplement_plot(path, name)
}
html_table <- function(x, title, note = "") {
  paste0("<!doctype html><html><meta charset='utf-8'><title>", esc(title),
    "</title><style>body{font:15px Arial;max-width:1500px;margin:35px auto;padding:0 22px}",
    "table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin:18px 0}td,th{padding:6px 9px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}",
    "th{background:#edf3f7}h1{font-size:25px}p{line-height:1.5}</style><h1>", esc(title), "</h1><p>", esc(note),
    "</p>", as.character(knitr::kable(x, format = "html", digits = 4, row.names = FALSE,
      escape = !isTRUE(attr(x, "html_cells")))), "</html>")
}
save_table <- function(x, name, title, note = "", folder = supp_dir) {
  if("eta2_generalized"%in%names(x)) {
    decision_p <- if("p_holm"%in%names(x))x$p_holm else if("p"%in%names(x))x$p else
      if("Omnibus_p"%in%names(x))x$Omnibus_p else rep(NA_real_,nrow(x))
    x$eta2_generalized <- ifelse(is.finite(x$eta2_generalized),fmt(x$eta2_generalized,3),"")
  }
  if (is_supplement(folder)) {
    add_supplement(name, title, as.character(knitr::kable(x, format = "html", digits = 4, row.names = FALSE,
      escape = !isTRUE(attr(x, "html_cells")))), note)
  } else {
    writeLines(html_table(x, title, note), file.path(folder, paste0(name, ".html")))
    register_export(file.path(folder, paste0(name, ".html")))
    write_csv(x, paste0(name, ".csv"), folder)
  }
}
write_supplement <- function() {
  # Reader-facing inventory: exactly four sections, six tables and seven figures.
  # Analysis caches and wording checks are not included in this document.
  items <- list()
  add_item <- function(section,kind,number,title,content,note="") {
    key <- paste0(kind,number)
    if(key%in%names(items))stop("Duplicate supplementary item: ",key)
    items[[key]] <<- list(section=section,kind=kind,number=number,title=title,content=content,note=note)
  }
  add_table <- function(section,number,title,x,note="",escape=TRUE) {
    if(!nrow(x))x <- data.frame(Status="No estimable results available")
    empty <- vapply(x,function(v)all(is.na(v) | !nzchar(as.character(v))),logical(1))
    x <- x[,!empty,drop=FALSE]
    if(escape)for(column in names(x))x[[column]] <- esc(as.character(x[[column]]))
    if("p"%in%names(x)) {
      numeric_p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]","",x$p)))
      significant <- !is.na(numeric_p) & numeric_p<cfg$alpha
      x$p[significant] <- paste0("<strong>",x$p[significant],"</strong>")
      if("Type"%in%names(x)) {
        omnibus <- significant & grepl("[Oo]mnibus|[Tt]est",x$Type)
        for(column in intersect(c("F","df1","df2","Generalized η²"),names(x))) {
          take <- omnibus & !is.na(x[[column]]) & nzchar(x[[column]])
          x[[column]][take] <- paste0("<strong>",x[[column]][take],"</strong>")
        }
      }
    }
    if("Status"%in%names(x)) {
      changed <- grepl("significance changed: TRUE",x$Status,fixed=TRUE)
      x$Status[changed] <- paste0("<strong>",x$Status[changed],"</strong>")
    }
    for(column in names(x))x[[column]][is.na(x[[column]]) | !nzchar(x[[column]])] <- "—"
    add_item(section,"Table",number,paste0("Table S",number,". ",title),
      as.character(knitr::kable(x,format="html",digits=3,row.names=FALSE,escape=FALSE)),note)
  }
  # Every merged result table uses one shared schema, not nested independent tables.
  result_row <- function(type,model="",term="",estimate="",F="",df1="",df2="",p="",adjustment="",eta="",status="") {
    data.frame(Type=type,Model=model,Term=term,`Estimate [95% CI]`=estimate,F=F,df1=df1,df2=df2,
      p=p,Adjustment=adjustment,`Generalized η²`=eta,Status=status,check.names=FALSE)
  }
  supp_eta_note <- gsub("Generalized eta-squared is displayed only for significant omnibus tests (using the reported p-value adjustment).",
    "Generalized eta-squared is reported for every estimable omnibus test, regardless of significance.",eta_note,fixed=TRUE)
  eta_cell <- function(q,p_value=q$p)if("eta2_generalized"%in%names(q) && is.finite(q$eta2_generalized))
      fmt(q$eta2_generalized,3) else ""
  contrast_rows <- function(z,type,model="",adjustment="Unadjusted",p_column="p",label_column="Contrast") {
    if(!nrow(z))return(NULL)
    bind(lapply(seq_len(nrow(z)),function(i) {
      q <- z[i,,drop=FALSE]
      label <- if(label_column%in%names(q))as.character(q[[label_column]]) else ""
      result_row(type,if(!nzchar(model) && "Model"%in%names(q))as.character(q$Model) else model,label,ci_pp(q),p=fp(q[[p_column]]),adjustment=adjustment)
    }))
  }
  # S1: the preserved reference-comparison data, not an overwritten gt object.
  add_table(1,1,"Sample composition and national comparison",national_comparison_data,
    "Study and national field classifications are not directly equivalent. Additional demographics are shown in Figure S1.",escape=FALSE)
  # S3: association strengths and signed one-predictor outcome associations.
  stopifnot(identical(as.character(assoc_mi$x),as.character(assoc_mi_intervals$x)),
    identical(as.character(assoc_mi$y),as.character(assoc_mi_intervals$y)))
  s3 <- data.frame(Analysis="Bivariate association",Variables=paste(assoc_mi$x,assoc_mi$y,sep=" × "),
    Measure=assoc_mi$measure,Estimate=fmt(assoc_mi$strength,3),
    CI=ifelse(is.finite(assoc_mi_intervals$lower) & is.finite(assoc_mi_intervals$upper),
      paste0("[",fmt(assoc_mi_intervals$lower,3),", ",fmt(assoc_mi_intervals$upper,3),"]"),"Not estimable"),F=fmt(assoc_mi$F,2),
    df1=fmt(assoc_mi$df1,0),df2=fmt(assoc_mi$df2,2),p=fp(assoc_mi$p),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  signed <- bind(list(baseline_bivariate,education_bivariate))
  if(nrow(signed))s3 <- rbind(s3,data.frame(Analysis="Signed outcome association",Variables=paste(signed$Outcome,signed$Variable,sep=" × "),
    Measure="b (percentage points per year)",Estimate=fmt(100*signed$estimate,3),
    CI=paste0("[",fmt(100*signed$lower,3),", ",fmt(100*signed$upper,3),"]"),F=fmt(signed$F,2),
    df1=fmt(signed$df1,0),df2=fmt(signed$df2,2),p=fp(signed$p),stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
  add_table(1,2,"Bivariate associations",s3,
    "r, point-biserial r and phi are signed; Cramér’s V and eta are unsigned. Effect strengths average imputations; F tests and p-values use HC3/Rubin pooling. Signed b coefficients are unstandardized. Association-strength 95% CIs use within-imputation bootstrap variances (400 resamples) and Rubin pooling, bounded to the measure’s theoretical range. These CIs are approximate; the p-values remain HC3/Rubin tests, not bootstrap tests. Significant p-values are bold. Tests are unadjusted.")
  # S4: estimates, omnibus tests, fit and planned contrasts share one long-form table.
  rows <- list()
  for(k in names(interaction_fits)) {
    z <- standardized_coefs[[k]]
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(z))) {
      q <- z[i,,drop=FALSE]
      if(q$term=="gender_c")q <- standardized_gender_marginal[[k]]
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Standardized coefficient",k,pretty_term(z$term[i]),
        paste0(fmt(q$estimate,3)," [",fmt(q$lower,3),", ",fmt(q$upper,3),"]"),p=fp(q$p),adjustment="Unadjusted")
    }
    z <- main_omnibus_tests[main_omnibus_tests$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(z))) {
      q <- z[i,,drop=FALSE]
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Omnibus test",k,q$Term,F=fmt(q$F,2),df1=fmt(q$df1,0),
        df2=fmt(q$df2,2),p=fp(q$p),adjustment="Unadjusted",eta=eta_cell(q))
    }
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Model fit",k,"N",as.character(nobs(interaction_fits[[k]][[1]])))
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Model fit",k,"R²",fmt(model_r_squared[k],3))
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Model fit",k,"Adjusted R²",fmt(model_adjusted_r_squared[k],3))
    a <- model_aicc_summary[model_aicc_summary$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Model fit",k,"AICc: mean [range]",paste0(fmt(a$AICc_mean,2)," [",fmt(a$AICc_min,2),", ",fmt(a$AICc_max,2),"]"))
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- contrast_rows(focal_results[[k]],"Planned gender/gap contrast",k,"Holm within named family","p_holm")
    z <- gender_gaps(interaction_fits[[k]],datasets);z$Contrast <- paste("Women minus men:",z$area)
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- contrast_rows(z,"Within-area gender contrast",k)
  }
  main_rows <- bind(rows)
  # S5: contrasts and tests only. No adjusted group/category probability estimates.
  rows <- list(contrast_rows(pairwise_all,"Six-group pairwise contrast","M1","Tukey across 15 comparisons","p_tukey"),
    contrast_rows(meeting_pairwise,"Meeting-context contrast","M2","Tukey across three comparisons","p_tukey","Category1"),
    contrast_rows(h3_outcome_support,"Combined circumstance–homogamy contrast","","Unadjusted","p","Category"))
  # Replace meeting labels with both categories so the comparison is explicit.
  meeting_display <- meeting_pairwise;meeting_display$Contrast <- paste(meeting_display$Category1,"minus",meeting_display$Category2)
  rows[[2]] <- contrast_rows(meeting_display,"Meeting-context contrast","M2","Tukey across three comparisons","p_tukey")
  for(k in names(av_variables)) {
    z <- formation_response_gender_gaps[formation_response_gender_gaps$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
    z$Contrast <- paste(z$setting,z$area,"women minus men",sep="; ")
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- contrast_rows(z,"Circumstance gender gap",k)
    z <- formation_response_gap_comparisons[formation_response_gap_comparisons$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
    z$Contrast <- paste(z$setting,paste("Nat&Eng minus",z$area),"men-minus-women gap",sep="; ")
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- contrast_rows(z,"Circumstance gap comparison",k)
    z <- av_distribution_contrasts[av_distribution_contrasts$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- contrast_rows(z,"Combined circumstance gap comparison",k)
    q <- av_response_tests[av_response_tests$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Joint categorical-distribution test",k,"Gender × research area",F=fmt(q$F,2),
      df1=fmt(q$df1,0),df2=fmt(q$df2,2),p=fp(q$p),adjustment="Unadjusted")
    {
      e <- response_category_eta[response_category_eta$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(e)))rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Category-specific omnibus effect size",k,e$Category[i],eta=fmt(e$eta2_generalized[i],3))
    }
  }
  combined_model_rows <- rbind(main_rows,bind(rows))
  # Continuous-timing omnibus tests belong here, not in the shorter sensitivity table.
  if(nrow(polynomial_tests)) {
    tt <- polynomial_tests[polynomial_tests$Specification=="Primary" &
      polynomial_tests$Association%in%c("Timing jointly","Highest-order timing term"),,drop=FALSE]
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(tt))) {
      q <- tt[i,,drop=FALSE]
      model <- if(q$Degree=="Cubic")cubic_timing else quadratic_timing
      eta <- ""
      if(is.null(model$error)) {
        fits <- if(q$Degree=="Linear")model$linear else model$fits
        terms <- polynomial_terms[[as.character(q$Degree)]]
        if(q$Association=="Highest-order timing term")terms <- tail(terms,1)
        eta <- fmt(mean_generalized_eta_block(fits,terms,model$datasets),3)
      }
      combined_model_rows <- rbind(combined_model_rows,result_row("Continuous timing omnibus test",q$Degree,q$Association,
        F=fmt(q$F,2),df1=fmt(q$df1,0),df2=fmt(q$df2,2),p=fp(q$p),adjustment="Unadjusted",eta=eta))
    }
  }
  distribution_rows <- main_table2_coefficients[main_table2_coefficients$Model%in%paste("Model",2:3),,drop=FALSE]
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(distribution_rows))) {
    q <- distribution_rows[i,,drop=FALSE]
    is_fit <- q$Predictor=="AICc"
    combined_model_rows <- rbind(combined_model_rows,result_row(
      if(is_fit)"Category-distribution model fit" else "Category-specific standardized coefficient",
      paste(q$Model,q$Outcome,sep=": "),
      paste(c(q$Category,q$Predictor)[nzchar(c(q$Category,q$Predictor))],collapse="; "),
      if(is_fit)q$`t/F (df)` else paste0(q$`Standardized β [95% CI]`,"; ",q$`t/F (df)`),
      p=q$p,adjustment=if(is_fit)"" else "Unadjusted"))
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(formation_all_tests))) {
    q <- formation_all_tests[i,,drop=FALSE]
    combined_model_rows <- rbind(combined_model_rows,result_row("Category-distribution omnibus test",
      paste("Model",q$Manuscript_model),q$Association,F=fmt(q$F,2),df1=fmt(q$df1,0),df2=fmt(q$df2,2),p=fp(q$p),adjustment="Unadjusted"))
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(timing_field_marginals))) {
    q <- timing_field_marginals[i,,drop=FALSE]
    combined_model_rows <- rbind(combined_model_rows,result_row("Supporting timing contrast","Model 3",
      paste(q$Area,"at least five years before vs. remaining categories"),
      paste0(fmt(100*(2*q$estimate-1),1)," [",fmt(100*(2*q$lower-1),1),", ",fmt(100*(2*q$upper-1),1),"]"),
      p=fp(q$Early_vs_remaining_p),adjustment="Unadjusted; equal gender weights"))
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(timing_field_comparisons))) {
    q <- timing_field_comparisons[i,,drop=FALSE]
    combined_model_rows <- rbind(combined_model_rows,result_row("Supporting timing field contrast","Model 3",
      paste(q$Area,"minus",q$Reference,"for formation at least five years before completion"),
      ci_pp(q),p=fp(q$p),adjustment="Unadjusted; equal gender weights"))
  }
  add_table(2,3,"Main-model estimates, fit, omnibus tests and contrasts",combined_model_rows,
    paste(table3_note,supp_eta_note,"All contrasts are differences in percentage points, not group probabilities. These models jointly predict the non-reference meeting/timing category indicators; each coefficient is labelled by its outcome category. Their AICc values are not comparable with occupational-homogamy AICc. Significant tests are bold; dashes indicate fields that do not apply. AICc ranges are between-imputation ranges, not CIs."))
  # Former main Table 2: retain five-column layout and significant-estimate emphasis.
  supplementary_model_table <- as.data.frame(lapply(main_table2,function(x)
    gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*","<strong>\\1</strong>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x)),perl=TRUE)),check.names=FALSE)
  add_table(2,6,"Models 1–5: standardized coefficients [95% CIs]",supplementary_model_table,main_table2_note)

  register_export(supplementary_model_path)
  # S6: one summary per diagnostic/model/sample; no 50-imputation listings.
  diagnostics <- rbind(mi_diag$summary,cc_diag$summary)
  vif <- bind(list(mi_diag$vif,cc_diag$vif))
  diagnostic_rows <- list()
  summarize_numeric <- function(z,group_columns,stat_columns,type) {
    if(!nrow(z))return(NULL)
    groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(z)),interaction(z[group_columns],drop=TRUE))
    bind(lapply(groups,function(idx)bind(lapply(stat_columns,function(stat) {
      v <- z[[stat]][idx];v <- v[is.finite(v)]
      data.frame(Type=type,Sample=as.character(z$Sample[idx[1]]),Model=as.character(z$Model[idx[1]]),
        Predictor=if("Term"%in%names(z))as.character(z$Term[idx[1]]) else "",Statistic=stat,
        Mean=if(length(v))mean(v) else NA_real_,Minimum=if(length(v))min(v) else NA_real_,Maximum=if(length(v))max(v) else NA_real_)
    }))))
  }
  diagnostic_rows[[1]] <- summarize_numeric(diagnostics,c("Sample","Model"),
    setdiff(names(diagnostics),c("Sample","Model","Imputation")),"Model diagnostic")
  if(nrow(vif))diagnostic_rows[[2]] <- summarize_numeric(vif,c("Sample","Model","Term"),
    names(vif)[vapply(vif,is.numeric,logical(1)) & names(vif)!="Imputation"],"VIF/GVIF")
  diag_summary <- bind(diagnostic_rows)
  diag_summary <- diag_summary[!diag_summary$Statistic%in%c("N","Df","Predictions_outside_0_1"),,drop=FALSE]
  diagnostic_records <- data.frame(Analysis="Diagnostic",Specification=paste(diag_summary$Model,diag_summary$Sample),
    Quantity=ifelse(nzchar(diag_summary$Predictor),paste(diag_summary$Predictor,diag_summary$Statistic,sep=": "),diag_summary$Statistic),
    `Estimate [95% CI]`=paste0(fmt(diag_summary$Mean,3)," [range ",fmt(diag_summary$Minimum,3),", ",fmt(diag_summary$Maximum,3),"]"),
    p="",Status="",check.names=FALSE)
  # S7: all sensitivity contrasts, indirect estimates, timing tests and failures.
  rows <- list()
  for(label in names(sensitivity_pairs)) {
    # The same exclusion estimates already appear against the primary model.
    # Do not display a duplicate comparison against complete cases.
    if(startsWith(label,"Exclusions within complete cases"))next
    z <- sensitivity_pairs[[label]]$alt
    z <- z[z$id%in%indirect_ids,,drop=FALSE]
    if(grepl("^(Linear|Quadratic|Cubic) timing:",label) && !grepl("Primary$",label)) {
      changed_ids <- sensitivity_summary$id[sensitivity_summary$Specification==label &
        !is.na(sensitivity_summary$Threshold_change) & sensitivity_summary$Threshold_change]
      z <- z[z$id%in%changed_ids,,drop=FALSE]
    }
    changes <- sensitivity_summary[sensitivity_summary$Specification==label,,drop=FALSE]
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(z))) {
      q <- z[i,,drop=FALSE];ch <- changes[changes$id==q$id,,drop=FALSE]
      reference_model <- if(grepl("M[123]$",label))sub(".*(M[123])$","\\1",label) else "M3"
      status <- if(nrow(ch))paste0("Reference: primary ",reference_model,
        "; absolute change = ",fmt(ch$Change_pp[1],2),
        " pp; significance changed: ",ch$Threshold_change[1]) else ""
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Sensitivity contrast",label,q$Contrast,ci_pp(q),p=fp(q$p_holm),adjustment="As specified for the contrast",status=status)
    }
  }
  indirect_compact <- indirect_sensitivity[indirect_sensitivity$Reference=="Primary",,drop=FALSE]
  polynomial_indirect <- grepl("^(Linear|Quadratic|Cubic) timing:",indirect_compact$Specification)
  keep_indirect <- !polynomial_indirect | grepl("Primary$",indirect_compact$Specification) |
    (!is.na(indirect_compact$Threshold_change) & indirect_compact$Threshold_change)
  indirect_compact <- indirect_compact[keep_indirect,,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(indirect_compact))for(i in seq_len(nrow(indirect_compact))) {
    q <- indirect_compact[i,,drop=FALSE]
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Indirect-association sensitivity",paste(q$Specification,q$Model),q$Contrast,ci_pp(q),
      p=fp(q$p_holm),adjustment="Holm across two field contrasts",status=paste0("Reference: ",q$Reference,"; change = ",fmt(q$Change_pp,2)," pp; significance changed: ",q$Threshold_change))
  }
  for(z in list(sensitivity_status,indirect_sensitivity_status,polynomial_status))if(nrow(z))for(i in seq_len(nrow(z))) {
    q <- z[i,,drop=FALSE]
    label <- if("Specification"%in%names(q))as.character(q$Specification) else ""
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Unavailable sensitivity analysis",label,status=as.character(q$Status))
  }
  sensitivity_records <- bind(rows)
  sensitivity_records <- data.frame(Analysis=sensitivity_records$Type,Specification=sensitivity_records$Model,
    Quantity=sensitivity_records$Term,`Estimate [95% CI]`=sensitivity_records$`Estimate [95% CI]`,
    p=sensitivity_records$p,Status=sensitivity_records$Status,check.names=FALSE)
  if(nrow(formation_sensitivity_tests))for(i in seq_len(nrow(formation_sensitivity_tests))) {
    q <- formation_sensitivity_tests[i,,drop=FALSE]
    sensitivity_records <- rbind(sensitivity_records,data.frame(Analysis="Category-distribution sensitivity",
      Specification=paste(q$Specification,q$Model),Quantity=q$Association,`Estimate [95% CI]`="",
      p=fp(q$p),Status=paste0("N = ",q$N,"; primary p ",fp(q$Primary_p),
        "; significance changed: ",q$Significance_changed),check.names=FALSE))
  }
  if(nrow(formation_sensitivity_failures))for(i in seq_len(nrow(formation_sensitivity_failures))) {
    q <- formation_sensitivity_failures[i,,drop=FALSE]
    sensitivity_records <- rbind(sensitivity_records,data.frame(Analysis="Unavailable category-distribution sensitivity",
      Specification=paste(q$Specification,q$Model),Quantity="",`Estimate [95% CI]`="",p="",Status=q$Status,check.names=FALSE))
  }
  if(nrow(logistic_coefficient_results))for(i in seq_len(nrow(logistic_coefficient_results))) {
    q <- logistic_coefficient_results[i,,drop=FALSE]
    sensitivity_records <- rbind(sensitivity_records,data.frame(Analysis="Logistic odds-ratio coefficient",
      Specification=q$Model,Quantity=pretty_term(q$term),
      `Estimate [95% CI]`=paste0(fmt(exp(q$estimate),3)," [",fmt(exp(q$lower),3),", ",fmt(exp(q$upper),3),"]"),
      p=fp(q$p),Status="Unadjusted supporting coefficient test",check.names=FALSE))
  }
  add_table(3,4,"Diagnostics and focused sensitivity analyses",rbind(diagnostic_records,sensitivity_records),
    "Diagnostics show mean [range] across imputations, not a 95% CI. Sensitivity estimates show percentage-point differences and 95% CIs. Only the two field-gap contrasts and corresponding indirect associations are retained. Standard complete-case, exclusion, logistic and omitted-duration checks are shown; for additional polynomial sensitivity variants, only primary specifications, changed significance conclusions and failures are shown. Internal cache keys M1, M2 and M3 correspond to manuscript Models 1, 4 and 5, respectively. All displayed changes and significance flags compare each sensitivity estimate with the corresponding main multiply imputed model (M1, M2 or M3), using the same multiplicity adjustment. Exclusion estimates are shown once, against that main model. Bold status identifies significance changed: TRUE. F, df and η² columns are omitted; continuous-timing omnibus tests are in Table S3. Main figures report the primary probabilities; alternative specifications are in Figures S3–S4.")
  # S8: exploratory tests, contrasts and covariate p-values, without probability rows.
  rows <- list()
  for(k in names(nested_models)) {
    z <- nested_models[[k]]
    if(!is.null(z$error)) {
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Unavailable exploratory model",k,status=z$error);next
    }
    tests <- dplyr::bind_rows(nested_overall_tests[[k]],z$tests)
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(tests))) {
      q <- tests[i,,drop=FALSE];adjusted <- q$Association=="Interaction"
      pv <- if(adjusted)q$p_holm else q$p
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Exploratory omnibus test",paste0(k," (n = ",z$N,")"),q$Association,
        F=fmt(q$F,2),df1=fmt(q$df1,0),df2=fmt(q$df2,2),p=fp(pv),
        adjustment=if(adjusted)"Holm across three outcomes" else "Unadjusted",eta=eta_cell(q,pv))
    }
    gap <- z$gaps;gap$Contrast <- paste("Women minus men:",gap$area)
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- contrast_rows(gap,"Exploratory within-area gender contrast",k,"Holm across three areas","p_holm")
    cv <- nested_covariate_results[nested_covariate_results$Outcome==k,,drop=FALSE]
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(cv)))rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- result_row("Covariate omnibus p-value",k,cv$term[i],p=fp(cv$p[i]),adjustment="Unadjusted")
  }

  if(nrow(phd_contrasts)) {

    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- contrast_rows(phd_contrasts,"Partner-education field contrast","PhD","Holm across two field comparisons","p_holm")
  }
  if(nrow(exploratory_extension_tests))for(i in seq_len(nrow(exploratory_extension_tests))) {

  }

      paste0(fmt(q$estimate,3)," [",fmt(q$lower,3),", ",fmt(q$upper,3),"]"),p=fp(q$p),adjustment="Unadjusted supporting test")

  # Generate the seven standalone supplementary PNGs and embed the same images.
  add_png <- function(section,number,title,draw,width=2800,height=1800,note="") {
    path <- file.path(supp_dir,paste0("Figure_S",number,".png"))
    grDevices::png(path,width=width,height=height,res=180,bg="white")
    tryCatch(draw(),finally=grDevices::dev.off())

      paste0('<img alt="',esc(title),'" src="',knitr::image_uri(path),'">'),note)
  }
  add_png(1,1,"Participant and partner characteristics, including totals",function() {
    e <- new.env(parent=environment(desc_base))
    total_groups <- expand.grid(Area=table1_levels,Gender=c("Man","Woman"),Status="Total",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    total_groups$row_y <- c(28,27,26,24,23,22)
    total_groups$N <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(total_groups)),function(i)
      sum(df$gender.factor%in%total_groups$Gender[i] & df$research_area_3g%in%total_groups$Area[i]),integer(1))
    total_groups$label <- paste0(total_groups$Area," · ",ifelse(total_groups$Gender=="Man","Men","Women")," (N = ",total_groups$N,")")
    e$desc_groups <- rbind(total_groups[,names(desc_groups)],desc_groups)
    stopifnot(nrow(total_groups)==6L,sum(total_groups$N)==nrow(df),nrow(e$desc_groups)==18L)
    e$df <- df;e$df$absolute_age_difference <- abs(num(df$final_age_diff))
    for(name in c("desc_subset","desc_base","desc_headers","left_desc_headers","make_desc_category","make_desc_continuous")) {
      f <- get(name,envir=environment(desc_base));environment(f) <- e;assign(name,f,envir=e)
    }
    is_academic <- e$df$cp_academic_couple%in%"In Academic Couple"
    is_nonacademic <- e$df$cp_academic_couple%in%"In Non-Academic Couple"
    topic_raw <- as.character(e$df$partner_topic_academic)
    education_raw <- as.character(e$df$partner_education_nonacademic)
    topic_observed <- is_academic & topic_raw%in%c("Same/similar topics(s)","Different topics in same area","Different areas")
    phd_observed <- is_nonacademic & education_raw%in%c("Partner has a doctorate","Partner has no doctorate")
    e$df$desc_partner_phd <- ifelse(phd_observed,
      ifelse(education_raw=="Partner has a doctorate","Yes","No"),NA_character_)
    e$df$desc_same_topic <- ifelse(topic_observed,
      ifelse(topic_raw=="Same/similar topics(s)","Yes","No"),NA_character_)
    e$df$desc_same_area <- ifelse(topic_observed,
      ifelse(topic_raw%in%c("Same/similar topics(s)","Different topics in same area"),"Yes","No"),NA_character_)
    similarity_spec <- function(v,label,yes,no)list(v=v,label=label,type="categorical",
      levels=c("Yes","No"),short=c(yes,no),palette=c("#398F87","#D5E5DF"))
    similarity_row <- list(
      similarity_spec("desc_partner_phd","Partner education\n(non-academic couples)","Partner with PhD","Partner without PhD"),
      similarity_spec("desc_same_topic","Research-topic similarity\n(academic couples)","Same/similar topics","Different topics"),
      similarity_spec("desc_same_area","Research-area similarity\n(academic couples)","Same research area","Different research areas"))
    demographic_rows <- c(supp_rows,list(similarity_row))
    groups_with_totals <- e$desc_groups
    tests <- bind(list(original_full_tests,similarity_test_table))
    caption_for <- function(sp) {
      variable <- if(sp$v=="age")"age_c" else if(sp$v=="final_age_diff")"absolute_age_difference" else sp$v
      label <- names(comparison_variables)[unname(comparison_variables)==variable]
      if(!length(label))return("")
      z <- tests[tests$Variable%in%label,,drop=FALSE]
      if(!nrow(z))return("")
      pretty <- c(gender_c="Gender",research_area_3g="Area",cp_academic_couple_c="Couple type",
        `Education within non-academic couples`="Education",`Topics within academic couples`="Topic similarity",
        `Research areas within academic couples`="Area similarity")
      names <- unname(pretty[z$Comparison]);names[is.na(names)] <- z$Comparison[is.na(names)]
      paste(paste0(names,": p ",fp(z$p)),collapse="; ")
    }
    grid::grid.newpage();grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout=grid::grid.layout(length(demographic_rows),1)))
    for(i in seq_along(demographic_rows)) {
      # Only the final similarity row omits the six Total groups.
      e$desc_groups <- if(i==length(demographic_rows))desc_groups else groups_with_totals
      panels <- lapply(seq_along(demographic_rows[[i]]),function(j) {
        sp <- demographic_rows[[i]][[j]]
        if(sp$v=="final_age_diff") {sp$v <- "absolute_age_difference";sp$label <- "Absolute partner age difference"}
        plot <- if(sp$type=="continuous")e$make_desc_continuous(sp,show_groups=j==1) else e$make_desc_category(sp,show_groups=j==1)
        annotation <- caption_for(sp)
        if(nzchar(annotation))plot <- plot+labs(caption=stringr::str_wrap(annotation,85))+
          theme(plot.caption=element_text(size=9,hjust=0))
        plot
      })
      grob <- e$left_desc_headers(patchwork::wrap_plots(panels,nrow=1,guides="keep"))
      grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout.pos.row=i,layout.pos.col=1));grid::grid.draw(grob);grid::popViewport()
    }
    grid::popViewport()
  },width=3600,height=max(2500,1600*(length(supp_rows)+1)),note="The first eight rows contain two panels each; the final row contains the three partner-similarity panels. Each demographic panel has eighteen subgroup rows: six Total sex-by-area groups, six academic-couple groups, and six non-academic-couple groups. Men precede women; area order is Hum&Soc, Life, Nat&Eng. Continuous values show observed M (SD) and ±1 SD; categorical values show observed n (%). Group Ns are in the labels. Missing values are excluded from descriptive denominators. Available unadjusted comparison p-values appear below the corresponding panels. Partner-education percentages use observed non-academic couples; topic and area percentages use observed academic couples. The partner-similarity row omits the six Total groups and retains the twelve couple-type × gender × area groups; inapplicable couple-type rows are blank. Detailed meeting context uses the original cp_meet.factor classification. Race/ethnicity uses the existing White versus White-Mixed / Non-White classification. This figure replaces the former descriptive table and the separate partner-similarity figure.")
  add_png(3,2,"Standard plot.lm diagnostics for M1–M3",function() {
    graphics::par(mfrow=c(6,6),mar=c(3.1,3.2,2.5,.6),oma=c(0,0,1,0),cex=.9)
    for(sample in c("Imputed","Complete cases"))for(k in names(interaction_fits)) {
      f <- if(sample=="Imputed")interaction_fits[[k]][[1]] else cc_models[[k]][[1]]
      class(f) <- setdiff(class(f),"ava_lm")
      for(which in 1:6)graphics::plot(f,which=which,main=paste(k,sample),id.n=0,ask=FALSE)
    }
  },width=6000,height=6000,note="Each row is one model/sample combination: M1–M3 from the first imputation, followed by M1–M3 complete-case fits. The six plot.lm columns are residuals versus fitted, Normal Q–Q, Scale–Location, Cook’s distance, residuals versus leverage, and Cook’s distance versus leverage/(1−leverage). These plots are descriptive for a binary-outcome linear probability model; numerical diagnostics are summarized in Table S4.")
  add_png(3,3,"Adjusted probabilities across sensitivity specifications",function() {
    z <- sensitivity_plot_predictions
    if(!nrow(z)) {graphics::plot.new();graphics::text(.5,.5,"Sensitivity predictions unavailable");return(invisible(NULL))}
    z$gender <- factor(z$gender,levels=c("Men","Women"));z$area <- factor(z$area,levels=field_levels)
    dodge <- position_dodge(width=.7)
    plot <- ggplot(z,aes(area,estimate,colour=Specification,group=Specification))+
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper),position=dodge,width=.12)+geom_point(position=dodge,size=2)+
      facet_grid(gender~Model)+scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x)paste0(round(100*x),"%"))+
      labs(x="Research area",y="Adjusted probability of occupational homogamy",colour="Sensitivity specification")+
      theme_minimal(base_size=13)+theme(legend.position="bottom",axis.text.x=element_text(angle=20,hjust=1),
        strip.text.x=element_text(size=18,face="bold"),strip.text.y=element_text(size=18,face="bold"),
        panel.spacing.y=grid::unit(1.2,"lines"))
    grob <- ggplotGrob(plot)
    panel_rows <- sort(unique(grob$layout$t[grepl("^panel",grob$layout$name)]))
    if(length(panel_rows)==2L) {
      gap <- panel_rows[1]+1L
      grob <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(grob,grid::linesGrob(x=grid::unit(c(0,1),"npc"),
        y=grid::unit(c(.5,.5),"npc"),gp=grid::gpar(col="#8A929A",lwd=1.2)),
        t=gap,l=min(grob$layout$l[grepl("^panel",grob$layout$name)]),
        r=max(grob$layout$r[grepl("^panel",grob$layout$name)]),clip="off",name="sex-panel-separator")
    }
    grid::grid.newpage();grid::grid.draw(grob)
  },width=3200,height=2100,note="Only alternative specifications are plotted; primary M1–M3 probabilities remain in the main figures. Pointwise HC3/Rubin 95% CIs use each specification’s sample and covariate distribution.")
  add_png(3,4,"Continuous timing curves",function() {
    curves <- bind(lapply(c("Linear","Quadratic","Cubic"),function(degree) {
      if(degree=="Linear") {
        if(!is.null(quadratic_timing$error))return(NULL)
        a <- quadratic_timing
        z <- bind(lapply(a$curve$Timing_years,function(t)cbind(Timing_years=t,
          pool_contrast(a$linear,a$datasets,list(list(timing_years_c=(t-a$center)/10)),1))))
        z$Degree <- degree;return(z)
      }
      a <- if(degree=="Quadratic")quadratic_timing else cubic_timing
      if(!is.null(a$error))return(NULL)
      z <- a$curve;z$Degree <- degree;z
    }))
    if(!nrow(curves)) {graphics::plot.new();graphics::text(.5,.5,"Timing curves unavailable");return(invisible(NULL))}
    print(ggplot(curves,aes(Timing_years,estimate))+
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper),fill="#40678F",alpha=.18)+geom_line(colour="#40678F",linewidth=.8)+
      geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype="dotted")+facet_wrap(~Degree,nrow=1)+
      scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x)paste0(round(100*x),"%"))+
      labs(x="Relationship formation relative to PhD completion (years)",y="Adjusted probability of occupational homogamy")+theme_minimal(base_size=12))
  },width=3000,height=1400,note="Primary linear, quadratic and cubic continuous-timing sensitivity curves with pointwise 95% CIs. Tests and other timing specifications are in Tables S3–S4.")
  add_png(4,5,"Standardized coefficients for exploratory partner-similarity models",function() {

    z$stars <- p_stars(z$p)

      geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype="dashed",colour="#8A929A")+
      geom_segment(aes(x=lower,xend=upper,yend=Predictor),linewidth=.6,colour="#40678F")+

      geom_text(aes(label=stars),nudge_y=.23,size=4.2,colour="#243746")+
      facet_wrap(~Outcome,ncol=1,drop=FALSE)+

      theme_minimal(base_size=13)+theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),

        panel.spacing.y=grid::unit(1.5,"lines"),plot.margin=margin(14,20,14,14)))
  },width=3300,height=3300,note="Exploratory M1 specifications include gender × research area, age, age similarity and relationship duration. Every non-intercept coefficient is shown, including covariates and interactions. Coefficients are standardized by SD(design column)/SD(outcome) within each imputation; scaled HC3 variances and estimates are then Rubin-pooled. Gender is the women–men coefficient in the reference field (Humanities & Social Sciences); field coefficients are at gender = 0 under effect coding. Interactions use their own design-column SDs. Pointwise 95% CIs and unadjusted coefficient tests: * p < .05; ** p < .01; *** p < .001. No significant-test screening is applied. Adjusted probabilities appear in main Figures 4–5.")
  add_png(4,6,"Continuous-timing sensitivity curves for exploratory similarity outcomes",function() {
    curves <- bind(lapply(names(nested_extensions),function(key) {
      z <- nested_extensions[[key]]
      if(!is.null(z$error) || !z$specification%in%c("Linear","Quadratic","Cubic"))return(NULL)
      cbind(Outcome=z$outcome,Degree=z$specification,z$curve)
    }))
    if(!nrow(curves)) {graphics::plot.new();graphics::text(.5,.5,"Timing curves unavailable");return(invisible(NULL))}
    curves$Degree <- factor(curves$Degree,levels=c("Linear","Quadratic","Cubic"))
    print(ggplot(curves,aes(Timing_years,estimate))+
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper),fill="#174A75",alpha=.15)+
      geom_line(color="#174A75",linewidth=.8)+facet_grid(Outcome~Degree)+
      scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x)paste0(round(100*x),"%"))+
      labs(x="Formation relative to PhD completion (years)",y="Adjusted probability of partner similarity")+
      theme_minimal(base_size=14))
  },width=3600,height=2800,note="Separate linear, quadratic and cubic continuous-timing specifications for topic and area similarity in academic couples, and partner PhD status in non-academic couples. Models include gender × area and baseline covariates; curves cover the central 95% of timing values. Shading shows pointwise HC3/Rubin 95% CIs. Tests and coefficients are in Table S5.")
  add_png(3,7,"Logistic sensitivity: odds ratios",function() {
    z <- logistic_coefficient_results
    if(!nrow(z)) {graphics::plot.new();graphics::text(.5,.5,"Logistic coefficient estimates unavailable");return(invisible(NULL))}
    z$Predictor <- factor(z$term,levels=rev(unique(z$term)),labels=stringr::str_wrap(pretty_term(rev(unique(z$term))),44))
    print(ggplot(z,aes(exp(estimate),Predictor))+
      geom_vline(xintercept=1,linetype="dashed",color="#888888")+
      geom_segment(aes(x=exp(lower),xend=exp(upper),yend=Predictor),color="#174A75")+
      geom_point(color="#174A75",size=2.5)+scale_x_log10()+facet_wrap(~Model,ncol=1,scales="free_y")+
      labs(x="Odds ratio and pointwise 95% CI (log scale)",y=NULL)+theme_minimal(base_size=13))
  },width=3200,height=3600,note="Logistic versions of occupational-homogamy Models 1, 4–5, with HC3/Rubin-pooled log-odds coefficients exponentiated to odds ratios. All non-intercept coefficients are shown without significance screening. The gender coefficient refers to Humanities & Social Sciences. Marginal probability contrasts and indirect associations are reported separately in Table S4.")
  stopifnot(sum(vapply(items,function(x)x$kind=="Table",logical(1)))==6L,
    sum(vapply(items,function(x)x$kind=="Figure",logical(1)))==7L)
  sections <- c("Sample and unadjusted associations","Main models and relationship formation",
    "Diagnostics and sensitivity analyses","Educational, topic and area similarity")
  body <- vapply(seq_along(sections),function(section) {
    z <- items[vapply(items,function(x)x$section==section,logical(1))]
    if(section==1L)z <- z[intersect(c("Table1","Figure1","Figure2","Table2"),names(z))]
    content <- paste(vapply(z,function(x)paste0('<article id="',tolower(x$kind),'S',x$number,'"><h3>',esc(x$title),
      '</h3><div class="content">',x$content,'</div><p class="note">',esc(x$note),'</p></article>'),character(1)),collapse="\n")
    paste0('<section id="section',section,'"><h2>',section,'. ',esc(sections[section]),'</h2>',content,'</section>')
  },character(1))
  toc <- paste0('<li><a href="#section',seq_along(sections),'">',seq_along(sections),'. ',esc(sections),'</a></li>',collapse="")
  html <- paste0('<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Supplementary material</title>',
    '<style>body{font:15px Arial,sans-serif;color:#243746;max-width:1400px;margin:35px auto;padding:0 24px;line-height:1.5}',
    'h2{border-bottom:2px solid #cbd7df;padding-top:28px}h3{font-size:17px}article{margin:24px 0 36px}.note{font-size:12px;color:#52616d}',
    '.content{overflow-x:auto}img{max-width:100%;height:auto}table{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;width:100%}',
    'td,th{padding:6px 9px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}th{background:#f0f4f7}a{color:#315c80}</style></head><body>',
    '<h1>Supplementary material</h1><p>Four sections, six tables and seven figures. Adjusted group probabilities are shown only in figures. Contrasts are reported as differences.</p>',
    '<nav><ol>',toc,'</ol></nav><p>Internal analysis keys M1, M2 and M3 in this supplement denote manuscript Models 1, 4 and 5 (occupational homogamy), respectively. Manuscript Models 2–3 describe the category distributions; Models 6–7 label indirect-association calculations.</p><p><strong>Manuscript reference guide:</strong> Sample: Table S1 and Figure S1. Bivariate associations: Table S2. M1–M3, model fit, the 15 comparisons and meeting/timing contrasts: Table S3. Standardized coefficients for Models 1–5: Table S6. Diagnostics and sensitivity: Table S4 and Figures S2–S4 and S7. Educational, topic and area similarity: Table S5 and Figures S5–S6.</p>',paste(body,collapse="\n"),'</body></html>')
  count_tables <- gregexpr('<table[ >]',html,perl=TRUE)[[1]]
  stopifnot(length(count_tables)==6L,count_tables[1]>0)
  path <- file.path(supp_dir,"Supplementary_Material.html")
  writeLines(html,path);register_export(path)
}
