```{r 03-estimation-and-output-functions}
# three-model-estimation-functions ----
vcov.ava_lm <- function(object, ...) object$ava_vcov
fit_lpm <- function(formula, dat) {
  f <- lm(formula, data = dat, na.action = na.fail)
  if (anyNA(coef(f)) || df.residual(f) <= 5) stop("Unestimable model: inspect empty cells or redundant predictors.")
  f$ava_vcov <- sandwich::vcovHC(f, type = "HC3")
  if (any(!is.finite(f$ava_vcov))) stop("HC3 covariance is not finite; inspect sparse cells.")
  class(f) <- c("ava_lm", class(f)); f
}
pool_one <- function(Q, U, n, k) {
  stopifnot(length(Q) == length(U), all(is.finite(Q)), all(is.finite(U)))
  U <- pmax(U, 0)
  if (length(Q) == 1L || (var(Q) == 0 && mean(U) == 0)) {
    estimate <- mean(Q); se <- sqrt(mean(U)); df <- n - k
  } else {
    z <- mice::pool.scalar(Q, U, n = n, k = k)
    estimate <- z$qbar; se <- sqrt(z$t); df <- z$df
  }
  data.frame(estimate = estimate, SE = se, df = df,
    lower = estimate - qt(.975, df) * se, upper = estimate + qt(.975, df) * se,
    p = if (se > 0) 2 * pt(-abs(estimate / se), df) else NA_real_)
}
pool_vectors <- function(Q, U, dfcom) {
  nm <- paste0("b", seq_along(Q[[1]]))
  Q <- lapply(Q, setNames, nm)
  U <- lapply(U, function(v) { dimnames(v) <- list(nm, nm); v })
  if (length(nm) == 1L) {
    z <- pool_one(vapply(Q, `[`, numeric(1), 1), vapply(U, `[`, numeric(1), 1), dfcom + 1, 1)
    return(data.frame(F = (z$estimate / z$SE)^2, df1 = 1, df2 = z$df, p = z$p))
  }
  if (length(Q) == 1L || max(abs(stats::cov(do.call(rbind, Q)))) < 1e-18) {
    b <- Reduce(`+`, Q) / length(Q); V <- Reduce(`+`, U) / length(U)
    Fval <- as.numeric(crossprod(b, solve(V, b))) / length(b)
    return(data.frame(F = Fval, df1 = length(b), df2 = dfcom,
                      p = pf(Fval, length(b), dfcom, lower.tail = FALSE)))
  }
  z <- mitml::testConstraints(qhat = Q, uhat = U, constraints = nm, method = "D1", df.com = dfcom)
  z <- as.numeric(z$test[1, 1:4])
  data.frame(F = z[1], df1 = z[2], df2 = z[3], p = z[4])
}
pool_fits <- function(fits) {
  nm <- names(coef(fits[[1]]))
  stopifnot(all(vapply(fits, function(f) identical(names(coef(f)), nm), logical(1))))
  bind(lapply(nm, function(t) cbind(term = t, pool_one(
    vapply(fits, function(f) coef(f)[t], numeric(1)),
    vapply(fits, function(f) vcov(f)[t, t], numeric(1)), nobs(fits[[1]]), length(nm)))))
}
block_test <- function(fits, terms) {
  pool_vectors(lapply(fits, function(f) coef(f)[terms]),
               lapply(fits, function(f) vcov(f)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]), df.residual(fits[[1]]))
}
term_columns <- function(fit, variable) {
  labels <- attr(terms(fit), "term.labels"); idx <- match(variable, labels)
  if (is.na(idx)) stop("Term absent: ", variable)
  colnames(model.matrix(fit))[attr(model.matrix(fit), "assign") == idx]
}
pair_prediction <- function(f, dat, set = list()) {
  nd <- dat
  for (nm in names(set)) nd[[nm]] <- if (is.factor(dat[[nm]]))
    factor(rep(set[[nm]], nrow(nd)), levels = levels(dat[[nm]])) else rep(set[[nm]], nrow(nd))
  X <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(f)), nd, contrasts.arg = f$contrasts)
  if (inherits(f, "glm")) {
    mu <- plogis(drop(X %*% coef(f))); L <- colMeans(X * (mu * (1 - mu))); Q <- mean(mu)
  } else { L <- colMeans(X); Q <- sum(L * coef(f)) }
  list(Q = Q, L = L)
}
# Descriptive generalized eta-squared: all predictors are measured, not manipulated.
# Each SS is a Wald hypothesis SS based on (X'X)^-1, never the HC3 covariance.
# Gender uses the same sample-standardized marginal contrast as the reported test.
generalized_eta_profile <- function(f,dat=model.frame(f)) {
  X <- model.matrix(f); b <- coef(f); inv <- solve(crossprod(X))
  term_labels <- attr(terms(f),"term.labels")
  assignments <- attr(X,"assign")
  ss <- setNames(vapply(seq_along(term_labels),function(j) {
    take <- which(assignments==j)
    L <- diag(ncol(X))[take,,drop=FALSE]
    if(term_labels[j]=="gender_c") {
      pw <- pair_prediction(f,dat,list(gender_c=.5))
      pm <- pair_prediction(f,dat,list(gender_c=-.5))
      L <- matrix(pw$L-pm$L,nrow=1)
    }
    q <- drop(L%*%b)
    max(0,as.numeric(crossprod(q,solve(L%*%inv%*%t(L),q))))
  },numeric(1)),term_labels)
  residual_ss <- sum(residuals(f)^2)
  # With every effect observed, Olejnik/Algina denominator simplifies to this sum.
  denominator <- residual_ss+sum(ss)
  stopifnot(is.finite(denominator),denominator>0)
  eta <- ss/denominator
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(eta)),all(eta>=0),all(eta<=1))
  list(SS=ss,Residual_SS=residual_ss,Denominator=denominator,Eta2_G=eta)
}
mean_generalized_eta <- function(fs,term,ds=NULL) {
  vals <- vapply(seq_along(fs),function(i) {
    z <- if(is.null(ds))generalized_eta_profile(fs[[i]]) else generalized_eta_profile(fs[[i]],ds[[i]])
    if(!term%in%names(z$Eta2_G))stop("Unknown generalized eta-squared term: ",term)
    unname(z$Eta2_G[term])
  },numeric(1))
  mean(vals)
}
mean_generalized_eta_block <- function(fs,terms,ds) {
  mean(vapply(seq_along(fs),function(i) {
    f <- fs[[i]];X <- model.matrix(f);take <- match(terms,colnames(X))
    stopifnot(!anyNA(take))
    L <- diag(ncol(X))[take,,drop=FALSE];q <- drop(L%*%coef(f));inv <- solve(crossprod(X))
    ss <- max(0,as.numeric(crossprod(q,solve(L%*%inv%*%t(L),q))))
    profile <- generalized_eta_profile(f,ds[[i]])
    # Treat the jointly tested timing block as one observed effect in the denominator.
    denominator <- profile$Residual_SS+sum(profile$SS[!names(profile$SS)%in%terms])+ss
    ss/denominator
  },numeric(1)))
}
add_generalized_eta <- function(test,fs,term,ds=NULL) {
  test$eta2_generalized <- mean_generalized_eta(fs,term,ds)
  test
}
aicc_one <- function(f) {
  # ML likelihood counts regression coefficients, intercept and residual variance.
  ll <- stats::logLik(f,REML=FALSE); K <- attr(ll,"df"); n <- stats::nobs(f)
  stopifnot(K==f$rank+1L,n>K+1L)
  aic <- -2*as.numeric(ll)+2*K
  data.frame(N=n,K=K,AIC=aic,AICc=aic+2*K*(K+1)/(n-K-1))
}
# Prediction averaging may use a subgroup; pooling retains the fitted model's n and k.
pool_contrast <- function(fits, datasets, settings, weights, prediction_data = datasets) {
  z <- lapply(seq_along(fits), function(i) {
    pr <- lapply(settings, function(s) pair_prediction(fits[[i]], prediction_data[[i]], s))
    L <- Reduce(`+`, Map(function(p, w) p$L * w, pr, weights))
    c(Q = sum(vapply(pr, `[[`, numeric(1), "Q") * weights), U = as.numeric(crossprod(L, vcov(fits[[i]]) %*% L)))
  })
  pool_one(vapply(z, `[[`, numeric(1), "Q"), vapply(z, `[[`, numeric(1), "U"),
           nrow(datasets[[1]]), length(coef(fits[[1]])))
}
make_imputations <- function(dat) {
  for (v in names(dat)) if (all(is.na(dat[[v]]))) stop("All values missing for ", v)
  if (!anyNA(dat)) return(list(data = list(dat), imp = NULL))
  imdat <- dat
  if ("age_homogamous_c" %in% names(imdat))
    imdat$age_homogamous_c <- factor(imdat$age_homogamous_c, levels = c(-.5, .5))
  methods <- rep("", ncol(imdat)); names(methods) <- names(imdat)
  for (v in names(imdat)[colSums(is.na(imdat)) > 0]) methods[v] <-
    if (is.factor(imdat[[v]])) { if (nlevels(imdat[[v]]) == 2) "logreg" else "polyreg" } else "pmm"
  # Keep observed gender-by-area heterogeneity in every imputation equation.
  forms <- lapply(names(imdat), function(v) {
    rhs <- setdiff(names(imdat), v)
    if (all(c("gender_c", "research_area_3g") %in% rhs))
      rhs <- c(setdiff(rhs, c("gender_c", "research_area_3g")), "gender_c * research_area_3g")
    reformulate(rhs, v)
  }); names(forms) <- names(imdat)
  key <- digest::digest(list("monogamous-three-model-mi-v2", imdat, methods, forms, cfg$m, cfg$maxit, cfg$seed))
  path <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("imputation_", key, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(path)) imp <- readRDS(path) else {
    imp <- mice::mice(imdat, m = cfg$m, maxit = cfg$maxit, method = methods,
                      formulas = forms, seed = cfg$seed, printFlag = FALSE)
    saveRDS(imp, path)
  }
  ds <- lapply(seq_len(imp$m), function(i) {
    z <- mice::complete(imp, i)
    if ("age_homogamous_c" %in% names(z)) z$age_homogamous_c <- num(z$age_homogamous_c)
    z
  })
  if (any(vapply(ds, anyNA, logical(1)))) stop("Imputation left missing values; inspect logged events.")
  list(data = ds, imp = imp)
}
mi <- make_imputations(analysis_data)
datasets <- mi$data
if (!is.null(mi$imp) && !is.null(mi$imp$loggedEvents)) {
  save_table(mi$imp$loggedEvents, "S1_imputation_events", "S1. Imputation events")
  warning("Imputation events were recorded. Inspect S1 and the convergence plots before interpreting results.")
}
# adjustment, not changes in the people included or independent imputations.
```

```{r 04-main-models-and-indirect-associations}
# bivariate-associations ----
bivariate_labels <- vlabels
names(bivariate_labels)[names(bivariate_labels) == "timing_relationship_phd_4g"] <- "timing_relationship_phd_continuous"
names(bivariate_labels)[names(bivariate_labels) == "age_homogamous_c"] <- "absolute_age_difference"
bivariate_labels["timing_relationship_phd_continuous"] <- "Formation timing (years relative to PhD)"
bivariate_labels["absolute_age_difference"] <- "Absolute age difference (years)"
bivariate_labels <- c(bivariate_labels, age_at_phd="Age at PhD completion (years)",
                      cp_start_age="Age at relationship formation (years)")
bivariate_vars <- names(bivariate_labels)
bivariate_source <- d
bivariate_source$absolute_age_difference <- abs(num(d$final_age_diff))
bivariate_data <- bivariate_source[bivariate_vars]
# Signed age difference is required for Table 1; Table 2 retains absolute difference.
bivariate_data$signed_age_difference <- num(d$final_age_diff)

# Impute the continuous scales directly, rather than reconstructing years from categories.

# The stacked HC3 covariance retains covariance between category equations.
multi_indicator <- function(dat, response, rhs) {
  X <- model.matrix(reformulate(rhs), dat)
  y <- dat[[response]]
  Y <- if (is.factor(y)) model.matrix(~ y)[, -1, drop = FALSE] else matrix(y, ncol = 1)
  fit <- lm.fit(X, Y)
  if (fit$rank < ncol(X)) stop("Rank-deficient indicator regression.")
  B <- matrix(fit$coefficients, nrow = ncol(X))
  E <- matrix(fit$residuals, nrow = nrow(X))
  inv <- solve(crossprod(X)); bread <- X %*% inv
  h <- rowSums(bread * X)
  influence <- do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(ncol(Y)), function(j) bread * (E[, j] / (1 - h))))
  Q <- as.vector(B); U <- crossprod(influence)
  names(Q) <- paste0("b", seq_along(Q)); dimnames(U) <- list(names(Q), names(Q))
  slope <- rep(colnames(X) != "(Intercept)", ncol(Y))
  list(Q = Q, U = U, slope = slope, X = X, B = B, Y = Y, df = nrow(X) - ncol(X))
}
as_category <- function(dat, nm) {
  if (nm == "gender_c") return(factor(dat[[nm]], levels = c(-.5, .5)))
  if (nm == "age_homogamous_c") return(factor(dat[[nm]], levels = c(-.5, .5)))
  if (nm == "cp_academic_couple_c") return(factor(dat[[nm]], levels = c(0, 1)))
  dat[[nm]]
}
association_one <- function(dat, x, y) {
  z <- data.frame(x = as_category(dat, x), y = as_category(dat, y))
  cx <- is.factor(z$x); cy <- is.factor(z$y)
  bx <- cx && nlevels(z$x) == 2L; by <- cy && nlevels(z$y) == 2L
  if ((!cx || bx) && (!cy || by)) {
    xx <- if (bx) as.numeric(z$x) - 1 else z$x
    yy <- if (by) as.numeric(z$y) - 1 else z$y
    effect <- cor(xx, yy)
    measure <- if (bx && by) "phi" else if (bx || by) "r_pb" else "r"
  } else if (cx && cy) {
    ct <- table(z$x, z$y)
    ch <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(ct, correct = FALSE))
    effect <- sqrt(as.numeric(ch$statistic) / (sum(ct) * min(dim(ct) - 1))); measure <- "V"
  } else {
    if (cy) { zz <- z$x; z$x <- z$y; z$y <- zz }
    effect <- sqrt(max(0, summary(lm(y ~ x, z))$r.squared)); measure <- "eta"
  }
  a <- multi_indicator(z, "y", "x")
  list(effect = effect, measure = measure, Q = a$Q[a$slope], U = a$U[a$slope, a$slope, drop = FALSE], df = a$df)
}
association_matrix <- function(ds, label) {
  bind(lapply(combn(bivariate_vars, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(pair) {
    a <- lapply(ds, association_one, x = pair[1], y = pair[2])
    test <- tryCatch(pool_vectors(lapply(a, `[[`, "Q"), lapply(a, `[[`, "U"), a[[1]]$df),
                     error = function(e) data.frame(F = NA_real_, df1 = NA_real_, df2 = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    data.frame(x = pair[1], y = pair[2], sample = label, N = nrow(ds[[1]]),
      measure = a[[1]]$measure, strength = mean(vapply(a, `[[`, numeric(1), "effect")),
      minimum = min(vapply(a, `[[`, numeric(1), "effect")), maximum = max(vapply(a, `[[`, numeric(1), "effect")),
      F = test$F, df1 = test$df1, df2 = test$df2, p = test$p)
  }))
}
association_effect_fast <- function(xx,yy) {
  cx <- is.factor(xx);cy <- is.factor(yy)
  bx <- cx && nlevels(xx)==2L;by <- cy && nlevels(yy)==2L
  if((!cx || bx) && (!cy || by)) {
    x <- if(bx)as.numeric(xx)-1 else xx;y <- if(by)as.numeric(yy)-1 else yy
    return(suppressWarnings(cor(x,y)))
  }
  if(cx && cy) {
    ct <- table(xx,yy);n <- sum(ct);expected <- outer(rowSums(ct),colSums(ct))/n
    keep <- expected>0
    return(sqrt(sum(((ct-expected)^2/ifelse(keep,expected,1))[keep])/(n*min(nlevels(xx)-1,nlevels(yy)-1))))
  }
  groups <- if(cx)xx else yy;values <- if(cx)yy else xx
  counts <- table(groups);means <- tapply(values,groups,mean)
  total <- sum((values-mean(values))^2)
  if(total<=0)return(NA_real_)
  sqrt(max(0,sum(counts[counts>0]*(means[counts>0]-mean(values))^2)/total))
}
association_strength_intervals <- function(ds,associations,B=400L) {
  key <- digest::digest(list("monogamous-association-strength-ci-v2",ds,associations[c("x","y")],B,cfg$seed))
  path <- file.path(cache_dir,paste0("association_ci_",key,".rds"))
  if(file.exists(path))return(readRDS(path))
  had_seed <- exists(".Random.seed",envir=.GlobalEnv,inherits=FALSE)
  if(had_seed)old_seed <- get(".Random.seed",envir=.GlobalEnv)
  on.exit(if(had_seed)assign(".Random.seed",old_seed,envir=.GlobalEnv) else
    if(exists(".Random.seed",envir=.GlobalEnv,inherits=FALSE))rm(".Random.seed",envir=.GlobalEnv),add=TRUE)
  set.seed(cfg$seed+41L)
  out <- bind(lapply(seq_len(nrow(associations)),function(j) {
    x <- associations$x[j];y <- associations$y[j]
    signed <- associations$measure[j]%in%c("r","r_pb","phi")
    parts <- lapply(ds,function(dat) {
      xx <- as_category(dat,x);yy <- as_category(dat,y);n <- nrow(dat)
      estimates <- replicate(B,{idx <- sample.int(n,n,replace=TRUE);association_effect_fast(xx[idx],yy[idx])})
      estimates <- estimates[is.finite(estimates)]
      c(Q=association_effect_fast(xx,yy),U=if(length(estimates)>=.8*B)var(estimates) else NA_real_)
    })
    Q <- vapply(parts,`[`,numeric(1),"Q");U <- vapply(parts,`[`,numeric(1),"U")
    if(any(!is.finite(Q)) || any(!is.finite(U)))return(data.frame(x=x,y=y,lower=NA_real_,upper=NA_real_,Status="CI not estimable"))
    dfcom <- association_one(ds[[1]],x,y)$df
    q <- pool_one(Q,U,nrow(ds[[1]]),nrow(ds[[1]])-dfcom)
    lower_bound <- if(signed)-1 else 0
    data.frame(x=x,y=y,lower=max(lower_bound,q$lower),upper=min(1,q$upper),Status="")
  }))
  saveRDS(out,path);out
}

assoc_plot <- function(z, title) {
  z <- z[z$x %in% names(continuous_matrix_labels) & z$y %in% names(continuous_matrix_labels),,drop=FALSE]
  z$x <- factor(unname(continuous_matrix_labels[z$x]), levels = unname(continuous_matrix_labels))
  z$y <- factor(unname(continuous_matrix_labels[z$y]), levels = rev(unname(continuous_matrix_labels)))
  z$label <- paste0(fmt(z$strength, 2), "\n", z$measure)
  ggplot(z, aes(x, y, fill = strength)) + geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(limits = c(-1, 1), low = "#b35454", mid = "#f2f6fa", high = "#36849a", midpoint = 0, name = "Association") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) + coord_equal() + theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
}

contrast_table <- function(fs,ds) {
  z <- bind(lapply(names(focal),function(nm) {
    sp <- focal[[nm]]
    cbind(id=nm,Contrast=sp$label,Family=sp$family,pool_contrast(fs,ds,sp$settings,sp$weights))
  }))
  z$p_holm <- ave(z$p,z$Family,FUN=function(p)p.adjust(p,"holm"));z
}

group_predictions <- function(fs, ds, group = "research_area_3g") {
  if (!is.null(fs$error)) return(data.frame())
  groups <- levels(ds[[1]][[group]])
  bind(lapply(groups, function(a) bind(lapply(c(-.5, .5), function(g) {
    cbind(area = a, gender = ifelse(g == .5, "Women", "Men"),
          pool_contrast(fs, ds, list(c(list(gender_c = g), setNames(list(a), group))), 1))
  }))))
}
gender_gaps <- function(fs, ds, group = "research_area_3g") {
  if (!is.null(fs$error)) return(data.frame())
  groups <- levels(ds[[1]][[group]])
  bind(lapply(groups, function(a) cbind(area = a,
    pool_contrast(fs, ds, list(c(list(gender_c = .5), setNames(list(a), group)),
                             c(list(gender_c = -.5), setNames(list(a), group))), c(1, -1)))))
}
gap_differences <- function(fs, ds, group = "research_area_3g") {
  if (!is.null(fs$error)) return(data.frame())
  groups <- levels(ds[[1]][[group]])
  z <- bind(lapply(groups[-1], function(a) cbind(contrast = paste(a, "vs", groups[1]),
    pool_contrast(fs, ds, list(c(list(gender_c = .5), setNames(list(a), group)), c(list(gender_c = -.5), setNames(list(a), group)),
                             c(list(gender_c = .5), setNames(list(groups[1]), group)), c(list(gender_c = -.5), setNames(list(groups[1]), group))), c(1, -1, -1, 1)))))
  z$p_holm <- p.adjust(z$p, "holm"); z
}

condition_rows <- bind(lapply(names(av_variables),function(k) {
 z <- lapply(datasets,function(d) {d$gender_area <- interaction(d$gender_c,d$research_area_3g,drop=TRUE);d})
 pairs <- list(c("gender_area",av_variables[k]),c(av_variables[k],"cp_academic_couple_c"),c("gender_area","cp_academic_couple_c"))
 ps <- vapply(pairs,function(pair) {
   fits <- lapply(z,function(d)association_one(d,pair[1],pair[2]))
   pool_vectors(lapply(fits,`[[`,"Q"),lapply(fits,`[[`,"U"),fits[[1]]$df)$p
 },numeric(1))
 yes <- ps<cfg$alpha
 condition <- if(all(yes))1L else if(all(yes[1:2])&&!yes[3])2L else if(!any(yes))3L else 4L
 interpretation <- c("All three zero-order associations were supported; evaluate adjusted and indirect associations.",
   "Group–AV and AV–outcome associations were supported, without a clear overall group–outcome association.",
   "None of the three zero-order tests reached the threshold; this does not establish population zeros.",
   "Only part of the three-association pattern was supported; adjustment alone cannot establish an explanatory pathway.")[condition]
 data.frame(Model=k,Condition=condition,Group_AV_p=ps[1],AV_outcome_p=ps[2],Group_outcome_p=ps[3],Interpretation=interpretation)
}))

# targeted-indirect ----
# Planned indirect contrasts: calculated regardless of omnibus p or attenuation.
hc3_contributions <- function(f) {
  X <- model.matrix(f); sweep(X%*%solve(crossprod(X)),1,residuals(f)/(1-hatvalues(f)),"*")
}
indirect_for_contrast <- function(ds,reduced,full,av,sp) {
  one <- lapply(seq_along(ds),function(i) {
    f0 <- reduced[[i]]; f1 <- full[[i]]; X <- model.matrix(f0)
    Z <- model.matrix(f1)[,unlist(lapply(av,function(v)term_columns(f1,v)),use.names=FALSE),drop=FALSE]
    pr <- lapply(sp$settings,function(s)pair_prediction(f0,ds[[i]],s))
    L <- Reduce(`+`,Map(function(p,w)p$L*w,pr,sp$weights))
    af <- lm.fit(X,Z); A <- matrix(af$coefficients,nrow=ncol(X)); E <- matrix(af$residuals,nrow=nrow(X))
    bread <- X%*%solve(crossprod(X)); h <- rowSums(bread*X)
    a <- drop(L%*%A); b <- coef(f1)[colnames(Z)]; nz <- length(b)
    ia <- sapply(seq_len(nz),function(j)drop(bread%*%L)*E[,j]/(1-h))
    ib <- hc3_contributions(f1)[,colnames(Z),drop=FALSE]
    V <- crossprod(cbind(ia,ib)); G <- cbind(diag(b,nz),diag(a,nz))
    products <- a*b; U <- G%*%V%*%t(G); total <- sum(products)
    pr1 <- lapply(sp$settings,function(s)pair_prediction(f1,ds[[i]],s))
    delta <- sum(vapply(pr,`[[`,numeric(1),"Q")*sp$weights)-sum(vapply(pr1,`[[`,numeric(1),"Q")*sp$weights)
    if(abs(total-delta)>1e-8)stop("Indirect contrast identity failed")
    list(Q=total,U=sum(U),components=products,component_U=diag(U),labels=colnames(Z),
      identity_error=abs(total-delta),n=nobs(f1),k=length(coef(f1)))
  })
  z <- pool_one(vapply(one,`[[`,numeric(1),"Q"),vapply(one,`[[`,numeric(1),"U"),one[[1]]$n,one[[1]]$k)
  components <- bind(lapply(seq_along(one[[1]]$labels),function(j)cbind(Category=one[[1]]$labels[j],
    pool_one(vapply(one,function(x)x$components[j],numeric(1)),vapply(one,function(x)x$component_U[j],numeric(1)),one[[1]]$n,one[[1]]$k))))
  list(total=z,components=components,identity_error=max(vapply(one,`[[`,numeric(1),"identity_error")))
}
# Four planned indirect contrasts: two field differences in gender gaps for each associational variable.
indirect_ids <- names(focal)[grepl("^gap_",names(focal))]
indirect_results <- indirect_components <- screening <- data.frame()
av_tests <- bind(lapply(names(av_variables),function(k)cbind(Model=k,
  block_test(interaction_fits[[k]],term_columns(interaction_fits[[k]][[1]],av_variables[k])))))
for(k in names(av_variables)) {
  av <- av_variables[k]; p_av <- av_tests$p[av_tests$Model==k]
  for(id in indirect_ids) {
    before <- focal_results$M1[focal_results$M1$id==id,]
    after <- focal_results[[k]][focal_results[[k]]$id==id,]
    attenuated <- abs(after$estimate)<abs(before$estimate) && before$estimate*after$estimate>=0
    eligible <- is.finite(p_av) && p_av<cfg$alpha && attenuated
    screening <- rbind(screening,data.frame(Model=k,Contrast=focal[[id]]$label,
      Baseline=before$estimate,Adjusted=after$estimate,AV_p=p_av,Attenuated=attenuated,Attenuation_and_block_criterion=eligible))
    # All planned indirect contrasts are estimated; attenuation is descriptive, not a selection gate.
    q <- indirect_for_contrast(datasets,interaction_fits$M1,interaction_fits[[k]],av,focal[[id]])
    indirect_results <- rbind(indirect_results,cbind(Model=k,id=id,Contrast=focal[[id]]$label,q$total))
    indirect_components <- rbind(indirect_components,cbind(Model=k,id=id,Contrast=focal[[id]]$label,q$components))
  }
}
if(nrow(indirect_results)) {
  indirect_results$p_holm <- ave(indirect_results$p,indirect_results$Model,
    FUN=function(p)p.adjust(p,"holm",n=length(indirect_ids)))
  indirect_components$p_holm <- ave(indirect_components$p,indirect_components$Model,FUN=function(p)p.adjust(p,"holm"))
}

All four planned field-gap indirect contrasts are estimated without significance screening. Total indirect associations concern the full categorical variable. Holm correction covers two indirect contrasts within H2a and two within H2b. Category components are descriptive decompositions, not additional primary tests. Associations do not establish causality."

  z <- pool_vectors(lapply(fits,function(f)f$Q[take]),lapply(fits,function(f)f$U[take,take,drop=FALSE]),fits[[1]]$df)

}))
save_table(av_response_tests,"S4_AV_response_interactions","Gender-by-area differences in meeting and timing distributions")
h3_target_outcome <- list()
av_distribution_contrasts <- bind(lapply(names(av_variables),function(k) {
  av <- av_variables[k]; rhs <- c("gender_c*research_area_3g",base_controls)
  fits <- av_response_fits[[k]]
  lev <- levels(datasets[[1]][[av]])
  target <- if(k=="M2") "School/university or work versus other contexts" else
    "Less than five years before/during or after PhD versus five or more years before"
  # Combine the categories specified in H2; primary outcome models remain categorical.
  category <- if(k=="M2") as.numeric(seq_along(lev)%in%c(2L,3L)) else
    as.numeric(lev!="5 years or more before PhD completion year")
  target_levels <- lev[category==1]; comparison_levels <- lev[category==0]
  category_counts <- table(datasets[[1]][[av]])
  target_weights <- as.numeric(category_counts[target_levels]); target_weights <- target_weights/sum(target_weights)
  comparison_weights <- as.numeric(category_counts[comparison_levels]); comparison_weights <- comparison_weights/sum(comparison_weights)
  setting_levels <- c(target_levels,comparison_levels)
  outcome_settings <- lapply(setting_levels,function(level) setNames(list(level),av))
  # Standardized target-group outcome contrast using fixed category-frequency weights.
  h3_target_outcome[[k]] <<- cbind(Model=k,Category=target,
    pool_contrast(interaction_fits[[k]],datasets,outcome_settings,c(target_weights,-comparison_weights)))
  bind(lapply(indirect_ids,function(id) {
    sp <- focal[[id]]
    results <- lapply(seq_along(fits),function(i) {
      f <- fits[[i]]
      design <- lapply(sp$settings,function(setting) {
        nd <- datasets[[i]]
        for(v in names(setting)) nd[[v]] <- if(is.factor(nd[[v]])) factor(rep(setting[[v]],nrow(nd)),levels=levels(nd[[v]])) else rep(setting[[v]],nrow(nd))
        colMeans(model.matrix(reformulate(rhs),nd))
      })
      L <- Reduce(`+`,Map(function(x,w)x*w,design,sp$weights))
      gradient <- as.vector(outer(L,category[-1]-category[1]))
      c(Q=sum(gradient*f$Q),U=as.numeric(crossprod(gradient,f$U%*%gradient)))
    })
    cbind(Model=k,Category=target,id=id,Contrast=sp$label,
      pool_one(vapply(results,`[`,numeric(1),"Q"),vapply(results,`[`,numeric(1),"U"),nrow(datasets[[1]]),ncol(fits[[1]]$X)))
  }))
}))
av_distribution_contrasts$p_holm <- ave(av_distribution_contrasts$p,av_distribution_contrasts$Model,FUN=function(p)p.adjust(p,"holm"))
primary_row <- function(number,hypothesis,model,id,contrast,q) {
  data.frame(Number=number,Hypothesis=hypothesis,Model=model,id=id,Contrast=contrast,
    estimate=q$estimate,SE=q$SE,lower=q$lower,upper=q$upper,p=q$p,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
primary_rows <- list(primary_row(1,"H1","M1","overall",focal$overall$label,
  focal_results$M1[focal_results$M1$id=="overall",,drop=FALSE]))
for(j in seq_along(indirect_ids)) {
  id <- indirect_ids[j]
  primary_rows[[length(primary_rows)+1L]] <- primary_row(j+1,"H1","M1",id,focal[[id]]$label,
    focal_results$M1[focal_results$M1$id==id,,drop=FALSE])
}
for(k in names(av_variables)) {
  h <- if(k=="M2")"H2a" else "H2b"
  for(id in indirect_ids) primary_rows[[length(primary_rows)+1L]] <- primary_row(length(primary_rows)+1L,h,k,paste0("indirect_",id),
    paste("Indirect association:",focal[[id]]$label),
    indirect_results[indirect_results$Model==k & indirect_results$id==id,,drop=FALSE])
}
primary_contrasts <- bind(primary_rows)
stopifnot(nrow(primary_contrasts)==7L,!anyDuplicated(primary_contrasts$Number))
# Combining hypothesis labels does not combine the prespecified multiplicity families.
primary_contrasts$Family <- ifelse(primary_contrasts$Model=="M1",
  ifelse(primary_contrasts$id=="overall","H1 overall","H1 field contrasts"),primary_contrasts$Hypothesis)
primary_contrasts$p_holm <- ave(primary_contrasts$p,primary_contrasts$Family,FUN=function(p)p.adjust(p,"holm"))
for(k in names(av_variables)) {
  pc <- primary_contrasts[primary_contrasts$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
  for(id in indirect_ids) {
    indirect_results$p_holm[indirect_results$Model==k & indirect_results$id==id] <- pc$p_holm[pc$id==paste0("indirect_",id)]
  }
}
primary_display <- primary_contrasts[c("Number","Hypothesis","Family","Model","Contrast")]
primary_display$`Estimate, percentage points` <- 100*primary_contrasts$estimate
primary_display$`95% CI lower` <- 100*primary_contrasts$lower
primary_display$`95% CI upper` <- 100*primary_contrasts$upper
primary_display$`Holm-adjusted p` <- primary_contrasts$p_holm
save_table(primary_display,"S4_primary_7","Seven primary hypothesis contrasts",
 "H1: one overall gender contrast and two field differences in gender gaps. H2a/H2b: two indirect associations each. Combined outcome and distribution estimates support interpretation; their p-values are unadjusted and are not additional primary tests. Holm adjustment covers the two H1 field contrasts and the two indirect contrasts within each H2a/H2b family; the overall H1 contrast remains a separate single test. Tests are two-sided; support also requires the predicted positive direction. Intervals are pointwise. Category-frequency weights for combined contrasts are fixed using the first imputed dataset.")
save_table(av_distribution_contrasts[,setdiff(names(av_distribution_contrasts),"p_holm"),drop=FALSE],"S4_AV_distribution_contrasts","Supporting H2 distribution estimates and 95% CIs")
h3_outcome_support <- bind(h3_target_outcome)
save_table(h3_outcome_support[,setdiff(names(h3_outcome_support),"p_holm"),drop=FALSE],"S4_H2_target_outcome","Supporting H2 outcome estimates and 95% CIs")
save_table(indirect_results,"S3_indirect_results","Four planned indirect associations",indirect_note)
component_display <- indirect_components[,setdiff(names(indirect_components),c("p","p_holm")),drop=FALSE]
save_table(component_display,"S3_indirect_components","Descriptive category components",indirect_note)
```

```{r 05-diagnostics-and-sensitivity}
#| include: false

# sensitivity-checks ----
# Step 0: diagnostics precede sensitivity estimation. Primary observations are retained.
flag_ids <- if(length(cfg$flagged_participant_ids)) as.character(cfg$flagged_participant_ids) else source_flagged_ids
relative_flags <- function(x) {
  o <- order(x,decreasing=TRUE,na.last=NA)
  if(length(o)<2L)return(integer(0))
  if(x[o[1L]]>2*x[o[2L]])o[1L] else integer(0)
}

run_diagnostics <- function(models, ids, sample_label) {
  summaries <- flags <- plots <- vifs <- list()
  for(k in names(models))for(i in seq_along(models[[k]])) {
    f <- models[[k]][[i]]
    # Standard lm diagnostics: use model geometry rather than the HC3 vcov override.
    class(f) <- setdiff(class(f),"ava_lm")
    sr <- rstudent(f); cd <- cooks.distance(f); hv <- hatvalues(f)
    chosen <- sort(unique(c(which(abs(sr)>4),relative_flags(cd),relative_flags(hv))))
    summaries[[length(summaries)+1L]] <- data.frame(Sample=sample_label,Model=k,Imputation=i,
      N=nobs(f),Max_abs_deleted_residual=max(abs(sr),na.rm=TRUE),
      Max_Cooks_D=max(cd,na.rm=TRUE),Max_leverage=max(hv,na.rm=TRUE),Flagged=length(chosen),
      Predictions_outside_0_1=sum(fitted(f)<0|fitted(f)>1))
    if(length(chosen))flags[[length(flags)+1L]] <- data.frame(Model=k,Imputation=i,ID=ids[chosen])
    vv <- tryCatch(car::vif(f,type="predictor"),error=function(e)NULL)
    if(!is.null(vv)) {
      if(is.matrix(vv)||is.data.frame(vv)) {
        num <- vv[,vapply(as.data.frame(vv),is.numeric,logical(1)),drop=FALSE]
        vifs[[length(vifs)+1L]] <- cbind(Sample=sample_label,Model=k,Imputation=i,Term=rownames(vv),num)
      } else vifs[[length(vifs)+1L]] <- data.frame(Sample=sample_label,Model=k,Imputation=i,Term=names(vv),VIF=as.numeric(vv))
    }
    if(i==1L)plots[[k]] <- data.frame(Model=k,Fitted=fitted(f),Residual=residuals(f))
  }
  list(summary=bind(summaries),flags=bind(flags),vif=bind(vifs),plot=bind(plots))
}
mi_diag <- run_diagnostics(interaction_fits,as.character(d$participant_id),"Imputed")
cc_diag <- run_diagnostics(cc_models,as.character(d$participant_id[cc_rows]),"Complete cases")
save_table(rbind(mi_diag$summary,cc_diag$summary),"S5_diagnostics","Diagnostics for M1–M3",
 "Absolute studentized deleted residuals >4; Cook's distance or leverage > twice the next-highest value. The largest value is compared with the next-highest; lower-tail gaps do not trigger exclusions. Imputed-data exclusions use the union across models and imputations; complete-case exclusions use the union across complete-case models. Previously flagged observations are also retained in the exclusion set. Primary models retain all observations. These diagnostics do not verify missing-at-random or independence assumptions.")
save_table(bind(list(mi_diag$vif,cc_diag$vif)),"S5_VIF","Predictor-level variance inflation diagnostics",
 "Predictor-level GVIFs account for interaction structure. GVIF^(1/(2*Df)) is dimension-adjusted and is not numerically equivalent to an ordinary VIF; model-level diagnostics are not significance tests.")

  key <- paste0("S5_residuals_",nm)

  supp_items[[key]]$title <- paste("Residual diagnostics for M1–M3:",gsub("_"," ",nm))
  supp_items[[key]]$note <- paste("Rows show M1–M3; columns show residuals versus fitted, Normal Q-Q and Scale-Location plots from plot.lm.",
    if(nm=="Imputed")"Plots use the first imputed dataset; numerical diagnostics cover all imputations." else "Plots use the complete-case sample.",
    "Binary-outcome linear probability models have non-normal, heteroskedastic errors by construction; Q-Q plots are descriptive. Inference uses HC3 variances.")
}
# Flag sets are fixed before refitting; imputed flags are unioned across all imputations.
mi_excluded <- unique(c(flag_ids,as.character(mi_diag$flags$ID)))
cc_excluded <- unique(c(flag_ids,as.character(cc_diag$flags$ID)))

sensitivity_status <- data.frame(Specification=character(),Status=character())
sensitivity_pairs <- list()
sensitivity_fits <- list()
# Include H1 contrasts and the combined H2 outcome contrasts on the probability scale.
sensitivity_contrasts <- function(fs,ds,k) {
  out <- contrast_table(fs,ds)
  out <- out[grepl("^overall$|^gender_|^gap_",out$id),,drop=FALSE]
  if(k%in%names(av_variables)) {
    av <- av_variables[k]; lev <- levels(datasets[[1]][[av]])
    target <- if(k=="M2")seq_along(lev)%in%c(2L,3L) else lev!="5 years or more before PhD completion year"
    counts <- as.numeric(table(datasets[[1]][[av]]))
    w <- ifelse(target,counts/sum(counts[target]),-counts/sum(counts[!target]))
    q <- pool_contrast(fs,ds,lapply(lev,function(v)setNames(list(v),av)),w)
    row <- out[1,,drop=FALSE]; row[1,] <- NA
    row$id <- paste0("H2_target_",k); row$Contrast <- if(k=="M2")"School/work versus other contexts" else "Close-to/post-PhD versus early formation"
    for(v in intersect(names(q),names(row)))row[[v]] <- q[[v]]
    row$p_holm <- q$p # Supporting outcome comparison; indirect checks are calculated separately.
    if("Family"%in%names(row))row$Family <- "H2 outcome sensitivity comparison (unadjusted p)"
    out <- rbind(out,row)
  }
  out
}
primary_sensitivity <- lapply(names(model_formulas),function(k)sensitivity_contrasts(interaction_fits[[k]],datasets,k))
names(primary_sensitivity) <- names(model_formulas)
register_sensitivity <- function(label,k,fs,ds,reference=primary_sensitivity[[k]]) {
  out <- sensitivity_contrasts(fs,ds,k)
  sensitivity_pairs[[label]] <<- list(alt=out,main=reference)
  sensitivity_fits[[label]] <<- list(fits=fs,datasets=ds)
  out
}

# Step 2: logistic models; contrasts are probability differences, not log-odds.
fit_logit <- function(fm,z) {
 f <- glm(fm,data=z,family=binomial(),na.action=na.fail)
 if(!isTRUE(f$converged)||anyNA(coef(f))||any(abs(coef(f))>25))stop("Logistic convergence/separation issue")
 # Use the same estimating functions and bread as vcovHC, before adding our class.
 # Mixing final response residuals with the stored IRLS weights can fail the
 # covariance check even when the binomial fit has converged.
 scores <- sandwich::estfun(f)
 h <- hatvalues(f)
 if(any(!is.finite(h)) || any(1-h<=sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)))
   stop("Logistic HC3 unavailable: leverage too close to one")
 B <- sandwich::bread(f)/nrow(scores)
 f$ava_influence <- sweep(scores,1,1-h,`/`)%*%B
 f$ava_vcov <- sandwich::vcovHC(f,type="HC3")
 if(!isTRUE(all.equal(unname(crossprod(f$ava_influence)),
     unname(f$ava_vcov),tolerance=1e-6)))
   stop("Logistic HC3 score covariance does not match sandwich::vcovHC")
 class(f)<-c("ava_lm",class(f));f
}

 },paste(k,"logistic sensitivity"))

# quadratic-timing-sensitivity ----
# Continuous timing sensitivity: square after imputation, using one fixed centering value.
quadratic_timing <- safe_analysis({
  quadratic_source <- analysis_data[all.vars(base_formula)]
  quadratic_source$timing_years <- num(d$timing_relationship_phd_continuous)
  if(sum(is.finite(quadratic_source$timing_years))<10L)stop("Too few observed continuous timing values.")
  timing_center <- mean(quadratic_source$timing_years,na.rm=TRUE)
  imp <- make_imputations(quadratic_source)
  ds <- lapply(imp$data,function(z) {
    z$timing_years_c <- (z$timing_years-timing_center)/10
    z$timing_years_sq <- z$timing_years_c^2
    z
  })
  linear_formula <- update(base_formula,.~.+timing_years_c)
  quadratic_formula <- update(linear_formula,.~.+timing_years_sq)
  reduced <- lapply(ds,function(z)fit_lpm(base_formula,z))
  linear <- lapply(ds,function(z)fit_lpm(linear_formula,z))
  fits <- lapply(ds,function(z)fit_lpm(quadratic_formula,z))
  tests <- rbind(cbind(Test="Separate linear timing model",block_test(linear,"timing_years_c")),
    cbind(Test="Quadratic term: non-linearity",block_test(fits,"timing_years_sq")),
    cbind(Test="Linear and quadratic timing jointly",block_test(fits,c("timing_years_c","timing_years_sq"))))
  support <- quantile(quadratic_source$timing_years,c(.025,.975),na.rm=TRUE,names=FALSE)
  grid <- sort(unique(c(seq(support[1],support[2],length.out=81),0)))
  grid <- grid[grid>=support[1] & grid<=support[2]]
  curve <- bind(lapply(grid,function(t) {
    tc <- (t-timing_center)/10
    cbind(Timing_years=t,pool_contrast(fits,ds,list(list(timing_years_c=tc,timing_years_sq=tc^2)),1))
  }))
  alt <- contrast_table(fits,ds)
  list(datasets=ds,reduced=reduced,linear=linear,fits=fits,tests=tests,curve=curve,
    coefficients=pool_fits(fits),linear_coefficients=pool_fits(linear),contrasts=alt,N=nrow(quadratic_source),Imputations=length(ds),center=timing_center)
},"Quadratic timing sensitivity")

Timing is imputed on its continuous scale; the square is derived afterward. The 1-df squared-term HC3 test evaluates non-linearity; the 2-df test evaluates both timing terms jointly. Estimates and variances are Rubin-pooled. These exploratory p-values are unadjusted.")

The curve covers the central 95% of observed timing; the rug displays observed values. Negative years precede PhD completion."
} else save_table(data.frame(Status=quadratic_timing$error),"S5_quadratic_timing_tests","Table S4. Quadratic timing estimation status")

# cubic-timing-sensitivity ----
# Cubic timing is a separate sensitivity model on the same imputed timing data.
cubic_timing <- safe_analysis({
  if(!is.null(quadratic_timing$error))stop(quadratic_timing$error)
  ds <- lapply(quadratic_timing$datasets,function(z) {
    z$timing_years_cube <- z$timing_years_c^3;z
  })
  formula <- update(base_formula,.~.+timing_years_c+timing_years_sq+timing_years_cube)
  fits <- lapply(ds,function(z)fit_lpm(formula,z))
  tests <- rbind(cbind(Test="Cubic term: additional curvature",block_test(fits,"timing_years_cube")),
    cbind(Test="All three timing terms jointly",block_test(fits,c("timing_years_c","timing_years_sq","timing_years_cube"))))
  curve <- bind(lapply(quadratic_timing$curve$Timing_years,function(t) {
    tc <- (t-quadratic_timing$center)/10
    cbind(Timing_years=t,pool_contrast(fits,ds,
      list(list(timing_years_c=tc,timing_years_sq=tc^2,timing_years_cube=tc^3)),1))
  }))
  list(datasets=ds,fits=fits,reduced=quadratic_timing$reduced,tests=tests,curve=curve,
    coefficients=pool_fits(fits),contrasts=contrast_table(fits,ds),
    N=quadratic_timing$N,Imputations=quadratic_timing$Imputations)
},"Cubic timing sensitivity")
if(is.null(cubic_timing$error)) {

    "The cubic model includes continuous timing, its square and its cube, retaining the M1 covariates and gender × area. Powers are derived after imputation. The 1-df cubic-term test evaluates additional curvature beyond the quadratic model; the 3-df test evaluates timing jointly. HC3 variances and Rubin pooling are used; exploratory p-values are unadjusted.")
  save_table(cubic_timing$coefficients,"S5_cubic_timing_coefficients","Cubic timing: full regression estimates")
  save_table(cubic_timing$contrasts,"S5_cubic_timing_contrasts","Cubic timing: gender and field-gap contrasts")
  z <- cubic_timing$curve;path <- tempfile(fileext=".png")
  grDevices::png(path,width=1800,height=1100,res=180,bg="white")

    graphics::par(mar=c(5.5,5,3.5,1),las=1,bty="l")
    graphics::plot(z$Timing_years,z$estimate,type="n",ylim=range(c(0,1,z$lower,z$upper)),
      yaxt="n",xlab="Relationship formation relative to PhD completion (years)",
      ylab="Adjusted probability of occupational homogamy",main="Separate cubic timing sensitivity")
    ticks <- pretty(range(c(0,1,z$lower,z$upper)))
    graphics::axis(2,at=ticks,labels=paste0(round(100*ticks),"%"))
    graphics::abline(h=ticks,col="#E3E8EC",lwd=.7)
    graphics::polygon(c(z$Timing_years,rev(z$Timing_years)),c(z$lower,rev(z$upper)),
      col=grDevices::adjustcolor("#7D6C9B",alpha.f=.18),border=NA)
    graphics::lines(z$Timing_years,z$estimate,col="#7D6C9B",lwd=2.5)
    graphics::abline(v=0,col="#777777",lty=3)
  },finally=grDevices::dev.off())
  embed_supplement_plot(path,"S5_cubic_timing_curve.png");unlink(path)
  supp_items[["S5_cubic_timing_curve"]]$title <- "Figure S4. Separate cubic timing curve"
  supp_items[["S5_cubic_timing_curve"]]$note <- "Overall predictions and pointwise 95% CIs use the same imputed timing sample and central observed timing range as the quadratic sensitivity analysis."
} else save_table(data.frame(Status=cubic_timing$error),"S5_cubic_timing_tests","Table S4. Cubic timing estimation status")

# indirect-sensitivity ----
# Logistic sensitivity: sum of distribution contrasts times average probability contrasts.
# This is an alternative marginal product, not a difference in logistic coefficients.
logistic_indirect_for_contrast <- function(ds,reduced,full,av,sp) {
  one <- lapply(seq_along(ds),function(i) {
    f0 <- reduced[[i]]; f1 <- full[[i]]; dat <- ds[[i]]
    X <- model.matrix(f0); lev <- levels(dat[[av]])
    Z <- model.matrix(f1)[,term_columns(f1,av),drop=FALSE]
    stopifnot(inherits(f1,"glm"),nrow(X)==nrow(dat),nobs(f1)==nrow(dat),
      identical(rownames(X),rownames(model.matrix(f1))),ncol(Z)==length(lev)-1L)
    # Verify treatment coding, so each Z column matches its non-reference category.
    stopifnot(max(abs(Z-sapply(lev[-1],function(v)as.numeric(dat[[av]]==v))))<1e-10)
    L <- Reduce(`+`,Map(function(setting,w) {
      nd <- dat
      for(nm in names(setting))nd[[nm]] <- if(is.factor(dat[[nm]]))
        factor(rep(setting[[nm]],nrow(nd)),levels=levels(dat[[nm]])) else rep(setting[[nm]],nrow(nd))
      w*colMeans(model.matrix(delete.response(terms(f0)),nd,contrasts.arg=f0$contrasts))
    },sp$settings,sp$weights))
    af <- lm.fit(X,Z); A <- matrix(af$coefficients,nrow=ncol(X))
    E <- matrix(af$residuals,nrow=nrow(X))
    bread <- X%*%solve(crossprod(X)); h <- rowSums(bread*X)
    a <- drop(L%*%A)
    ia <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(Z)),function(j)drop(bread%*%L)*E[,j]/(1-h))
    pr <- lapply(lev,function(v)pair_prediction(f1,dat,setNames(list(v),av)))
    b <- vapply(pr[-1],function(z)z$Q-pr[[1]]$Q,numeric(1))
    Db <- do.call(rbind,lapply(pr[-1],function(z)z$L-pr[[1]]$L))
    # Joint HC3 covariance includes the dependence of the two fitted associations.
    ib <- f1$ava_influence
    stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(crossprod(ib)),unname(vcov(f1)),tolerance=1e-6)))
    influence <- cbind(ia,ib%*%t(Db))
    gradient <- c(b,a)
    list(Q=sum(a*b),U=as.numeric(crossprod(gradient,crossprod(influence)%*%gradient)),
      n=nobs(f1),k=length(coef(f1)))
  })
  pool_one(vapply(one,`[[`,numeric(1),"Q"),vapply(one,`[[`,numeric(1),"U"),one[[1]]$n,one[[1]]$k)
}

  data.frame(Specification=spec,Model=c("M2","M3"),Reference="Primary")))

  data.frame(Specification="M3 without duration",Model="M3",Reference="Primary"),
  data.frame(Specification="Exclusions within complete cases",Model=c("M2","M3"),Reference="Complete cases"))
compare_indirect <- function(out,ref,reference) {
  stopifnot(nrow(out)==length(indirect_ids),setequal(out$id,ref$id))
  ref <- ref[match(out$id,ref$id),,drop=FALSE]
  cbind(out,Reference=reference,Reference_estimate=ref$estimate,
    Reference_p_Holm=ref$p_holm,Change_pp=100*abs(out$estimate-ref$estimate),
    Signed_change_pp=100*(out$estimate-ref$estimate),
    Threshold_change=(out$p_holm<cfg$alpha)!=(ref$p_holm<cfg$alpha),
    Support_change=(out$estimate>0 & out$p_holm<cfg$alpha)!=(ref$estimate>0 & ref$p_holm<cfg$alpha),
    Sign_reversal=out$estimate*ref$estimate<0,
    Both_nonsignificant=out$p_holm>=cfg$alpha & ref$p_holm>=cfg$alpha)
}
register_indirect_check <- function(spec,k,reduced,full,ds) {
  out <- safe_analysis({
    stopifnot(length(ds)==length(reduced),length(ds)==length(full))
    logistic <- inherits(full[[1]],"glm")
    z <- bind(lapply(indirect_ids,function(id) {
      q <- if(logistic)logistic_indirect_for_contrast(ds,reduced,full,av_variables[[k]],focal[[id]]) else
        indirect_for_contrast(ds,reduced,full,av_variables[[k]],focal[[id]])$total
      cbind(Specification=spec,Model=k,id=id,Contrast=focal[[id]]$label,
        Method=if(logistic)"Logistic marginal probability product" else "Linear probability product",
        N=nrow(ds[[1]]),Imputations=length(ds),q)
    }))
    z$p_holm <- p.adjust(z$p,"holm",n=length(indirect_ids))
    z
  },paste(spec,k,"indirect sensitivity"))
  if(!is.null(out$error)) {
    indirect_sensitivity_status <<- rbind(indirect_sensitivity_status,
      data.frame(Specification=spec,Model=k,Status=out$error))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  indirect_sensitivity_sets[[paste(spec,k)]] <<- out
  ref <- indirect_results[indirect_results$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
  indirect_sensitivity <<- rbind(indirect_sensitivity,compare_indirect(out,ref,"Primary"))
}
for(spec in indirect_check_specs)for(k in names(av_variables)) {
  reduced <- sensitivity_fits[[paste(spec,"M1")]]
  full <- sensitivity_fits[[paste(spec,k)]]

}

if(exists("quadratic_timing")) {

        "These alternative timing indirect products include both continuous timing terms. The baseline and full model use the same imputed data and controls. Joint HC3 delta-method variances, Rubin pooling and Holm correction across the two fields are used.")
    } else indirect_sensitivity_status <- rbind(indirect_sensitivity_status,

if(exists("cubic_timing")) {

    } else indirect_sensitivity_status <- rbind(indirect_sensitivity_status,
```

```{r 06-exploratory-partner-similarity}
# nested-similarity ----
# Conditional outcomes: each is defined only within its eligible couple group.
nested_specs <- list(
  Topic = list(status = 1, variable = "partner_topic_academic",
               positive = "Same/similar topics(s)",
               levels = c("Different areas", "Different topics in same area", "Same/similar topics(s)"),
               title = "Same/similar versus different research topics within academic couples"),
  Area = list(status = 1, variable = "partner_topic_academic",
              positive = c("Different topics in same area", "Same/similar topics(s)"),
              levels = c("Different areas", "Different topics in same area", "Same/similar topics(s)"),
              title = "Same versus different research areas within academic couples"),
  PhD = list(status = 0, variable = "partner_education_nonacademic",
             positive = "Partner has a doctorate",
             levels = c("Partner has no doctorate", "Partner has a doctorate"),
             title = "Partner PhD within non-academic couples")
)
nested_outcome <- function(sp) {
  x <- as.character(d[[sp$variable]])
  ifelse(d$cp_academic_couple_c == sp$status & x %in% sp$levels,
         as.numeric(x %in% sp$positive), NA_real_)
}
# Area similarity includes same/similar topics AND different topics within the same area.
# Missing/unavailable responses remain missing; this differs from topic similarity.
area_outcome_check <- nested_outcome(nested_specs$Area)
topic_outcome_check <- nested_outcome(nested_specs$Topic)
stopifnot(identical(is.na(area_outcome_check),is.na(topic_outcome_check)),
  all(area_outcome_check[!is.na(topic_outcome_check) & topic_outcome_check==1]==1))
nested_descriptives <- bind(lapply(names(nested_specs), function(k) {
  sp <- nested_specs[[k]]; y <- nested_outcome(sp)
  bind(lapply(field_levels, function(a) bind(lapply(c(-.5, .5), function(g) {
    rows <- d$cp_academic_couple_c == sp$status & d$research_area_3g == a & d$gender_c == g
    observed <- sum(!is.na(y[rows])); positive <- sum(y[rows] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(Similarity = sp$title, Area = a, Gender = ifelse(g == .5, "Women", "Men"),
      Eligible = sum(rows), Observed = observed, Missing = sum(is.na(y[rows])),
      Similar = positive, Percent = if (observed) 100 * positive / observed else NA_real_)
  }))))
}))
save_table(nested_descriptives, "S10_similarity_descriptives", "S10. Similarity within current couple groups",
  "Topic similarity means the same/similar research topics within academic couples. Different topics includes different topics within the same area and different areas. Area similarity combines same/similar topics and different topics within the same area; its comparison is different research areas. Partner PhD status is defined within non-academic couples. Percentages use observed eligible responses. Structural inapplicability is not imputed.")

nested_models <- lapply(names(nested_specs), function(k) safe_analysis({
  y <- nested_outcome(nested_specs[[k]])
  observed <- !is.na(y)
  dat <- analysis_data[observed, setdiff(names(analysis_data), "cp_academic_couple_c"), drop = FALSE]
  dat$similarity <- y[observed]
  dat$timing_years <- num(d$timing_relationship_phd_continuous[observed])
  if (length(unique(dat$similarity)) < 2L) stop("No variation in the observed subgroup outcome.")
  # Include the observed subgroup outcome when imputing its predictors.
  # Neither missing subgroup outcomes nor structural inapplicability are imputed.
  imputed <- make_imputations(dat)
  formula <- similarity ~ gender_c * research_area_3g + age_c + age_homogamous_c + cp_duration_c
  fits <- lapply(imputed$data, function(z) fit_lpm(formula, z))
  all_terms <- names(coef(fits[[1]]))
  groups <- list(Interaction = grep("gender_c:|:gender_c",all_terms,value=TRUE))
  tests <- bind(lapply(names(groups), function(label)
    cbind(Association = label, block_test(fits, groups[[label]]))))
  tests$p_holm <- p.adjust(tests$p, "holm")
  cc <- dat[complete.cases(dat), , drop = FALSE]
  complete_fit <- safe_analysis(fit_lpm(formula, cc), paste(k, "complete cases"))
  if (is.null(complete_fit$error))
    save_table(pool_fits(list(complete_fit)), paste0("S10_", k, "_complete_cases"),
      paste(nested_specs[[k]]$title, "- complete cases"), folder = sens_dir)
  if (!is.null(imputed$imp)) {
    if (!is.null(imputed$imp$loggedEvents))
      save_table(imputed$imp$loggedEvents, paste0("S10_", k, "_imputation_events"),
                 paste(k, "subgroup imputation events"))
    save_imputation_trace(imputed$imp, paste0("S10_", k, "_imputation_trace.png"))
  }
  list(fits = fits, datasets = imputed$data, tests = tests,
       predictions = group_predictions(fits, imputed$data, "research_area_3g"),
       gaps = gender_gaps(fits, imputed$data, "research_area_3g"),
       N = nrow(dat), N_complete = nrow(cc))
}, paste(k, "conditional similarity analysis")))
names(nested_models) <- names(nested_specs)
phd_field_probabilities <- phd_field_contrasts <- data.frame()
if(is.null(nested_models$PhD$error)) {
  z <- nested_models$PhD
  field_settings <- function(a) list(list(gender_c=.5,research_area_3g=a),
                                     list(gender_c=-.5,research_area_3g=a))
  phd_field_probabilities <- bind(lapply(field_levels,function(a)
    cbind(Area=a,pool_contrast(z$fits,z$datasets,field_settings(a),c(.5,.5)))))
  phd_field_contrasts <- bind(lapply(field_levels[-1],function(a)
    cbind(Area=a,Reference=field_levels[1],

  phd_field_contrasts$p_holm <- p.adjust(phd_field_contrasts$p,"holm")
  save_table(phd_field_probabilities,"S10_PhD_field_probabilities",
    "Partner PhD probability by research area within non-academic couples",
    "Adjusted for age, binary age similarity and relationship duration. Predictions average equally over women and men, and over the subgroup sample distribution of covariates. Estimates are probabilities with pointwise 95% CIs.")
  save_table(phd_field_contrasts,"S10_PhD_field_contrasts",
    "Research-area differences in partner PhD probability within non-academic couples",
    "Life Sciences and Natural & Engineering Sciences versus Humanities & Social Sciences, with equal gender weights. Probability differences and pointwise 95% CIs; Holm correction across these two field comparisons, separately from within-field gender contrasts.")
}

valid_nested <- names(nested_models)[vapply(nested_models,function(z)is.null(z$error),logical(1))]
if(length(valid_nested)) {
  interaction_p <- vapply(nested_models[valid_nested],function(z)z$tests$p[1],numeric(1))
  interaction_adjusted <- p.adjust(interaction_p,"holm",n=length(nested_specs))
  for(k in valid_nested)nested_models[[k]]$tests$p_holm <- interaction_adjusted[k]
}

for (k in names(nested_models)) {
  z <- nested_models[[k]]
  if (!is.null(z$error)) {
    save_table(data.frame(Status = z$error), paste0("S10_", k, "_status"), nested_specs[[k]]$title)
    next
  }
  save_table(pool_fits(z$fits), paste0("S10_", k, "_coefficients"), nested_specs[[k]]$title)
  save_table(z$tests, paste0("S10_", k, "_tests"), paste(nested_specs[[k]]$title, "- overall tests"),
    "Models adjust for age, age similarity and duration. One gender-by-area interaction test is reported per outcome; Holm adjustment spans the three exploratory interaction tests (education, topic similarity and area similarity).")
  z$gaps$p_holm <- p.adjust(z$gaps$p, "holm")
  nested_models[[k]]$gaps <- z$gaps
  save_table(z$gaps, paste0("S10_", k, "_gender_gaps"), paste(nested_specs[[k]]$title, "- women minus men"),
    "Holm adjustment across the three within-area gender comparisons; pointwise 95% confidence intervals.")
  save_table(z$predictions, paste0("S10_", k, "_predicted_probabilities"), nested_specs[[k]]$title)
}
# Extensions requested in the new Results outline. Reuse each outcome's imputations.
nested_extensions <- list()
for(k in names(nested_models)) {
  base <- nested_models[[k]]
  if(!is.null(base$error))next
  for(spec in c("Meeting","Timing")) {
    variable <- if(spec=="Meeting")"meet_combined_3g" else "timing_relationship_phd_4g"
    out <- safe_analysis({
      formula <- reformulate(c("gender_c*research_area_3g",base_controls,variable),"similarity")
      fits <- lapply(base$datasets,function(dat)fit_lpm(formula,dat))
      list(fits=fits,datasets=base$datasets,N=base$N,N_complete=base$N_complete,
        predictions=group_predictions(fits,base$datasets),gaps=gender_gaps(fits,base$datasets),
        variable=variable,specification=spec,outcome=k)
    },paste(k,spec,"similarity extension"))
    nested_extensions[[paste(k,spec,sep="_")]] <- out
  }
  for(degree in 1:3) {
    spec <- c("Linear","Quadratic","Cubic")[degree]
    out <- safe_analysis({
      ds <- base$datasets
      center <- mean(vapply(ds,function(dat)mean(dat$timing_years),numeric(1)))
      ds <- lapply(ds,function(dat) {
        dat$timing_years_c <- dat$timing_years-center
        dat$timing_years_sq <- dat$timing_years_c^2
        dat$timing_years_cb <- dat$timing_years_c^3
        dat
      })
      terms <- c("timing_years_c","timing_years_sq","timing_years_cb")[seq_len(degree)]
      fits <- lapply(ds,function(dat)fit_lpm(reformulate(c("gender_c*research_area_3g",base_controls,terms),"similarity"),dat))
      test <- block_test(fits,terms)
      years <- seq(quantile(ds[[1]]$timing_years,.025),quantile(ds[[1]]$timing_years,.975),length.out=60)
      curve <- bind(lapply(years,function(year) {
        value <- year-center
        cbind(Timing_years=year,pool_contrast(fits,ds,
          list(list(timing_years_c=value,timing_years_sq=value^2,timing_years_cb=value^3)),1))
      }))
      list(fits=fits,datasets=ds,tests=test,curve=curve,N=base$N,
        specification=spec,outcome=k,terms=terms)
    },paste(k,spec,"continuous-timing similarity sensitivity"))
    nested_extensions[[paste(k,spec,sep="_")]] <- out
  }
}
```

```{r 07-tables-figures-and-sensitivity-summaries}
# reporting-helpers ----
pretty_term <- function(x) {
 x<-gsub("research_area_3g","Area: ",x,fixed=TRUE);x<-gsub("gender_c","Women minus men",x,fixed=TRUE)
 x<-gsub("meet_combined_3g","Meeting: ",x,fixed=TRUE);x<-gsub("timing_relationship_phd_4g","Timing: ",x,fixed=TRUE)
 x<-gsub("age_homogamous_c","Similar age (0–2 vs 3+ years)",x,fixed=TRUE)
 x<-gsub("cp_duration_c","Relationship duration",x,fixed=TRUE);gsub("age_c","Age",x,fixed=TRUE)
}
ci_pp <- function(z) if(!nrow(z)||anyNA(z[1,c("estimate","lower","upper")])) "not estimable" else
 sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]",100*z$estimate[1],100*z$lower[1],100*z$upper[1])
association_table <- data.frame(Variable=paste0(seq_along(continuous_matrix_labels), ". ", unname(continuous_matrix_labels)),check.names=FALSE)
for(j in seq_along(continuous_matrix_labels)) {
 col <- rep("",length(continuous_matrix_labels))
 for(i in seq_along(continuous_matrix_labels))if(i>j) {
  z<-get_assoc(assoc_mi,names(continuous_matrix_labels)[j],names(continuous_matrix_labels)[i])
  stars <- if (is.na(z$p)) "" else if (z$p < .001) "***" else if (z$p < .01) "**" else if (z$p < .05) "*" else ""
  statistic <- switch(z$measure, r_pb = "r_pb", phi = "φ", eta = "η", z$measure)
  p_text <- if (is.na(z$p)) "not estimable" else if (z$p < .001) "< 0.001" else paste0("= ", fmt(z$p, 3))
  cell <- paste0(statistic, " = ", fmt(z$strength, 2), ", p ", p_text, stars)
  cell <- esc(cell)
  cell <- if (!is.na(z$p) && z$p < .05) paste0("<strong>", cell, "</strong>") else cell
  if(is.finite(z$strength)) {
    endpoint <- if(z$strength>=0) "#91B9D7" else "#E5A49E"
    rgb_value <- grDevices::colorRamp(c("#FFFFFF",endpoint))(min(1,abs(z$strength)))
    fill <- grDevices::rgb(rgb_value[1],rgb_value[2],rgb_value[3],maxColorValue=255)
    cell <- paste0('<span style="display:block;padding:7px;background-color:',fill,
                   ';color:#243746;border-radius:3px;">',cell,'</span>')
  }
  col[i] <- cell
 }
 association_table[[as.character(j)]]<-col
}

selected_values <- function(z) {
  rr <- table1_rows(z)

  rr$Value[rr$Characteristic=="Partner minus participant age, years: M (SD)"] <-
    if(sum(!is.na(age_gap)))sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)",mean(age_gap,na.rm=TRUE),sd(age_gap,na.rm=TRUE)) else "—"
  starts <- which(rr$Indent==0L); ends <- c(starts[-1]-1L,nrow(rr))
  idx <- match(formation_blocks,rr$Characteristic[starts])
  rr$Value[unlist(lapply(idx,function(i)seq.int(starts[i],ends[i])),use.names=FALSE)]
}

format_table1_test <- function(z) {
  if(!nrow(z) || !is.finite(z$p[1]))return("Not estimable")
  stars <- if(z$p[1]<.001)"***" else if(z$p[1]<.01)"**" else if(z$p[1]<.05)"*" else ""
  paste0(switch(z$measure[1],r_pb="rₚᵦ",eta="η",phi="φ",z$measure[1])," = ",fmt(z$strength[1],2),", p ",fp(z$p[1]),stars)
}

  "Age at relationship formation, years: M (SD)"="cp_start_age",

for(k in names(group_vars)) {
  meeting <- get_assoc(assoc_mi,"meet_combined_3g",group_vars[k])
  # Categorical timing uses the primary categorical-scale imputations.
  aa <- lapply(datasets,association_one,x=unname(group_vars[k]),y="timing_relationship_phd_4g")
  tt <- pool_vectors(lapply(aa,`[[`,"Q"),lapply(aa,`[[`,"U"),aa[[1]]$df)
  timing <- data.frame(measure=aa[[1]]$measure,
    strength=mean(vapply(aa,`[[`,numeric(1),"effect")),F=tt$F,df1=tt$df1,df2=tt$df2,p=tt$p)
  formation_data[[k]][formation_data$Characteristic=="Meeting context"] <- format_table1_test(meeting)
  formation_data[[k]][formation_data$Characteristic=="Relationship formation relative to PhD completion"] <- format_table1_test(timing)
  keep_test <- function(z,label) data.frame(Variable=label,Comparison=unname(group_vars[k]),
    Measure=z$measure[1],Estimate=z$strength[1],F=z$F[1],df1=z$df1[1],df2=z$df2[1],p=z$p[1])
  table1_full_tests[[paste0(k,"_meeting")]] <- keep_test(meeting,"Meeting context")
  table1_full_tests[[paste0(k,"_timing")]] <- keep_test(timing,"Categorical formation timing")
  table1_cat_tests[[k]] <- c(meeting=meeting$p[1],timing=timing$p[1])
  table1_cont_tests[[k]] <- setNames(rep(NA_real_,length(continuous_table1_vars)),names(continuous_table1_vars))
  for(label in names(continuous_table1_vars)) {
    # Fit continuous response on grouping factor: tests mean differences with HC3 variance.
    aa_cont <- lapply(bivariate_datasets,association_one,
                      x=unname(group_vars[k]),y=unname(continuous_table1_vars[label]))
    tt_cont <- pool_vectors(lapply(aa_cont,`[[`,"Q"),lapply(aa_cont,`[[`,"U"),aa_cont[[1]]$df)
    zz <- data.frame(measure=aa_cont[[1]]$measure,
      strength=mean(vapply(aa_cont,`[[`,numeric(1),"effect")),
      F=tt_cont$F,df1=tt_cont$df1,df2=tt_cont$df2,p=tt_cont$p)
    # Reuse the paragraph's exact unadjusted association and pooled HC3 test.
    if(unname(continuous_table1_vars[label])=="absolute_age_difference")
      zz <- get_assoc(assoc_mi,"absolute_age_difference",unname(group_vars[k]))
    formation_data[[k]][formation_data$Characteristic==label] <- format_table1_test(zz)
    table1_cont_tests[[k]][label] <- zz$p[1]
    table1_full_tests[[paste(k,label)]] <- keep_test(zz,
      if(unname(continuous_table1_vars[label])=="absolute_age_difference")"Absolute partner age difference, years: M (SD)" else label)
  }
  table1_headings[[k]] <- "Omnibus association"
}

shade_value <- function(x) {
  if(grepl("%",x,fixed=TRUE))x <- sub(".*\\(([0-9.]+)%\\).*","\\1",x)
  else x <- sub(" .*","",x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

                      light="#FCF3F2",dark="#E5AAA5"))) {
  gt_table_formation <- gt_table_formation %>%
    gt::tab_style(style=gt::cell_fill(color=spec$light),
      locations=gt::cells_column_labels(columns=all_of(spec$cols)))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(formation_data))) {
    if(grepl("Missing",formation_data$Characteristic[i],fixed=TRUE))next
    values <- vapply(as.character(unlist(formation_data[i,spec$cols,drop=FALSE])),shade_value,numeric(1))
    ok <- is.finite(values)
    if(!any(ok))next
    span <- diff(range(values[ok]))
    intensity <- if(span>0)(values[ok]-min(values[ok]))/span else rep(0,sum(ok))
    rgb_values <- grDevices::colorRamp(c(spec$light,spec$dark))(intensity)
    fills <- grDevices::rgb(rgb_values[,1],rgb_values[,2],rgb_values[,3],maxColorValue=255)
    for(j in seq_along(fills))gt_table_formation <- gt_table_formation %>%
      gt::tab_style(style=gt::cell_fill(color=fills[j]),
        locations=gt::cells_body(columns=all_of(spec$cols[ok][j]),rows=i))
  }
}

# Standardize estimates and their HC3 variances within each imputation, then pool.
p_stars <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < .001, "***",
  ifelse(p < .01, "**", ifelse(p < .05, "*", ""))))
p_with_stars <- function(p) paste0("p ", fp(p), p_stars(p))
standardized_coefs <- lapply(interaction_fits, function(fs) {
  terms <- setdiff(names(coef(fs[[1]])), "(Intercept)")
  scales <- lapply(fs, function(f) {
    X <- model.matrix(f)
    apply(X, 2, sd) / sd(model.response(model.frame(f)))
  })
  bind(lapply(terms, function(t) cbind(term=t, pool_one(
    vapply(seq_along(fs), function(i) unname(coef(fs[[i]])[t] * scales[[i]][t]), numeric(1)),
    vapply(seq_along(fs), function(i) unname(vcov(fs[[i]])[t,t] * scales[[i]][t]^2), numeric(1)),
    nobs(fs[[1]]), length(coef(fs[[1]]))))))
})
# Exploratory M1 forest data: standardize every design column within imputation.
nested_standardized_coefs <- bind(lapply(c("PhD","Topic","Area"),function(k) {
  z <- nested_models[[k]]
  if(!is.null(z$error))return(NULL)
  fs <- z$fits
  terms <- setdiff(names(coef(fs[[1]])),"(Intercept)")
  scales <- lapply(fs,function(f) {
    X <- model.matrix(f)
    apply(X,2,sd)/sd(model.response(model.frame(f)))
  })
  q <- bind(lapply(terms,function(t)cbind(term=t,pool_one(
    vapply(seq_along(fs),function(i)unname(coef(fs[[i]])[t]*scales[[i]][t]),numeric(1)),
    vapply(seq_along(fs),function(i)unname(vcov(fs[[i]])[t,t]*scales[[i]][t]^2),numeric(1)),
    nobs(fs[[1]]),length(coef(fs[[1]]))))))
  q$Outcome <- k;q
}))
# Table 2 gender row: standardized marginal contrast, not the reference-field slope.
# Standardize within each imputation and propagate the full coefficient covariance.
standardized_gender_marginal <- lapply(interaction_fits, function(fs) {
  estimates <- lapply(seq_along(fs), function(i) {
    f <- fs[[i]]
    pw <- pair_prediction(f, datasets[[i]], list(gender_c=.5))
    pm <- pair_prediction(f, datasets[[i]], list(gender_c=-.5))
    L <- pw$L-pm$L
    scale <- sd(model.matrix(f)[,"gender_c"]) / sd(model.response(model.frame(f)))
    c(Q=(pw$Q-pm$Q)*scale,
      U=as.numeric(crossprod(L,vcov(f)%*%L))*scale^2)
  })
  pool_one(vapply(estimates,`[[`,numeric(1),"Q"),
           vapply(estimates,`[[`,numeric(1),"U"),
           nobs(fs[[1]]),length(coef(fs[[1]])))
})
all_terms <- unique(unlist(lapply(standardized_coefs, function(z) z$term)))
model_table <- data.frame(Predictor=ifelse(all_terms=="gender_c", "Women minus men (overall adjusted; standardized contrast)", pretty_term(all_terms)), check.names=FALSE)
for (k in names(standardized_coefs)) {
  z <- standardized_coefs[[k]]
  model_table[[paste(k, model_titles[k])]] <- vapply(all_terms, function(t) {
    q <- if(t=="gender_c") standardized_gender_marginal[[k]] else z[z$term==t, ]
    if (!nrow(q)) return("—")
    cell <- esc(paste0(fmt(q$estimate,3), " [", fmt(q$lower,3), ", ", fmt(q$upper,3),
      "]; ", p_with_stars(q$p)))
    if (!is.na(q$p) && q$p < .05) paste0("<strong>",cell,"</strong>") else cell
  }, character(1))
}
# Full-model ordinary R-squared, summarized descriptively across imputations.
# HC3 changes inference, not fitted values or this goodness-of-fit measure.
model_r_squared <- vapply(interaction_fits, function(fs) {
  values <- vapply(fs, function(f) {
    y <- model.response(model.frame(f))
    sst <- sum((y-mean(y))^2)
    if(!is.finite(sst) || sst<=0) stop("R-squared requires outcome variation.")
    1-sum(residuals(f)^2)/sst
  }, numeric(1))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(values)))
  mean(values)
}, numeric(1))
r_squared_row <- model_table[1,,drop=FALSE]
r_squared_row$Predictor <- "R² (full model; mean across imputations)"
for(k in names(model_r_squared))
  r_squared_row[[paste(k,model_titles[k])]] <- fmt(model_r_squared[[k]],3)
model_table <- rbind(model_table,r_squared_row)
# Adjust for fitted model complexity within each imputation before averaging.
model_adjusted_r_squared <- vapply(interaction_fits, function(fs) {
  values <- vapply(fs, function(f) {
    y <- model.response(model.frame(f))
    sst <- sum((y-mean(y))^2)
    residual_df <- df.residual(f)
    if(!is.finite(sst) || sst<=0 || residual_df<=0)
      stop("Adjusted R-squared requires outcome variation and positive residual degrees of freedom.")
    1-(sum(residuals(f)^2)/residual_df)/(sst/(length(y)-1))
  }, numeric(1))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(values)))
  mean(values)
}, numeric(1))
adjusted_r_squared_row <- r_squared_row
adjusted_r_squared_row$Predictor <- "Adjusted R² (full model; mean across imputations)"
for(k in names(model_adjusted_r_squared))

    if(length(supported)>0)"partially supported by one primary indirect contrast" else "not supported by the primary indirect contrasts"

}))

  Adjustment=ifelse(indirect_results$Model=="M2","Meeting context","Formation timing"),
  Contrast=indirect_results$Contrast,
  `Indirect association, pp [95% CI]`=vapply(seq_len(nrow(indirect_results)),function(i)ci_pp(indirect_results[i,]),character(1)),
  `Holm p`=fp(indirect_results$p_holm),check.names=FALSE)else data.frame()

# reporting-functions ----
report_p <- function(p) if(!length(p) || is.na(p[1])) "not estimable" else fp(p[1])
report_supported <- function(p) length(p)==1L && is.finite(p) && p<cfg$alpha
report_field <- function(a) switch(as.character(a),
  "Hum&Soc Sciences"="Humanities & Social Sciences",
  "Nat&Eng Sciences"="Natural & Engineering Sciences",as.character(a))
report_f <- function(z,holm=FALSE) {
  if(nrow(z)!=1L)return("not estimable")
  paste0("F(",fmt(z$df1,0),", ",fmt(z$df2,2),") = ",fmt(z$F,2),", ",
    if(holm)"Holm-adjusted " else "","p ",report_p(if(holm)z$p_holm else z$p))
}
report_focal <- function(k,id) focal_results[[k]][focal_results[[k]]$id==id,,drop=FALSE]
pp_sentence <- function(z,holm=FALSE) {
  if(nrow(z)!=1L)return("not estimable")
  paste0(fmt(100*z$estimate,1)," percentage points (95% CI [",
    fmt(100*z$lower,1),", ",fmt(100*z$upper,1),"], ",
    if(holm)"Holm-adjusted " else "","p ",report_p(if(holm)z$p_holm else z$p),")")
}
report_pp <- pp_sentence
effect_sentence <- function(z)paste0(fmt(100*z$estimate,1),
  " percentage points (95% CI [",fmt(100*z$lower,1),", ",fmt(100*z$upper,1),"])")
brief_decision <- function(x)if(startsWith(x,"partially"))"partially supported" else
  if(startsWith(x,"supported"))"supported" else "not supported"
report_beta <- function(k,term) {
  z<-standardized_coefs[[k]]
  z<-z[z$term==term,,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(z)!=1L)return("not estimable")
  paste0("β = ",fmt(z$estimate,3),", 95% CI [",fmt(z$lower,3),", ",
    fmt(z$upper,3),"], p ",report_p(z$p))
}
# Marginal tests use common prediction distributions and the full HC3 covariance.
overall_tests <- function(fs,ds) {
  g<-pool_contrast(fs,ds,list(list(gender_c=.5),list(gender_c=-.5)),c(1,-1))
  gender<-data.frame(Association="Gender",F=(g$estimate/g$SE)^2,df1=1,df2=g$df,p=g$p)
  # Effect-coded gender makes the area block an equal-gender marginal test.
  area<-cbind(Association="Research area",
    block_test(fs,term_columns(fs[[1]],"research_area_3g")))
  rbind(gender,area)
}
# Attach hypothesis-matched descriptive effect sizes while retaining pooled HC3 F/p.
eta_note <- "Generalized eta-squared is SS_effect / (SS_residual + sum of SS for all observed effects), excluding the intercept. Hypothesis sums of squares use ordinary least-squares model geometry with all predictors designated observed. Gender SS uses the reported sample-standardized marginal contrast; area SS uses equal-gender marginal contrasts; interaction and covariate SS use the reported coefficient blocks. Values are calculated within imputations and averaged descriptively, not Rubin-pooled, with no inferential CIs. HC3/Rubin F tests remain unchanged; generalized eta-squared is not obtained by converting those F statistics. Generalized eta-squared is displayed only for significant omnibus tests (using the reported p-value adjustment)."
main_omnibus_tests <- bind(lapply(names(interaction_fits),function(k) {
  fs <- interaction_fits[[k]]
  labels <- attr(terms(fs[[1]]),"term.labels")
  bind(lapply(labels,function(term) {
    test <- if(term=="gender_c") {
      q <- pool_contrast(fs,datasets,list(list(gender_c=.5),list(gender_c=-.5)),c(1,-1))
      data.frame(F=(q$estimate/q$SE)^2,df1=1,df2=q$df,p=q$p)
    } else block_test(fs,term_columns(fs[[1]],term))
    cbind(Model=k,Term=term,add_generalized_eta(test,fs,term,datasets))
  }))
}))
interaction_tests$eta2_generalized <- NA_real_
for(k in names(interaction_fits))interaction_tests$eta2_generalized[interaction_tests$model==k] <-
  mean_generalized_eta(interaction_fits[[k]],"gender_c:research_area_3g",datasets)
save_table(main_omnibus_tests,"S3_omnibus_effect_sizes","Omnibus tests and generalized eta-squared for every term in M1–M3",eta_note)
save_table(interaction_tests,"S4_gender_area_interactions","Gender-by-area interaction tests",eta_note)
main_overall_tests<-overall_tests(interaction_fits$M1,datasets)
main_overall_tests$eta2_generalized <- vapply(c("gender_c","research_area_3g"),
  function(term)mean_generalized_eta(interaction_fits$M1,term,datasets),numeric(1))
nested_overall_tests<-lapply(nested_models,function(z)
  if(is.null(z$error))overall_tests(z$fits,z$datasets) else data.frame())
for(k in names(nested_models))if(is.null(nested_models[[k]]$error)) {
  z <- nested_models[[k]]
  nested_overall_tests[[k]]$eta2_generalized <- vapply(c("gender_c","research_area_3g"),
    function(term)mean_generalized_eta(z$fits,term,z$datasets),numeric(1))
  nested_models[[k]]$tests <- add_generalized_eta(z$tests,z$fits,"gender_c:research_area_3g",z$datasets)
  save_table(nested_models[[k]]$tests,paste0("S10_",k,"_tests"),
    paste(nested_specs[[k]]$title,"- gender-by-area interaction"),eta_note)
}
save_table(bind(c(list(cbind(Outcome="Occupational homogamy",main_overall_tests)),
  lapply(names(nested_overall_tests),function(k)
    if(nrow(nested_overall_tests[[k]]))cbind(Outcome=k,nested_overall_tests[[k]])))),
  "S3_overall_tests","Overall adjusted gender and research-area tests",
  paste("Ancillary marginal tests from the existing fitted models. Unadjusted p-values; these do not add primary hypotheses.",eta_note))
```
