# Full sensitivity analyses for separate linear, quadratic and cubic timing models.
polynomial_extra_plan <- expand.grid(Degree=c("Linear","Quadratic","Cubic"),
  Specification=c("Primary","Complete cases","Complete-case exclusions","Imputed exclusions","Logistic","Without duration"),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
polynomial_extra_plan <- polynomial_extra_plan[!(polynomial_extra_plan$Specification=="Primary" &
  polynomial_extra_plan$Degree%in%c("Quadratic","Cubic")),,drop=FALSE]
polynomial_results <- polynomial_status <- polynomial_coefs <- polynomial_tests <- polynomial_probabilities <- polynomial_pairwise <- data.frame()
polynomial_terms <- list(Linear="timing_years_c",Quadratic=c("timing_years_c","timing_years_sq"),
  Cubic=c("timing_years_c","timing_years_sq","timing_years_cube"))
polynomial_raw <- analysis_data[all.vars(base_formula)]
polynomial_raw$timing_years <- num(d$timing_relationship_phd_continuous)
polynomial_cc <- polynomial_raw[complete.cases(polynomial_raw),,drop=FALSE]
polynomial_cc_keep <- !as.character(d$participant_id[complete.cases(polynomial_raw)])%in%cc_excluded
polynomial_excluded <- safe_analysis(make_imputations(polynomial_raw[mi_keep,,drop=FALSE]),"Polynomial timing exclusions")
polynomial_data <- function(raw)lapply(raw,function(z) {
  z$timing_years_c <- (z$timing_years-quadratic_timing$center)/10
  z$timing_years_sq <- z$timing_years_c^2;z$timing_years_cube <- z$timing_years_c^3;z
})
polynomial_logistic_indirect <- function(ds,reduced,full,terms,sp) {
  one <- lapply(seq_along(ds),function(i) {
    f0<-reduced[[i]];f1<-full[[i]];X<-model.matrix(f0);X1<-model.matrix(f1)
    Z<-X1[,terms,drop=FALSE]
    design<-lapply(sp$settings,function(st) {
      nd<-ds[[i]]
      for(v in names(st))nd[[v]]<-if(is.factor(nd[[v]]))factor(rep(st[[v]],nrow(nd)),levels=levels(nd[[v]])) else rep(st[[v]],nrow(nd))
      colMeans(model.matrix(delete.response(stats::terms(f0)),nd,contrasts.arg=f0$contrasts))
    })
    L<-Reduce(`+`,Map(function(x,w)x*w,design,sp$weights))
    af<-lm.fit(X,Z);A<-matrix(af$coefficients,nrow=ncol(X));E<-matrix(af$residuals,nrow=nrow(X))
    a<-drop(L%*%A);b<-coef(f1)[terms];mu<-fitted(f1)
    slope<-mean(mu*(1-mu));path<-sum(a*b)
    bread<-X%*%solve(crossprod(X));h<-rowSums(bread*X)
    ia<-sapply(seq_len(ncol(Z)),function(j)drop(bread%*%L)*E[,j]/(1-h))
    ib<-f1$ava_influence
    gb<-path*colMeans(X1*(mu*(1-mu)*(1-2*mu)))
    gb[match(terms,colnames(X1))]<-gb[match(terms,colnames(X1))]+a*slope
    gradient<-c(b*slope,gb)
    list(Q=path*slope,U=as.numeric(crossprod(gradient,crossprod(cbind(ia,ib))%*%gradient)),n=nobs(f1),k=length(coef(f1)))
  })
  pool_one(vapply(one,`[[`,numeric(1),"Q"),vapply(one,`[[`,numeric(1),"U"),one[[1]]$n,one[[1]]$k)
}
for(degree in names(polynomial_terms))for(spec in c("Primary","Complete cases","Complete-case exclusions","Imputed exclusions","Logistic","Without duration")) {
  label<-paste(degree,"timing:",spec);terms<-polynomial_terms[[degree]]
  rr<-safe_analysis({
    if(!is.null(quadratic_timing$error))stop(quadratic_timing$error)
    raw<-switch(spec,"Complete cases"=list(polynomial_cc),
      "Complete-case exclusions"=list(polynomial_cc[polynomial_cc_keep,,drop=FALSE]),
      "Imputed exclusions"={if(!is.null(polynomial_excluded$error))stop(polynomial_excluded$error);polynomial_excluded$data},
      quadratic_timing$datasets)
    ds<-polynomial_data(raw)
    baseline<-if(spec=="Without duration")update(base_formula,.~.-cp_duration_c) else base_formula
    formula<-reformulate(c(attr(stats::terms(baseline),"term.labels"),terms),"cp_academic_couple_c")
    fit<-if(spec=="Logistic")fit_logit else fit_lpm
    fs<-lapply(ds,function(z)fit(formula,z));reduced<-lapply(ds,function(z)fit(baseline,z))
    tests<-rbind(overall_tests(fs,ds),cbind(Association="Gender × research area",
      block_test(fs,grep(":",names(coef(fs[[1]])),value=TRUE))),
      cbind(Association="Timing jointly",block_test(fs,terms)),
      cbind(Association="Highest-order timing term",block_test(fs,tail(terms,1))))
    for(v in intersect(base_controls,names(coef(fs[[1]]))))tests<-rbind(tests,
      cbind(Association=v,block_test(fs,v)))
    preds<-group_predictions(fs,ds)
    cells<-expand.grid(area=field_levels,gender=c(-.5,.5),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    pairs<-bind(lapply(combn(1:6,2,simplify=FALSE),function(ij) {
      settings<-lapply(ij,function(j)list(gender_c=cells$gender[j],research_area_3g=cells$area[j]))
      q<-pool_contrast(fs,ds,settings,c(1,-1))
      cbind(Group1=paste(ifelse(cells$gender[ij[1]]<0,"Men","Women"),cells$area[ij[1]]),
        Group2=paste(ifelse(cells$gender[ij[2]]<0,"Men","Women"),cells$area[ij[2]]),q)
    }))
    pairs$p_Tukey<-ptukey(sqrt(2)*abs(pairs$estimate/pairs$SE),6,pairs$df,lower.tail=FALSE)
    indirect<-bind(lapply(indirect_ids,function(id) {
      q<-if(spec=="Logistic")polynomial_logistic_indirect(ds,reduced,fs,terms,focal[[id]]) else
        indirect_for_contrast(ds,reduced,fs,terms,focal[[id]])$total
      cbind(Specification=label,Model="M3",id=id,Contrast=focal[[id]]$label,
        Method=if(spec=="Logistic")"Logistic average-derivative probability product" else "Polynomial linear probability product",
        N=nrow(ds[[1]]),Imputations=length(ds),q)
    }))
    indirect$p_holm<-p.adjust(indirect$p,"holm",n=length(indirect_ids))
    list(coefs=pool_fits(fs),tests=tests,probabilities=preds,pairs=pairs,
      contrasts=contrast_table(fs,ds),indirect=indirect,N=nrow(ds[[1]]))
  },label)
  extra<-any(polynomial_extra_plan$Degree==degree & polynomial_extra_plan$Specification==spec)
  if(extra)indirect_check_plan<-rbind(indirect_check_plan,data.frame(Specification=label,Model="M3",Reference="Primary"))
  if(!is.null(rr$error)) {
    polynomial_status<-rbind(polynomial_status,data.frame(Degree=degree,Specification=spec,Status=rr$error))
    if(extra)indirect_sensitivity_status<-rbind(indirect_sensitivity_status,data.frame(Specification=label,Model="M3",Status=rr$error))
  } else {
    polynomial_coefs<-rbind(polynomial_coefs,cbind(Degree=degree,Specification=spec,rr$coefs))
    polynomial_tests<-rbind(polynomial_tests,cbind(Degree=degree,Specification=spec,rr$tests))
    polynomial_probabilities<-rbind(polynomial_probabilities,cbind(Degree=degree,Specification=spec,rr$probabilities))
    polynomial_pairwise<-rbind(polynomial_pairwise,cbind(Degree=degree,Specification=spec,rr$pairs))
    if(extra) {
      sensitivity_pairs[[label]]<-list(alt=rr$contrasts,main=primary_sensitivity$M3)
      indirect_sensitivity<-rbind(indirect_sensitivity,
        compare_indirect(rr$indirect,indirect_results[indirect_results$Model=="M3",,drop=FALSE],"Primary"))
    }
    polynomial_results<-rbind(polynomial_results,data.frame(Degree=degree,Specification=spec,N=rr$N,Status="Completed"))
  }
}

sensitivity_summary <- bind(lapply(names(sensitivity_pairs),function(nm) {
  zz <- sensitivity_pairs[[nm]]; ids <- intersect(zz$alt$id,zz$main$id)
  ids <- ids[grepl("^overall$|^gender_|^gap_|^H2_target_",ids)]
  a <- zz$alt[match(ids,zz$alt$id),,drop=FALSE]; b <- zz$main[match(ids,zz$main$id),,drop=FALSE]
  data.frame(Specification=nm,id=a$id,Reference=if(startsWith(nm,"Exclusions within complete cases"))"Complete cases" else "Primary",Contrast=a$Contrast,
    Change_pp=100*abs(a$estimate-b$estimate),
    Sign_reversal=a$estimate*b$estimate<0,
    Threshold_change=(a$p_holm<cfg$alpha)!=(b$p_holm<cfg$alpha),
    Both_nonsignificant=a$p_holm>=cfg$alpha & b$p_holm>=cfg$alpha)
}))

  expected <- if(prefix%in%c("Quadratic timing","Cubic timing",polynomial_extra_labels))length(focal) else
    sum(vapply(models,function(k)nrow(primary_sensitivity[[k]]),integer(1)))
  delta <- vapply(c("M1","M2","M3"),function(k) {
    if(!k %in% models)return("—")
    zz <- z[valid & (endsWith(z$Specification,k) | (prefix=="M3 without duration" & k=="M3") | (prefix%in%polynomial_extra_labels & k=="M3")),,drop=FALSE]
    if(!nrow(zz))return("Unavailable")
    paste0(fmt(max(zz$Change_pp),1),if(nrow(zz)<nrow(primary_sensitivity[[k]]))"*" else "")
  },character(1))
  data.frame(Check=spec[1],Reference=spec[2],`M1 Δ max`=delta[1],`M2 Δ max`=delta[2],`M3 Δ max`=delta[3],
    Verified=paste0(sum(valid),"/",expected),
    `Significance changes`=if(any(valid))as.character(sum(z$Threshold_change[valid])) else "Unavailable",
    `Direction reversals`=if(any(valid))as.character(sum(z$Sign_reversal[valid])) else "Unavailable",check.names=FALSE)
}))

    is.na(indirect_sensitivity$Threshold_change) | is.na(indirect_sensitivity$Support_change) |
    indirect_sensitivity$Threshold_change | indirect_sensitivity$Support_change),,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(indirect_exceptions))save_table(indirect_exceptions,"S5_indirect_exceptions",
    "Changed or unverified indirect conclusions",indirect_check_note)
}

                           " (N = ",desc_groups$N,")")
desc_subset <- function(i) df[df$gender.factor %in% desc_groups$Gender[i] &
  (desc_groups$Status[i]=="Total" | df$cp_academic_couple %in% desc_groups$Status[i]) & df$research_area_3g %in% desc_groups$Area[i],,drop=FALSE]
desc_base <- function(dat,title,show_groups=FALSE) {
  ggplot(dat)+scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,max(desc_groups$row_y)+2),breaks=desc_groups$row_y,
    labels=if(show_groups)desc_groups$label else rep("",nrow(desc_groups)),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0)))+
    geom_hline(yintercept=seq(10.5,max(desc_groups$row_y),by=10),colour="#AEB4BA",linewidth=.35)+
    geom_hline(yintercept=seq(5,max(desc_groups$row_y),by=10),colour="#D5DADF",linetype="dotted",linewidth=.25)+
    labs(title=title,y=NULL,x=NULL)+theme_minimal(base_size=12)+
    theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),axis.text.y=element_text(size=11),
          axis.text.x=element_text(size=10),axis.ticks=element_blank(),
          plot.title=element_text(size=13,face="bold",hjust=.5),
          legend.position="bottom",legend.justification="left",legend.text=element_text(size=10),
          legend.title=element_text(size=11),legend.key.height=grid::unit(.40,"cm"),
          plot.margin=margin(8,9,8,9))
}
desc_headers <- function(p,left,show_groups) p
left_desc_headers <- function(p) {
  g <- patchwork::patchworkGrob(p)
  panels <- g$layout[grepl("^panel-[0-9]+$",g$layout$name),,drop=FALSE]
  stopifnot(nrow(panels)>0L)
  label_cols <- g$layout$l[grepl("^axis-l-[0-9]+$",g$layout$name)]
  left_col <- min(c(panels$l,label_cols))
  statuses <- unique(desc_groups$Status)
  labels <- vapply(statuses,function(x)switch(x,Total="Total",`In Academic Couple`="Academic couples",`In Non-Academic Couple`="Non-academic couples",x),character(1))
  positions <- vapply(statuses,function(x)max(desc_groups$row_y[desc_groups$Status==x])+1.375,numeric(1))
  upper <- max(desc_groups$row_y)+2
  heading <- grid::textGrob(labels,x=0,y=(positions-1)/(upper-1),just="left",
    gp=grid::gpar(fontsize=16,fontface="bold",col="#252525"))
  gtable::gtable_add_grob(g,heading,t=min(panels$t),b=max(panels$b),
    l=left_col,r=max(panels$r),z=Inf,clip="off",name="couple-type-headings")
}
# Actual observed categorical counts; structural inapplicability is never a category.
make_desc_category <- function(sp,show_groups=FALSE,similarity=FALSE) {
  if(identical(sp$type,"unavailable"))return(
    desc_base(data.frame(),sp$label,show_groups)+
      annotate("text",x=50,y=mean(desc_groups$row_y),label="No observed data available",size=4)+
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,100),breaks=NULL))
  zz <- bind(lapply(seq_len(nrow(desc_groups)),function(i) {
    z <- desc_subset(i)
    if(similarity) {
      if(desc_groups$Status[i]=="In Academic Couple") {
        raw <- as.character(z$partner_topic_academic)
        levels <- c("Same/similar topics(s)","Different topics in same area","Different areas")
        labels <- c("Same/similar topics","Different topics, same area","Different research areas")
      } else {
        raw <- as.character(z$partner_education_nonacademic)
        levels <- c("Partner has a doctorate","Partner has no doctorate")
        labels <- c("Partner with PhD","Partner without PhD")
      }
    } else {raw <- as.character(z[[sp$v]]);levels <- sp$levels;labels <- sp$short}
    counts <- vapply(levels,function(v)sum(raw==v,na.rm=TRUE),integer(1))
    den <- sum(counts);percent <- if(den)100*counts/den else rep(NA_real_,length(counts))
    right <- cumsum(percent)
    data.frame(row_y=desc_groups$row_y[i],Category=labels,n=counts,percent=percent,
      left=c(0,head(right,-1)),right=right)
  }))
  palette <- if(similarity)c("Same/similar topics"="#398F87","Different topics, same area"="#9CBFB4",
    "Different research areas"="#CDE0D9","Partner with PhD"="#8864A8","Partner without PhD"="#DACCE7") else
    setNames(if(!is.null(sp$palette))sp$palette else
      if(sp$v=="meet_combined_3g")c("#D99B55","#E6C39B","#E9E2D7") else
      c("#385D85","#739ABD","#B1CBDD","#DDE9F0"),sp$short)
  zz$Category <- factor(zz$Category,levels=names(palette))
  zz$label <- ifelse(zz$n==0,"",ifelse(zz$percent<18,
    paste0(zz$n,"\n",sprintf("%.1f",zz$percent),"%"),
    paste0(zz$n," (",sprintf("%.1f",zz$percent),"%)")))
  zz$text_colour <- ifelse(as.character(zz$Category)=="≥5 years before","white","#243746")
  pp <- desc_base(zz,if(similarity)"Partner similarity" else sp$label,show_groups)+
    geom_rect(aes(xmin=left,xmax=right,ymin=row_y-.33,ymax=row_y+.33,fill=Category),
      colour="white",linewidth=.25,na.rm=TRUE)+
    geom_text(aes(x=(left+right)/2,y=row_y,label=label,colour=text_colour),size=2.9,lineheight=.85,na.rm=TRUE)+
    scale_colour_identity()+scale_fill_manual(values=palette,drop=FALSE,name=NULL,
      labels=function(x)stringr::str_wrap(x,32))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,100),breaks=c(0,50,100),labels=function(x)paste0(x,"%"),
      expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0)))+guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,byrow=TRUE))
  desc_headers(pp,0,show_groups)
}
make_desc_continuous <- function(sp,show_groups=FALSE) {
  zz <- bind(lapply(seq_len(nrow(desc_groups)),function(i) {
    x <- num(desc_subset(i)[[sp$v]]);x <- x[is.finite(x)];n <- length(x)
    data.frame(row_y=desc_groups$row_y[i],Gender=ifelse(desc_groups$Gender[i]=="Man","Men","Women"),
      n=n,Mean=if(n)mean(x) else NA_real_,SD=if(n>1)sd(x) else NA_real_)
  }))
  zz$Gender <- factor(zz$Gender,levels=c("Men","Women"))
  zz$label <- ifelse(zz$n>0,sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)",zz$Mean,zz$SD),"No data")
  bounds <- range(c(zz$Mean-zz$SD,zz$Mean+zz$SD,zz$Mean),finite=TRUE)
  if(!all(is.finite(bounds)))bounds <- c(0,1)
  pad <- max(diff(bounds)*.1,.5)
  pp <- desc_base(zz,sp$label,show_groups)
  if(sp$v %in% c("final_age_diff","timing_relationship_phd_continuous"))
    pp <- pp+geom_vline(xintercept=0,colour="#B6C1CA",linetype="dashed",linewidth=.35)
  pp <- pp+geom_segment(aes(x=Mean-SD,xend=Mean+SD,y=row_y+.10,yend=row_y+.10,colour=Gender),
                       linewidth=.45,na.rm=TRUE)+
    geom_point(aes(x=Mean,y=row_y+.10,colour=Gender,shape=Gender),size=2.2,na.rm=TRUE)+
    geom_text(aes(x=Mean,y=row_y-.25,label=label),size=2.8,colour="#425464",na.rm=TRUE)+
    scale_colour_manual(values=c(Men="#426C91",Women="#C76158"),name=NULL)+
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(Men=16,Women=18),name=NULL)+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=bounds+c(-pad,pad),breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(n=3))
  pp <- pp+guides(colour="none",shape="none")+labs(x="years")
  desc_headers(pp,bounds[1]-pad,show_groups)
}

supp_category <- function(v,label,palette="Set 2") {
  x <- df[[v]]
  lev <- if(is.factor(x))levels(droplevels(x)) else sort(unique(as.character(x[!is.na(x)])))
  if(!length(lev)) {
    warning("Figure S1: no observed values available for ",v)
    return(list(v=v,label=label,type="unavailable",levels=character(0),short=character(0)))
  }
  list(v=v,label=label,type="categorical",levels=lev,short=lev,
       palette=grDevices::hcl.colors(length(lev),palette=palette))
}
supp_cont <- function(i,label) {sp <- desc_specs[[i]];sp$label <- label;sp}

  ref<-phd_field_probabilities[phd_field_probabilities$Area==field_levels[1],,drop=FALSE]
  comparisons<-paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(phd_field_contrasts)),function(i) {
    z<-phd_field_contrasts[i,,drop=FALSE]
    pr<-phd_field_probabilities[phd_field_probabilities$Area==z$Area,,drop=FALSE]
    paste0(fmt(100*pr$estimate,1),"% in ",report_field(z$Area),
      " (difference: ",pp_sentence(z,TRUE),")")
  },character(1)),collapse=", and ")
  same_status<-report_supported(gt$p)==report_supported(phd$tests$p_holm)
  gender_interaction<-if(same_status)paste0(
    "Gender-related tests (",report_f(gt),") and the gender-by-area interaction (",
    report_f(phd$tests,TRUE),") were ",
    if(report_supported(gt$p))"significant." else "non-significant.") else paste0(
    "The gender-related test was ",if(report_supported(gt$p))"significant" else "non-significant",
    " (",report_f(gt),"), and the gender-by-area interaction was ",
    if(report_supported(phd$tests$p_holm))"significant" else "non-significant",
    " (",report_f(phd$tests,TRUE),").")
  paste0("Among non-academic couples (n = ",phd$N,"), we also ",
    if(report_supported(at$p))"found a significant main effect of professors’ main research area" else
      "examined professors’ main research area",
    " in predicting partner similarity in education (",report_f(at),"). Relative to Humanities & Social Sciences (",
    fmt(100*ref$estimate,1),"%), adjusted probabilities of reporting a partner with a PhD degree were ",
    comparisons,". ",gender_interaction)
}

  tests<-nested_overall_tests$Topic
  gt<-tests[tests$Association=="Gender",,drop=FALSE]

  all_nonsignificant<-!report_supported(gt$p) && !report_supported(at$p) &&
    !report_supported(topic_model$tests$p_holm)
  paste0("Among academic couples (n = ",topic_model$N,"), topic similarity ",
    if(all_nonsignificant)"did not differ significantly by" else "was examined by",

}

checks <- list()
add_claim <- function(claim,pass) {
  checks[[length(checks)+1L]] <<- data.frame(Statement=claim,
    Verified=length(pass)==1L && !is.na(pass) && isTRUE(pass))
}
add_claim("M1 gender-by-area interaction is significant",report_supported(it1$p))
add_claim("Meeting context is significantly associated with occupational homogamy",
  report_supported(formation_omnibus$p[formation_omnibus$Model=="M2"]))
add_claim("Formation timing omnibus association is non-significant",
  !report_supported(formation_omnibus$p[formation_omnibus$Model=="M3"]))
add_claim("Meeting indirect association is positive and significant for Natural & Engineering Sciences",
  meeting_nat$estimate>0 && report_supported(meeting_nat$p_holm))
add_claim("Meeting indirect association is non-significant for Life Sciences",!report_supported(meeting_life$p_holm))
add_claim("Both timing indirect associations are non-significant",
  all(is.finite(c(timing_life$p_holm,timing_nat$p_holm))) &&
    !report_supported(timing_life$p_holm) && !report_supported(timing_nat$p_holm))
add_claim("All three occupational-homogamy bivariate covariate associations are significant",
  nrow(baseline_bivariate)==3L && all(is.finite(baseline_bivariate$p) & baseline_bivariate$p<cfg$alpha))
add_claim("Occupational-homogamy bivariate directions: younger age, larger absolute age gap, shorter duration",
  nrow(baseline_bivariate)==3L && all(sign(baseline_bivariate$estimate)==c(-1,1,-1)))
baseline_rows <- coefs$M1[match(base_controls,coefs$M1$term),,drop=FALSE]
add_claim("None of the three covariates is significant independently in M1",
  all(is.finite(baseline_rows$p) & baseline_rows$p>=cfg$alpha))
add_claim("Shorter duration is significant in M2",
  report_supported(duration_test$p) && coefs$M2$estimate[coefs$M2$term=="cp_duration_c"]<0)
add_claim("Duration is non-significant in M3",!report_supported(coefs$M3$p[coefs$M3$term=="cp_duration_c"]))
add_claim("All three educational-homogamy bivariate covariate associations are significant",
  nrow(education_bivariate)==3L && all(is.finite(education_bivariate$p) & education_bivariate$p<cfg$alpha))
if(is.null(phd$error) && is.null(topic_model$error)) {
  ptests <- nested_overall_tests$PhD; ttests <- nested_overall_tests$Topic
  add_claim("Exploratory partner-education research-area association is significant",

  add_claim("Exploratory partner-education gender and interaction tests are non-significant",
    !report_supported(ptests$p[ptests$Association=="Gender"]) && !report_supported(phd$tests$p_holm))
  add_claim("Exploratory topic-similarity gender, area and interaction tests are non-significant",
    all(is.finite(ttests$p) & ttests$p>=cfg$alpha) && !report_supported(topic_model$tests$p_holm))
}
author_claim_checks <- bind(checks)
save_table(author_claim_checks,"S3_report_claim_checks","Checks of supplied Results wording",
  "FALSE identifies a supplied expected pattern not verified by the current analysis. The generated Results use current estimates and computed significance statuses.")

# Six maxima are checked independently; failed or missing analyses are never counted as stable.
author_robustness_checks <- bind(lapply(c("field","meeting","timing"),function(kind)
  bind(lapply(indirect_ids,function(id) {
    if(kind=="field") {
      z <- gender_sensitivity[gender_sensitivity$id==id,,drop=FALSE]
      valid <- is.finite(z$Change_pp) & !is.na(z$Threshold_change)
      expected <- length(indirect_check_specs)*length(model_formulas)+1L+as.integer(exists("quadratic_timing"))+as.integer(exists("cubic_timing"))+if(exists("polynomial_extra_plan"))nrow(polynomial_extra_plan) else 0L
      changes <- if(any(valid))sum(z$Threshold_change[valid]) else NA_integer_
    } else {
      k <- if(kind=="meeting")"M2" else "M3"
      z <- indirect_sensitivity[indirect_sensitivity$Reference=="Primary" &
        indirect_sensitivity$Model==k & indirect_sensitivity$id==id,,drop=FALSE]
      valid <- is.finite(z$Change_pp) & !is.na(z$Threshold_change) & !is.na(z$Support_change)
      expected <- sum(indirect_check_plan$Reference=="Primary" & indirect_check_plan$Model==k)
      changes <- if(any(valid))sum(z$Threshold_change[valid]) else NA_integer_
    }
    complete <- sum(valid)==expected
    data.frame(Association=kind,Contrast=focal[[id]]$label,
      Maximum_change_pp=if(any(valid))max(z$Change_pp[valid]) else NA_real_,
      Available=sum(valid),Expected=expected,All_checks_completed=complete,
      Significance_changes=changes,
      Unchanged_significance_verified=complete && !is.na(changes) && changes==0)
  }))))
save_table(author_robustness_checks,"S5_report_claim_checks","Verification of robustness claims",
  "Maxima use only comparisons with the corresponding primary estimates. Comparisons against complete cases are not displayed; all reader-facing sensitivity contrasts use the corresponding primary model as their reference. The six values are generated from the current refits, rather than hard-coded 6.6. A statement of unchanged significance is verified only when every expected check completed and none changed significance.")
unverified_claims <- author_claim_checks$Statement[!author_claim_checks$Verified]
unverified_robustness <- author_robustness_checks$Contrast[!author_robustness_checks$Unchanged_significance_verified]
if(length(unverified_claims) || length(unverified_robustness))warning(
  "Supplied Results wording contains statements not verified by this render. See the internal wording checks. The generated Results use current estimates and computed significance statuses.")

# Overall outcome probabilities and adjusted categorical circumstance distributions.
formation_predictions <- function(k) {
  variable <- av_variables[[k]]
  bind(lapply(levels(datasets[[1]][[variable]]),function(value)
    cbind(setting=value,pool_contrast(interaction_fits[[k]],datasets,list(setNames(list(value),variable)),1))))
}
formation_response_predictions <- function(k) {
  av <- av_variables[[k]];rhs <- c("gender_c*research_area_3g",base_controls)
  fits <- av_response_fits[[k]];lev <- levels(datasets[[1]][[av]])
  bind(lapply(field_levels,function(a)bind(lapply(c(-.5,.5),function(g)
    bind(lapply(seq_along(lev),function(j) {
      parts <- lapply(seq_along(fits),function(i) {
        z <- datasets[[i]];z$gender_c <- g
        z$research_area_3g <- factor(rep(a,nrow(z)),levels=field_levels)
        L <- colMeans(model.matrix(reformulate(rhs),z));f <- fits[[i]]
        w <- if(j==1L)rep(-1,length(lev)-1L) else as.numeric(seq_len(length(lev)-1L)==j-1L)
        gradient <- as.vector(outer(L,w))
        c(Q=as.numeric(j==1L)+sum(gradient*f$Q),U=as.numeric(crossprod(gradient,f$U%*%gradient)))
      })
      cbind(area=a,gender=ifelse(g==-.5,"Men","Women"),setting=lev[j],
        pool_one(vapply(parts,`[`,numeric(1),"Q"),vapply(parts,`[`,numeric(1),"U"),
          nrow(datasets[[1]]),ncol(fits[[1]]$X)))
    }))))))
}
# Category-specific circumstance contrasts share the joint indicator-model covariance.
# In particular, the reference category (Other) equals 1 minus all other indicators.
formation_response_contrast <- function(k, category, settings, weights) {
  av <- av_variables[[k]]; rhs <- c("gender_c*research_area_3g",base_controls)
  fits <- av_response_fits[[k]]; lev <- levels(datasets[[1]][[av]])
  j <- match(category,lev)
  stopifnot(!is.na(j),length(settings)==length(weights))
  parts <- lapply(seq_along(fits),function(i) {
    f <- fits[[i]]
    design <- lapply(settings,function(setting) {
      nd <- datasets[[i]]
      for(v in names(setting)) nd[[v]] <- if(is.factor(nd[[v]]))
        factor(rep(setting[[v]],nrow(nd)),levels=levels(nd[[v]])) else rep(setting[[v]],nrow(nd))
      colMeans(model.matrix(reformulate(rhs),nd))
    })
    L <- Reduce(`+`,Map(function(x,w)x*w,design,weights))
    w <- if(j==1L)rep(-1,length(lev)-1L) else as.numeric(seq_len(length(lev)-1L)==j-1L)
    gradient <- as.vector(outer(L,w))
    c(Q=as.numeric(j==1L)*sum(weights)+sum(gradient*f$Q),
      U=as.numeric(crossprod(gradient,f$U%*%gradient)))
  })
  pool_one(vapply(parts,`[`,numeric(1),"Q"),vapply(parts,`[`,numeric(1),"U"),
    nrow(datasets[[1]]),ncol(fits[[1]]$X))
}
response_setting <- function(a,g)list(research_area_3g=a,gender_c=g)

      Reference=field_levels[3],Contrast="Men-minus-women gap: Nat&Eng minus comparison area",

      (gaps$estimate[gaps$area==a]-gaps$estimate[gaps$area==field_levels[3]]))<1e-8)

formation_category_labels <- function(k)if(k=="M2")c("Other","Work-related","School/university") else
  c("≥5 years before","<5 years before / same year","1–5 years after",">5 years after")
# Draw every category explicitly: axis() can suppress neighbouring multiline labels.
draw_formation_category_axis <- function(k,at) {
  labels <- if(k=="M2")c("Other","Work-related","School/\nuniversity") else
    c("≥5 years\nbefore","<5 years\nbefore or\nsame year","1–5 years\nafter",">5 years\nafter")
  stopifnot(length(at)==length(labels))
  graphics::axis(1,at=at,labels=FALSE)
  label_cex <- if(k=="M3").9 else 1
  label_y <- graphics::par("usr")[3] - 1.4*graphics::strheight("M",cex=label_cex)
  # Top-align labels below the plot; reserve the lower margin for all three lines.
  graphics::text(x=at,y=rep(label_y,length(at)),labels=labels,
    adj=c(.5,1),xpd=NA,cex=label_cex)
}
draw_formation_figure <- function(path,outcome,distribution,tests,width=2600,height=3100,res=200) {
  grDevices::png(path,width=width,height=height,res=res,bg="white")
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(),add=TRUE)
  graphics::layout(matrix(c(1,3,2,4),nrow=2,byrow=TRUE))
  graphics::par(mar=c(8,6.4,5.6,1.2),oma=c(0,0,0,0),las=1,bty="l",cex=1.18,cex.main=1.06,cex.lab=1.06,cex.axis=1)
  colours <- list(M2=c("#7C8794","#C07848","#40678F"),M3=c("#7C8794","#40678F","#C07848","#7D6C9B"))
  for(k in c("M2","M3")) {
    z <- outcome[[k]];labels <- if(k=="M2")c("Other","Work-related","School/\nuniversity") else formation_category_labels(k)
    positions <- seq_len(nrow(z));ylim <- range(c(0,1,z$lower,z$upper))
    ticks <- pretty(ylim,n=5)
    graphics::plot(positions,z$estimate,type="n",xlim=c(.6,length(positions)+.4),ylim=ylim,
      xaxt="n",yaxt="n",xlab="",ylab="Adjusted probability of occupational homogamy",
      main=if(k=="M2")"A. Homogamy across meeting contexts" else "B. Homogamy across formation timing")
    draw_formation_category_axis(k,positions)
    graphics::axis(2,at=ticks,labels=paste0(round(100*ticks),"%"))
    graphics::abline(h=ticks,col="#E3E8EC",lwd=.7)
    graphics::arrows(positions,z$lower,positions,z$upper,angle=90,code=3,length=.04,col="#40678F",lwd=1.4)
    graphics::points(positions,z$estimate,pch=16,cex=1.2,col="#40678F")
    graphics::text(positions,z$upper,labels=paste0(fmt(100*z$estimate,1),"%"),pos=3,offset=.45,cex=1)
    graphics::mtext("All research areas and both sexes",side=3,line=.5,cex=.98,col="#52616D")
    z <- distribution[[k]]
    sex_colour <- c(Men="#40678F",Women="#BF5959")
    area_shape <- setNames(c(16,17,15),field_levels)
    lev <- levels(datasets[[1]][[av_variables[[k]]]])
    offset <- seq(-.24,.24,length.out=6)
    group <- match(z$area,field_levels)+ifelse(z$gender=="Women",3L,0L)
    x <- match(z$setting,lev)+offset[group]
    ylim <- range(c(0,1,z$lower,z$upper));ticks <- pretty(ylim,n=5)
    graphics::plot(x,z$estimate,type="n",xlim=c(.6,length(lev)+.4),ylim=ylim,xaxt="n",yaxt="n",
      xlab="",ylab=if(k=="M2")"Adjusted probability of meeting context" else "Adjusted probability of timing category",
      main=if(k=="M2")"C. Meeting context by sex and area" else "D. Timing category by sex and area")
    draw_formation_category_axis(k,seq_along(lev))
    graphics::axis(2,at=ticks,labels=paste0(round(100*ticks),"%"))
    graphics::abline(h=ticks,col="#E3E8EC",lwd=.7)
    graphics::arrows(x,z$lower,x,z$upper,angle=90,code=3,length=.025,col=sex_colour[z$gender],lwd=1.1)
    graphics::points(x,z$estimate,pch=area_shape[z$area],cex=.95,col=sex_colour[z$gender])
    test <- tests[tests$Model==k,,drop=FALSE]
    graphics::legend("bottom",inset=c(0,-.29),legend=c("Men","Women","Hum&Soc","Life","Nat&Eng"),
      col=c(sex_colour,rep("#555555",3)),pch=c(16,16,area_shape),ncol=3,bty="n",xpd=NA,cex=.96)

  }
  invisible(path)
}

    ") were ",if(all(c(area_duration$p,phd_duration$p)>=cfg$alpha,na.rm=FALSE))
      "not statistically significant." else "reported separately in the Supplement.")
} else author_result_values$nested_covariate_summary <-
  "One or more exploratory relationship-duration associations could not be estimated."
nested_age <- nested_covariate_results[nested_covariate_results$term%in%c("age_c","age_homogamous_c"),,drop=FALSE]
if(nrow(nested_age)==6L && all(is.finite(nested_age$p)) && all(nested_age$p>=cfg$alpha)) {

} else {

# Report the six robustness maxima separately and only assert stability when verified.
robustness_max_text <- function(kind) {
  z <- author_robustness_checks[author_robustness_checks$Association==kind,,drop=FALSE]
  z <- z[match(vapply(indirect_ids,function(id)focal[[id]]$label,character(1)),z$Contrast),,drop=FALSE]
  label <- switch(kind,field="field gender-gap contrasts",meeting="indirect associations via meeting context",timing="indirect associations via formation timing")
  maxima <- vapply(z$Maximum_change_pp,function(x)if(is.finite(x))fmt(x,1) else "unavailable",character(1))
  status <- if(all(z$Unchanged_significance_verified))"with unchanged significance across all planned checks" else
    if(any(z$Significance_changes>0,na.rm=TRUE))"with significance changes in completed checks detailed in Table S4" else "with unchanged significance in completed checks; some planned checks remain unverified (Table S4)"
  paste0("For the ",label,", maximum estimate changes relative to the corresponding primary estimates were ",
    maxima[1]," and ",maxima[2]," percentage points for Life Sciences and Natural & Engineering Sciences, respectively, each relative to Humanities & Social Sciences (",status,").")
}

    z <- changed_field_checks[i,,drop=FALSE]
    pair <- sensitivity_pairs[[z$Specification]]
    a <- pair$alt[pair$alt$id==z$id,,drop=FALSE]
    b <- pair$main[pair$main$id==z$id,,drop=FALSE]
    if(nrow(a)!=1L || nrow(b)!=1L || !all(is.finite(c(a$p_holm,b$p_holm))))
      return(paste0(z$Contrast," changed significance in ",z$Specification," (Table S4)."))
    direction <- if(a$p_holm<cfg$alpha)"became significant" else "became non-significant"
    paste0(z$Contrast," ",direction," in ",z$Specification,
      " (Holm-adjusted p ",report_decimal_p(a$p_holm),
      "; corresponding primary p ",report_decimal_p(b$p_holm),").")
  },character(1))
  paste(details,collapse=" ")
} else ""

# Joint HC3 tests for Models 2–3 retain covariance between category equations.
indicator_marginal_tests <- function(fs,ds,rhs=c("gender_c*research_area_3g",base_controls)) {
  hypotheses <- c("Gender","Research area","Gender × research area")
  bind(lapply(hypotheses,function(hypothesis) {
    pieces <- lapply(seq_along(fs),function(i) {
      f <- fs[[i]];dat <- ds[[i]];p <- ncol(f$X);categories <- ncol(f$Y)
      design <- function(g=NULL,area=NULL) {
        nd <- dat
        if(!is.null(g))nd$gender_c <- g
        if(!is.null(area))nd$research_area_3g <- factor(rep(area,nrow(nd)),levels=field_levels)
        colMeans(model.matrix(reformulate(rhs),nd))
      }
      L <- if(hypothesis=="Gender")matrix(design(.5)-design(-.5),nrow=1) else
        if(hypothesis=="Research area")do.call(rbind,lapply(field_levels[-1],function(area)
          design(0,area)-design(0,field_levels[1]))) else {
          take <- grep(":",colnames(f$X));diag(p)[take,,drop=FALSE]
        }
      H <- kronecker(diag(categories),L)
      list(Q=drop(H%*%f$Q),U=H%*%f$U%*%t(H))
    })
    q <- pool_vectors(lapply(pieces,`[[`,"Q"),lapply(pieces,`[[`,"U"),fs[[1]]$df)
    cbind(Association=hypothesis,q)
  }))
}
formation_all_tests <- bind(lapply(names(av_response_fits),function(k)

    main <- formation_all_tests[formation_all_tests$Key==k,,drop=FALSE]
    z$Primary_p <- main$p[match(z$Association,main$Association)]

      Model=if(k=="M2")"Model 2" else "Model 3",N=nrow(plan$data[[1]]),z)

# Observed main Table 1. Missing percentages use the full eligible denominator.
main_table1_rows <- list()
main_table1_variable <- function(variable,label,continuous=FALSE,eligible=rep(TRUE,nrow(d)),values=NULL) {
  x <- if(is.null(values))d[[variable]] else values
  if(is.null(x))return(invisible(NULL))
  valid <- eligible & !is.na(x)
  if(continuous)valid <- valid & is.finite(num(x))
  missing <- sum(eligible & !valid)
  column <- function(group,level=NULL) {
    use <- eligible & group;observed <- use & valid
    if(continuous) {
      xx <- num(x[observed])
      return(if(length(xx))paste0(fmt(mean(xx),1)," (",fmt(sd(xx),1),")") else "—")
    }
    if(is.null(level))return(paste0(sum(observed)," observed"))
    n <- sum(observed & as.character(x)==level)
    paste0(n," (",pct(n,sum(observed)),"%)")
  }
  row <- function(category,level=NULL,heading=FALSE)data.frame(Variable=if(heading)label else "",
    Category=category,Men=column(men,level),Women=column(women,level),Total=column(rep(TRUE,nrow(d)),level),
    `Missing n (%)`=if(heading)paste0(missing," (",pct(missing,sum(eligible)),"%)") else "",check.names=FALSE)
  if(continuous)main_table1_rows[[length(main_table1_rows)+1L]] <<- row("M (SD)",heading=TRUE) else {
    main_table1_rows[[length(main_table1_rows)+1L]] <<- row("",heading=TRUE)
    levels <- if(is.factor(x))levels(droplevels(x[valid])) else unique(as.character(x[valid]))
    for(level in levels)main_table1_rows[[length(main_table1_rows)+1L]] <<- row(level,level)
  }
}

standardize_model_coefficients <- function(fs) {
  terms <- setdiff(names(coef(fs[[1]])),"(Intercept)")
  scales <- lapply(fs,function(f)apply(model.matrix(f),2,sd)/sd(model.response(model.frame(f))))
  bind(lapply(terms,function(term)cbind(term=term,pool_one(
    vapply(seq_along(fs),function(i)unname(coef(fs[[i]])[term]*scales[[i]][term]),numeric(1)),
    vapply(seq_along(fs),function(i)unname(vcov(fs[[i]])[term,term]*scales[[i]][term]^2),numeric(1)),
    nobs(fs[[1]]),length(coef(fs[[1]]))))))
}

model2_row <- function(model,outcome,category,predictor,coefficient="",test="",p=NA_real_)
  data.frame(Model=paste("Model",model),Outcome=outcome,Category=category,Predictor=predictor,
    `Standardized β [95% CI]`=coefficient,`t/F (df)`=test,
    p=if(is.finite(p))paste0(fp(p),p_stars(p)) else "",p_numeric=p,check.names=FALSE)
coefficient_cell <- function(q)paste0(fmt(q$estimate,3)," [",fmt(q$lower,3),", ",fmt(q$upper,3),"]")
for(k in c("M1","M2","M3")) {

  for(i in seq_len(nrow(qq))) {

    model2_rows[[length(model2_rows)+1L]] <- model2_row(number,"Occupational homogamy","",
      pretty_term(q$term),coefficient_cell(q),paste0("t(",fmt(q$df,1),") = ",fmt(q$estimate/q$SE,2)),q$p)
  }
  model2_rows[[length(model2_rows)+1L]] <- model2_row(number,"Occupational homogamy","",
    "AICc (Gaussian working likelihood)",test=fmt(mean(vapply(fs,function(f)aicc_one(f)$AICc,numeric(1))),2))
}
indicator_aicc <- function(f) {
  n <- nrow(f$X);r <- ncol(f$Y);p <- ncol(f$X)
  E <- f$Y-f$X%*%f$B;S <- crossprod(E)/n
  detS <- determinant(S,logarithm=TRUE)
  if(detS$sign<=0)return(NA_real_)
  K <- p*r+r*(r+1)/2
  if(n<=K+1)return(NA_real_)
  n*(r*(log(2*pi)+1)+as.numeric(detS$modulus))+2*K+2*K*(K+1)/(n-K-1)
}
for(k in names(av_response_fits)) {
  number <- if(k=="M2")2L else 3L
  response <- av_variables[[k]];fs <- av_response_fits[[k]]
  categories <- levels(datasets[[1]][[response]])[-1]
  terms <- setdiff(colnames(fs[[1]]$X),"(Intercept)")
  for(j in seq_along(categories))for(term in terms) {
    position <- (j-1L)*ncol(fs[[1]]$X)+match(term,colnames(fs[[1]]$X))
    scales <- vapply(fs,function(f)sd(f$X[,term])/sd(f$Y[,j]),numeric(1))
    q <- pool_one(vapply(seq_along(fs),function(i)fs[[i]]$Q[position]*scales[i],numeric(1)),
      vapply(seq_along(fs),function(i)fs[[i]]$U[position,position]*scales[i]^2,numeric(1)),
      nrow(fs[[1]]$X),ncol(fs[[1]]$X))
    model2_rows[[length(model2_rows)+1L]] <- model2_row(number,
      if(k=="M2")"Meeting context" else "Formation timing",categories[j],pretty_term(term),
      coefficient_cell(q),paste0("t(",fmt(q$df,1),") = ",fmt(q$estimate/q$SE,2)),q$p)
  }
  av_aicc <- vapply(fs,indicator_aicc,numeric(1))
  model2_rows[[length(model2_rows)+1L]] <- model2_row(number,
    if(k=="M2")"Meeting context" else "Formation timing","",
    "AICc (multivariate Gaussian working likelihood)",
    test=if(all(is.finite(av_aicc)))fmt(mean(av_aicc),2) else "Not estimable")
}
# Keep full coefficient/test/fit records for Table S3, but show coefficients/CIs only in Supplementary Table S6.
main_table2_coefficients <- bind(model2_rows)
main_table2_coefficients$Predictor[grepl("^AICc",main_table2_coefficients$Predictor)] <- "AICc"
main_table2_predictors <- setdiff(unique(main_table2_coefficients$Predictor),"AICc")
main_table2 <- data.frame(Predictor=c("**Outcome / specification**",main_table2_predictors),check.names=FALSE)
main_table2_outcomes <- c("Occupational Homogamy","Meetings","Formation Timings",
  "Occupational Homogamy — Meetings","Occupational Homogamy — Formation Timings")
for(number in 1:5) {
  label <- paste("Model",number)
  rows <- main_table2_coefficients[main_table2_coefficients$Model==label,,drop=FALSE]
  cells <- vapply(main_table2_predictors,function(predictor) {
    z <- rows[rows$Predictor==predictor,,drop=FALSE]
    if(!nrow(z))return("—")
    values <- z$`Standardized β [95% CI]`
    significant <- is.finite(z$p_numeric) & z$p_numeric<cfg$alpha
    values[significant] <- paste0("**",values[significant],"**")
    prefix <- ifelse(nzchar(z$Category),paste0(z$Category,": "),"")
    paste(paste0(prefix,values),collapse=" / ")
  },character(1))
  main_table2[[label]] <- c(paste0("**",main_table2_outcomes[number],"**"),cells)
}
stopifnot(identical(names(main_table2),c("Predictor",paste("Model",1:5))),
  !anyDuplicated(main_table2$Predictor),!any(grepl("Omnibus|^AICc$",main_table2$Predictor)),
  !any(grepl("β = |; t\\(|; p ",as.matrix(main_table2))))
main_table2_note <- paste("Cells report standardized coefficients [95% CIs] only; bold estimates have unadjusted two-sided p < .05, using the unrounded HC3/Rubin-pooled coefficient tests.",
  "— indicates a predictor absent from the model. Models 1, 4 and 5 predict Occupational Homogamy; Model 4 adds Meetings and Model 5 adds Formation Timings.",
  "Models 2–3 jointly predict the non-reference Meetings and Formation Timings indicators. Category-labelled estimates separated by / identify their distinct outcome equations; bold applies only to significant estimates, not automatically to every estimate sharing a cell.",
  "All models include gender × research area, age, binary age similarity and relationship duration. The reference field is Humanities & Social Sciences; meeting and timing predictors use Other and five or more years before PhD completion as references.",
  "Coefficients are standardized by SD(design column)/SD(outcome indicator) within each imputation, and estimates and scaled HC3 variances are Rubin-pooled.",
  "Gender coefficients refer to the reference field; area coefficients are evaluated at gender = 0 under effect coding. Full tests and model fit remain in Table S3. Primary planned-contrast corrections are unchanged.")

# Summarize exploratory extensions without copying provisional values from the outline.
exploratory_test_rows <- list()
exploratory_extension_coefficients <- data.frame()
for(key in names(nested_extensions)) {
  z <- nested_extensions[[key]]
  if(!is.null(z$error))next
  if(z$specification%in%c("Meeting","Timing")) {
    tests <- rbind(overall_tests(z$fits,z$datasets),cbind(Association="Gender × research area",
      block_test(z$fits,grep(":",names(coef(z$fits[[1]])),value=TRUE))),
      cbind(Association=if(z$specification=="Meeting")"Meeting context" else "Formation timing",
        block_test(z$fits,term_columns(z$fits[[1]],z$variable))))
    tests$eta2_generalized <- NA_real_
    tests$eta2_generalized[nrow(tests)] <- mean_generalized_eta(z$fits,z$variable,z$datasets)
  } else tests <- cbind(Association="Timing jointly",z$tests)
  exploratory_test_rows[[key]] <- cbind(Model_key=key,tests)
  qq <- standardize_model_coefficients(z$fits);qq$Model_key <- key
  exploratory_extension_coefficients <- rbind(exploratory_extension_coefficients,qq)
}
exploratory_extension_tests <- dplyr::bind_rows(exploratory_test_rows)

      label.padding=grid::unit(.10,"lines"),show.legend=FALSE)
}

result_pct <- function(x,eligible=rep(TRUE,length(x)))pct(sum(x & eligible,na.rm=TRUE),sum(eligible,na.rm=TRUE))
result_status <- function(p)if(length(p)!=1L || !is.finite(p))"could not be tested" else
  if(p<cfg$alpha)"was statistically significant" else "was not statistically significant"
result_test <- function(q)if(!nrow(q))"not estimable" else report_F_full(q)

  # Early minus all remaining timing categories = 2 * early probability - 1.
  q$Early_vs_remaining_p <- 2*pt(-abs((q$estimate-.5)/q$SE),df=q$df)
  cbind(Area=area,q)
}))

    author_result_values$meeting_work_p,") and ",author_result_values$meeting_school_pct,
    "% for school/university (versus other contexts, Tukey-adjusted p ",author_result_values$meeting_school_p,"). In Model 5, the overall association with the four-category formation-timing variable ",
    result_status(categorical_timing_p)," (",author_result_values$timing_F,
    "), with the highest adjusted probability in the ",author_result_values$timing_highest_category," category (Figure 3)."),
  paste0("**We finally tested for indirect associations.** As shown in Table 2, the indirect association via meeting context for Natural & Engineering Sciences relative to Humanities & Social Sciences ",
    result_status(meeting_nat$p_holm)," (",pp_sentence(meeting_nat,TRUE),"); the Life Sciences contrast ",
    result_status(meeting_life$p_holm)," (",pp_sentence(meeting_life,TRUE),"). Adjustment for meeting context changed the field-gap differences from ",
    author_result_values$nat_contrast," to ",author_result_values$meeting_nat_adjusted," pp in Natural & Engineering Sciences and from ",
    author_result_values$life_contrast," to ",author_result_values$meeting_life_adjusted," pp in Life Sciences. Adjustment for timing changed these contrasts from ",
    author_result_values$nat_contrast," to ",author_result_values$timing_nat_adjusted," pp and from ",author_result_values$life_contrast,
    " to ",author_result_values$timing_life_adjusted," pp, respectively. Timing indirect associations ",
    if(all(c(timing_life$p_holm,timing_nat$p_holm)>=cfg$alpha))"were non-significant for both contrasts." else
      "showed specification-dependent evidence, detailed in Table 2."," These associations do not establish causal mediation."))

# Summarize completed checks and name the largest primary-reference estimate changes.
result_sensitivity_label <- function(x) {
  for(k in names(report_model_map))x <- gsub(paste0("\\b",k,"\\b"),report_model_map[[k]],x,perl=TRUE)
  x
}
result_largest_field_changes <- paste(vapply(indirect_ids,function(id) {
  z <- gender_sensitivity[gender_sensitivity$id==id & is.finite(gender_sensitivity$Change_pp),,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(z))return(paste0(focal[[id]]$label,": sensitivity estimates were unavailable."))
  q <- z[which.max(z$Change_pp),,drop=FALSE]
  paste0("For ",focal[[id]]$label,", the largest absolute change was ",fmt(q$Change_pp,1),
    " percentage points in ",result_sensitivity_label(q$Specification),".")
},character(1)),collapse=" ")
result_influence_text <- if(sum(!mi_keep)==0L && sum(!cc_keep)==0L)
  "Second, no observations were flagged in either the imputed or complete-case sample using the residual, Cook’s-distance and leverage rules described in the Methods." else
  paste0("Second, the residual, Cook’s-distance and leverage rules described in the Methods flagged ",sum(!mi_keep),
    " observations in the imputed sample and ",sum(!cc_keep)," in the complete-case sample. These observations remained in the primary analyses and were excluded in sensitivity refits.")
result_sensitivity_pattern <- function(kind) {
  z <- author_robustness_checks[author_robustness_checks$Association==kind,,drop=FALSE]
  label <- switch(kind,field="field gender-gap contrasts",meeting="meeting-context indirect associations",
    timing="formation-timing indirect associations")
  changed <- sum(z$Significance_changes,na.rm=TRUE)
  if(any(!is.finite(z$Significance_changes)))return(paste("Some",label,"could not be evaluated (Table S4)."))
  if(changed>0)return(paste0("Statistical significance changed in ",changed,
    " completed comparisons for the ",label," (Table S4)."))
  paste0("The ",label," retained their primary significance conclusions across the completed checks.")
}
result_sensitivity_failures <- dplyr::bind_rows(sensitivity_status,indirect_sensitivity_status,polynomial_status)
result_sensitivity_completion <- if(nrow(result_sensitivity_failures)) {
  failed_logistic <- any(grepl("Logistic",result_sensitivity_failures$Specification,ignore.case=TRUE))
  paste0("Some planned checks",if(failed_logistic)" (including logistic sensitivity checks)" else "",
    " could not be completed; these are reported separately from changes in significance in Table S4.")
} else "All fitted sensitivity checks completed without recorded estimation failures."
result_sensitivity_paragraphs <- c(
  "Sensitivity analyses examined the occupational-homogamy models (Models 1, 4–5), the meeting/timing category distributions (Models 2–3), and the corresponding indirect associations (Models 6–7). We first describe the checks performed, then report the largest changes in estimates across sensitivity analyses.",
  paste0("First, analyses were repeated using complete-case observations (N = ",nrow(cc_data),"; Table S4). ",result_influence_text,
    " Third, Models 1–5 were re-estimated without age, partner-age similarity and relationship duration, and the indirect associations were recalculated using matching models without these covariates.",
    " Fourth, Models 3, 5 and 7 were re-estimated without relationship duration to examine sensitivity to its overlap with timing relative to PhD completion.",
    " Fifth, the categorical timing predictor in the occupational-homogamy model was replaced with separate continuous linear, quadratic and cubic specifications, and the timing indirect associations were recalculated with the corresponding timing terms (Models 5 and 7; Figure S4).",
    " Sixth, logistic versions of occupational-homogamy Models 1, 4–5 were fitted; indirect associations used marginal probability products rather than differences in logit coefficients (Table S4; Figure S7).",
    " The categorical-distribution Models 2–3 were checked using complete cases, influential-case exclusions and omission of covariates; they were not refitted as logistic models or polynomial outcome models."),
  paste0("Compared with the corresponding primary multiply imputed models, the largest changes in the field gender-gap contrasts were ",
    paste(vapply(indirect_ids,function(id) {
      z <- gender_sensitivity[gender_sensitivity$id==id & is.finite(gender_sensitivity$Change_pp),,drop=FALSE]
      if(nrow(z))fmt(max(z$Change_pp),1) else "unavailable"
    },character(1)),collapse=" and "),
    " percentage points for Life Sciences and Natural & Engineering Sciences, respectively (each relative to Humanities & Social Sciences). ",
    paste(vapply(c("field","meeting","timing"),result_sensitivity_pattern,character(1)),collapse=" "),
    " ",result_sensitivity_completion," Full estimates and comparisons are provided in Table S4."))

# Brief main-text exploratory results: baseline models, significant associations only.
# Meeting/timing extensions and all non-significant tests remain in Table S5.
result_exploratory_intro <- paste("We explored additional gender differences in partner similarity on work-related characteristics among professors in academic and non-academic couples.",
  "We first distinguished research-area and topic similarity within academic couples, then focused on educational similarity within non-academic couples. In a third subsection, we explored associations between partner similarity and participant age, partner-age difference, and relationship length.")
result_similarity_counts <- function(k) {
  y <- nested_outcome(nested_specs[[k]]);eligible <- if(k=="PhD")nonacademic else academic
  positive <- sum(y==1,na.rm=TRUE);negative <- sum(y==0,na.rm=TRUE)
  target <- 1
  gender_percent <- function(g)pct(sum(y[g]==target,na.rm=TRUE),sum(!is.na(y[g])))
  percentages <- paste0(gender_percent(women),"% of women and ",gender_percent(men),"% of men")
  if(k=="PhD")return(paste0(positive," had a PhD-qualified partner (",percentages,
    ") and ",negative," had a partner without a PhD (",sum(eligible & is.na(y))," missing)."))
  paste0(positive," reported ",if(k=="Topic")"the same or similar research topics" else "the same research area",
    " (",percentages,") and ",negative," reported ",if(k=="Topic")"different topics" else "different research areas",
    " (",sum(eligible & is.na(y))," missing).")
}
result_exploratory_significant <- function(k) {
  z <- nested_models[[k]]
  if(!is.null(z$error))return("")
  outcome <- switch(k,Topic="sharing research topics",Area="sharing a research area",PhD="having a PhD-qualified non-academic partner")
  text <- character()
  tests <- nested_overall_tests[[k]]
  gender <- tests[tests$Association=="Gender",,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(gender)==1L && report_supported(gender$p)) {
    q <- pool_contrast(z$fits,z$datasets,list(list(gender_c=.5),list(gender_c=-.5)),c(1,-1))
    text <- c(text,paste0("Women had a ",if(q$estimate>0)"higher" else "lower"," adjusted probability of ",outcome,
      " than men (difference = ",pp_sentence(q),")."))
  }
  area <- tests[tests$Association=="Research area",,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(area)==1L && report_supported(area$p)) {
    if(k=="PhD") {
      text <- c(text,paste0("Research area was associated with ",outcome," (",report_f(area),")."))
    } else {
      probabilities <- vapply(field_levels,function(a)pool_contrast(z$fits,z$datasets,
        list(list(gender_c=.5,research_area_3g=a),list(gender_c=-.5,research_area_3g=a)),c(.5,.5))$estimate,numeric(1))
      text <- c(text,paste0("Research area was associated with ",outcome," (",report_f(area),
        "), with equal-gender adjusted probabilities ranging from ",fmt(100*min(probabilities),1),"% in ",
        report_field(field_levels[which.min(probabilities)])," to ",fmt(100*max(probabilities),1),"% in ",
        report_field(field_levels[which.max(probabilities)]),"."))
    }
  }
  interaction <- z$tests
  if(nrow(interaction)==1L && report_supported(interaction$p_holm))
    text <- c(text,paste0("The gender difference in ",outcome," varied across research areas (",report_f(interaction,TRUE),")."))
  gaps <- z$gaps
  if(nrow(gaps))for(i in which(is.finite(gaps$p_holm) & gaps$p_holm<cfg$alpha)) {
    q <- gaps[i,,drop=FALSE]
    text <- c(text,paste0("In ",report_field(q$area),", women had a ",if(q$estimate>0)"higher" else "lower",
      " probability of ",outcome," than men (women–men difference = ",pp_sentence(q,TRUE),")."))
  }
  if(k=="PhD" && nrow(phd_field_contrasts))for(i in which(is.finite(phd_field_contrasts$p_holm) & phd_field_contrasts$p_holm<cfg$alpha)) {
    q <- phd_field_contrasts[i,,drop=FALSE]
    p1 <- phd_field_probabilities$estimate[phd_field_probabilities$Area==q$Area]
    p0 <- phd_field_probabilities$estimate[phd_field_probabilities$Area==q$Reference]
    text <- c(text,paste0("Professors in ",report_field(q$Area)," were ",if(q$estimate>0)"more" else "less",
      " likely to have a PhD-qualified partner than those in ",report_field(q$Reference),
      " (",fmt(100*p1,1),"% vs. ",fmt(100*p0,1),"%; adjusted difference = ",pp_sentence(q,TRUE),")."))
  }
  # Report only nonsignificant omnibus terms, using the same inference as above.
  # Interaction p-values retain Holm correction across the exploratory outcomes.
  ns_tests <- character()
  if(nrow(gender)==1L && is.finite(gender$p) && gender$p>=cfg$alpha)
    ns_tests <- c(ns_tests,paste0("gender: ",report_f(gender)))
  if(nrow(area)==1L && is.finite(area$p) && area$p>=cfg$alpha)
    ns_tests <- c(ns_tests,paste0("research area: ",report_f(area)))
  if(nrow(interaction)==1L && is.finite(interaction$p_holm) && interaction$p_holm>=cfg$alpha)
    ns_tests <- c(ns_tests,paste0("gender-by-area interaction: ",report_f(interaction,TRUE)))
  if(length(ns_tests)) {
    ns_labels <- sub(":.*$","",ns_tests)
    ns_terms <- if(length(ns_labels)==1L)ns_labels else if(length(ns_labels)==2L)
      paste(ns_labels,collapse=" or ") else
      paste0(paste(ns_labels[-length(ns_labels)],collapse=", "),", or ",tail(ns_labels,1))
    text <- c(text,paste0("No ",if(length(text))"other " else "",
      "significant associations with ",ns_terms," were found for ",outcome,
      " (",paste(ns_tests,collapse="; "),")."))
  }
  paste(text,collapse=" ")
}
result_academic_paragraphs <- c(
  paste0("Of the ",sum(academic)," professors in academic couples, ",result_similarity_counts("Topic"),
    " For research-area similarity, ",result_similarity_counts("Area"),
    " Area similarity should be interpreted cautiously: couples spanning Natural and Engineering Sciences could report different research areas, potentially underestimating similarity within this combined analytical group."),
  paste(Filter(nzchar,c(result_exploratory_significant("Topic"),result_exploratory_significant("Area"))),collapse=" "),
  "Models 8–9 adjusted for age, partner-age similarity and relationship duration (Figure 4; full results in Table S5).")
result_academic_paragraphs <- result_academic_paragraphs[nzchar(result_academic_paragraphs)]
result_education_paragraphs <- c(
  paste0("Of the ",sum(nonacademic)," professors in non-academic couples, ",result_similarity_counts("PhD"),
    " Model 14 examined educational similarity, adjusting for the same covariates (Figure 5)."),
  result_exploratory_significant("PhD"),
  "Full estimates, including the meeting-context and timing extensions, are reported in Table S5.")
result_education_paragraphs <- result_education_paragraphs[nzchar(result_education_paragraphs)]

# Covariate findings are reported once, in the third exploratory subsection.
result_exploratory_covariates <- function(k) {
  outcome <- switch(k,Topic="sharing research topics within academic couples",
    Area="sharing a research area within academic couples",PhD="having a PhD-qualified non-academic partner")
  text <- character()
  covariates <- nested_covariate_results[nested_covariate_results$Outcome==k &
    is.finite(nested_covariate_results$p) & nested_covariate_results$p<cfg$alpha,,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(covariates))for(i in seq_len(nrow(covariates))) {
    q <- covariates[i,,drop=FALSE]
    exposure <- switch(q$term,age_c="A one-year increase in participant age",cp_duration_c="A one-year increase in relationship duration",
      age_homogamous_c="Partner-age similarity (0–2 vs. at least 3 years)",pretty_term(q$term))
    text <- c(text,paste0(exposure," was associated with a ",if(q$estimate>0)"higher" else "lower",
      " probability of ",outcome," (",pp_sentence(q),")."))
  }
  paste(text,collapse=" ")
}
# Include the main models before the conditional partner-similarity models.
result_main_covariates <- function(k) {
  q <- coefs[[k]]
  q <- q[q$term%in%base_controls & is.finite(q$p) & q$p<cfg$alpha,,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(q))return("")
  paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(q)),function(i) {
    z <- q[i,,drop=FALSE]
    exposure <- switch(z$term,age_c="A one-year increase in participant age",
      cp_duration_c="A one-year increase in relationship duration",
      age_homogamous_c="Partner-age similarity (0–2 vs. at least 3 years)")
    paste0("In ",report_model_map[[k]],", ",tolower(exposure)," was associated with a ",
      if(z$estimate>0)"higher" else "lower"," probability of occupational homogamy (",pp_sentence(z),").")
  },character(1)),collapse=" ")
}
result_distribution_covariates <- function(number) {
  q <- main_table2_coefficients
  q <- q[q$Model==paste("Model",number) & q$Predictor%in%pretty_term(base_controls) &
    is.finite(q$p_numeric) & q$p_numeric<cfg$alpha,,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(q))return("")
  paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(q)),function(i) {
    z <- q[i,,drop=FALSE]
    term <- base_controls[match(z$Predictor,pretty_term(base_controls))]
    exposure <- switch(term,age_c="Greater participant age",cp_duration_c="Longer relationships",
      age_homogamous_c="Partner-age similarity (0–2 vs. at least 3 years)")
    coefficient <- as.numeric(sub(" .*","",z$`Standardized β [95% CI]`))
    paste0("In Model ",number,", ",tolower(exposure)," was associated with a ",
      if(coefficient>0)"higher" else "lower"," probability of ",
      if(number==2)paste0("meeting in the ",z$Category," category") else
        paste0("relationship formation in the ",z$Category," category"),
      " (standardized coefficient [95% CI] = ",z$`Standardized β [95% CI]`,
      "; p ",report_decimal_p(z$p_numeric),").")
  },character(1)),collapse=" ")
}
# Concise trends use the current pooled estimates; fall back to individual
# findings if a later analysis no longer supports the summarized pattern.
result_covariate_row <- function(model,term,category) {
  q <- main_table2_coefficients
  q <- q[q$Model==paste("Model",model) & q$Predictor==pretty_term(term) &
    grepl(category,q$Category,ignore.case=TRUE),,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(q)!=1L)return(data.frame())
  data.frame(estimate=as.numeric(sub(" .*","",q$`Standardized β [95% CI]`)),p=q$p_numeric)
}
result_trend_supported <- function(q,direction)
  nrow(q)==1L && is.finite(q$estimate) && report_supported(q$p) && sign(q$estimate)==direction
result_trend_ps <- function(rows) {
  ps <- vapply(rows,function(q)q$p,numeric(1))
  if(length(ps)==1L)return(paste0("p ",report_decimal_p(ps)))
  if(all(ps<.001))return(paste0(if(length(ps)==2L)"both" else "all"," ps < .001"))
  paste0(if(length(ps)==2L)"both" else "all"," ps ≤ ",
    sub("^0","",sprintf("%.3f",ceiling(max(ps)*1000)/1000)))
}
meeting_trends <- list(
  result_covariate_row(2,"age_c","At work"),
  result_covariate_row(2,"age_c","School/University"),
  result_covariate_row(2,"cp_duration_c","At work"),
  result_covariate_row(2,"cp_duration_c","School/University"))
timing_age_trends <- list(
  result_covariate_row(3,"age_c","More than 5 years"),
  result_covariate_row(3,"age_c","Less than 5 years"))
timing_duration_trends <- list(
  result_covariate_row(3,"cp_duration_c","More than 5 years"),
  result_covariate_row(3,"cp_duration_c","Less than 5 years"),
  result_covariate_row(3,"cp_duration_c","1 to 5 years"))
age_similarity_trend <- result_covariate_row(2,"age_homogamous_c","At work")
formation_trends_supported <- all(mapply(result_trend_supported,meeting_trends,c(1,-1,-1,1))) &&
  all(mapply(result_trend_supported,timing_age_trends,c(1,-1))) &&
  all(mapply(result_trend_supported,timing_duration_trends,c(-1,1,-1))) &&
  result_trend_supported(age_similarity_trend,-1)
result_formation_covariate_text <- if(formation_trends_supported)paste0(
  "Age and relationship length were primarily associated with meeting context and relationship timing. ",
  "Older professors were more likely to have met their partners at work and less likely to have met as students, whereas longer relationships showed the opposite pattern (",
  result_trend_ps(meeting_trends),"). Older professors were also more likely to have formed their relationships more than five years after PhD completion and less likely to have formed them shortly before or in the completion year (",
  result_trend_ps(timing_age_trends),"). Longer relationships showed the reverse pattern and were also less likely to have begun one to five years after completion (",
  result_trend_ps(timing_duration_trends),"). Partners with an age difference of 0–2 years were less likely than those at least three years apart to have met at work (",
  result_trend_ps(list(age_similarity_trend)),").") else
  paste(Filter(nzchar,vapply(2:3,result_distribution_covariates,character(1))),collapse=" ")
result_nested_covariate_row <- function(k,term)
  nested_covariate_results[nested_covariate_results$Outcome==k & nested_covariate_results$term==term,,drop=FALSE]
ohom_duration <- coefs$M2[coefs$M2$term=="cp_duration_c",,drop=FALSE]
topic_duration <- result_nested_covariate_row("Topic","cp_duration_c")
area_duration <- result_nested_covariate_row("Area","cp_duration_c")
area_age <- result_nested_covariate_row("Area","age_c")
# Summarize these outcomes only when no additional significant covariate
# associations would be hidden by the concise wording.
main_covariate_count <- sum(vapply(coefs,function(q)
  sum(q$term%in%base_controls & is.finite(q$p) & q$p<cfg$alpha),integer(1)))
nested_covariate_count <- sum(nested_covariate_results$term%in%base_controls &
  is.finite(nested_covariate_results$p) & nested_covariate_results$p<cfg$alpha)
phd_covariates <- nested_covariate_results[nested_covariate_results$Outcome=="PhD" &
  nested_covariate_results$term%in%base_controls,,drop=FALSE]
phd_covariates_nonsignificant <- nrow(phd_covariates)==length(base_controls) &&
  all(is.finite(phd_covariates$p)) && all(phd_covariates$p>=cfg$alpha)
similarity_trends_supported <- main_covariate_count==1L && nested_covariate_count==3L &&
  result_trend_supported(ohom_duration,-1) && result_trend_supported(topic_duration,-1) &&
  result_trend_supported(area_duration,-1) && result_trend_supported(area_age,1)
result_similarity_covariate_text <- if(similarity_trends_supported)paste0(
  "Associations with partner similarity were more limited. Longer relationships were associated with slightly lower occupational homogamy after adjustment for meeting context (",
  result_trend_ps(list(ohom_duration)),"), and with lower research-topic and research-area similarity within academic couples (p ",
  report_decimal_p(topic_duration$p)," and p ",report_decimal_p(area_duration$p),
  ", respectively). Older professors in academic couples were more likely to share their partner’s research area (",
  result_trend_ps(list(area_age)),").") else
  paste(Filter(nzchar,c(vapply(c("M1","M2","M3"),result_main_covariates,character(1)),
    vapply(c("Topic","Area","PhD"),result_exploratory_covariates,character(1)))),collapse=" ")
if(phd_covariates_nonsignificant)result_similarity_covariate_text <- paste(
  result_similarity_covariate_text,
  "None of these covariates was significantly associated with having a PhD-qualified partner within non-academic couples.")
result_covariate_paragraphs <- c(
  result_formation_covariate_text,
  result_similarity_covariate_text,
  "All associations were adjusted for the other covariates and gender × research area, with meeting context or timing additionally included in Models 4–5, respectively. Partner-age difference was modelled as age similarity (0–2 versus at least 3 years). Full estimates are reported in Tables S3, S5, and S6 and Figure S5. These supporting tests were not adjusted for multiple comparisons.")
result_covariate_paragraphs <- result_covariate_paragraphs[nzchar(result_covariate_paragraphs)]

# One Results builder keeps the rendered report, Markdown and editable Word in sync.
build_results <- function(format=c("html","pipe"),render_paths=FALSE) {
  format <- match.arg(format)
  table <- function(data,caption,note,emphasis=FALSE) {
    if(format=="pipe" && !emphasis)data <- as.data.frame(lapply(data,function(x)
      gsub("<[^>]+>","",as.character(x))),check.names=FALSE)
    if(format=="html" && emphasis)data <- as.data.frame(lapply(data,function(x)
      gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*","<strong>\\1</strong>",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x)),perl=TRUE)),check.names=FALSE)
    c(paste0("**",caption,"**"),"",as.character(knitr::kable(data,format=format,row.names=FALSE,
      escape=!(format=="html" && emphasis))),"",paste0("Note. ",note),"")
  }
  figure <- function(file,note) {
    path <- if(render_paths)gsub("\\\\","/",file.path(main_dir,file)) else file
    c(paste0("![](",path,")"),"",note,"")
  }
  c("# Results","","## 1. Sample Characteristics and Descriptive Statistics","",paste(result_sample_paragraphs,collapse="\n\n"),"",
    table(main_table1,"Table 1. Demographics and study variables by gender",main_table1_note),
    "## 2. Gender Differences in Occupational Homogamy Across Research Areas (H1)","",paste(result_h1_paragraphs,collapse="\n\n"),"",
    figure("Figure_1_adjusted_groups.png",figure1_note),
    "## 3. Meeting Context and Relationship Timing (H2a and H2b)","",paste(result_h2_paragraphs[1:3],collapse="\n\n"),"",
    figure("Figure_2_formation_groups.png",figure2_note),result_h2_paragraphs[4],"",
    figure("Figure_3_homogamy_circumstances.png",figure3_note),result_h2_paragraphs[5],"",
    table(indirect_main_table,"Table 2. Indirect associations for field differences in gender gaps",table1_indirect_note),
    "## 4. Sensitivity Analyses","",paste(result_sensitivity_paragraphs,collapse="\n\n"),"",
    "## 5. Exploratory Associations","",result_exploratory_intro,"","### 5.1. Partner Similarity in Research Areas/Topics among Academic Couples","",
    paste(result_academic_paragraphs,collapse="\n\n"),"",figure("Figure_4_academic_partner_similarity.png",figure4_note),
    "### 5.2. Partner Similarity in Education among Non-Academic Couples","",paste(result_education_paragraphs,collapse="\n\n"),"",
    figure("Figure_5_partner_education.png",figure5_note),
    "### 5.3. Age, Age Difference, and Relationship Length","",paste(result_covariate_paragraphs,collapse="\n\n"),"")
}
for(i in 1:2) {
  data <- list(main_table1,indirect_main_table)[[i]]
  write.csv(data,file.path(main_dir,paste0("Table_",i,".csv")),row.names=FALSE,na="")
  register_export(file.path(main_dir,paste0("Table_",i,".csv")))
}
